alias_search_basis.scope: 622 coverage_records and 30 generated_concepts.proposals in research/portfolio-register.json; supplementary rg across ddiscov_snapshot and round2 files
alias_search_basis.caveat: New to reviewed inventory is not a claim of new invention, patent novelty, biological novelty, or unowned asset.

final_shortlist.exact_entity: The slower-eluting chiral SFC peak 8015-P2 defined in Weigele et al. 2024, with the article/supplement stereochemical and analytical reference; do not substitute parent 8015 mixture, MiM111, Chimera C, or generic piperine.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Exact P2 improves established sensory/motor phenotypes in approximately 50-week-old Mfn2 T105M knock-in mice and rats. The 2026 rat study randomized and blinded testing; dose cohorts contain four rats per dose and seven WT comparators. The 10 mg/kg cohort stopped at four weeks after normal-range values. A separate acute motility assay used 100 mg/kg, not the chronic dose.

biological_sample_counts.2026_rat_dose_response: 4 animals/dose; WT reference 7; counts of other cohorts differ and were not imputed
biological_sample_counts.2024_mouse_exact_P2: Histology 4 mice/group and synapse counts 3/group; functional panel n values reside in the figures and were not independently transcribed
biological_sample_counts.2024_human_8015_mixture: One T105M patient background; independent culture experiments are not donors
biological_sample_counts.2020_human_Chimera_C: Four patient backgrounds; chemically different article
biological_sample_counts.2020_MiM111_mouse: 6 mice/group; sample target reduced from planned 15 because effect was larger than anticipated

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. WO2023196340 includes a displayed granted US family member US12396968B2; ceased PCT status does not establish open rights.
final_shortlist.decision: Continue staged independent exact-compound human-function proof; no S-tier promotion.
final_shortlist.ranking_delta: Retain human-function proof priority with a more concrete first neuronal assay route. No new exact-P2 human functional response was established in round4.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

independent_challenge.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
independent_challenge.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

final_shortlist.model_route: NYSCF/CMTA catalog identifies AG0002-01-MR(MFN2 H361Y),AG0008-01-MR(c.2219G>C; protein annotation needs reconciliation),and AG0015-01-MR(R364W),with iPSC and fibroblast routes. Distribution is request-based; dates are not a stock check. No exact T105M patient stock verified. Each line requires independent neuronal/neuromuscular qualification and isogenic control; engineered T105M is a separate rebuild branch. March2026 CMTA account adds an operating R364W service based on one patient and a healthy comparator. Function means transport/morphology there, not useful nerve-muscle transmission. Do not infer T105M stock from the Summer2024 recruitment table or ready organoid function from a future grant. Round5 adds exact isogenic R94Q methods and a separate patient/isogenic electrical phenotype; choose the function actually impaired and demonstrate delayed modifiability. CMTA/PsychoGenics operating R364W rat service is distinct from unrestricted stock.
final_shortlist.round4_delta: CMTA describes an already-used BrainXell/ANANDA R364W motor-neuron screening assay. This improves a first mechanistic assay route but supplies no exact-P2 response or NMJ-force endpoint. Summer2024 T105M table was a donor wishlist, not inventory. R364W human-harm extrapolation in an older paper was withdrawn by correction.

final_shortlist.round5_delta: Independent isogenic R94Q transport model has no overt patch-clamp deficit at tested age; a separate corrected patient line supplies network-burst phenotype. independent_challenge.finding: Published PBS pH7.4 solubility is0.23 micromolar, versus5 micromolar nominal concentration in the Darier assay (about22-fold). This is a formulation/exposure uncertainty, not proof the assay is invalid or a ceiling on skin exposure.
independent_challenge.biological_failure_mode: Residual SERCA may be inactivated in an established lesion. Junction-assembly protection may not translate to delayed repair.
independent_challenge.comparator: NAC protects mechanical adhesion in the same primary disease model. CDN1163 is a separate same-target comparator; no superiority follows from next-generation wording.

final_shortlist.model_route: Public JCI170739 SERCA2-perturbed keratinocyte model can guide an independently qualified build. Original N/TERT-2G and mutant clones are not verified standard stock. Catalog Ker-CT or primary HEKa/HEKn are alternative parent routes,not validated replicas. ATCC Lei CapCRL-1098 is an archival Mission Collection fibroblast without a public ATP2A2 genotype,not ready patient epidermis. The published Addgene PX458 route has industry-access restrictions; an independently validated commercial RNP implementation is a separate alternative. Existing treated cultures represent three donors and two actuator-domain variants with approximately70% SERCA2 protein. Biopsy-only DD5–7 are not extra efficacy donors. Qualify residual functional target rather than assume every ATP2A2 variant responds.
round4_delta: Both culture variants lie in the SERCA2 actuator domain. Mean protein abundance is about 70% of control; it is not a measured 50%-protein-null model. Calcium imaging in the retrieved section used DD2.
DD5–7 were biopsy immunohistochemistry samples, not additional NDC-treated culture donors.
DD3–4 required Y27632 during maintenance; all DD cultures and CTL1–2 received it for consistency. It was removed 24–36 h before assays, so there is no demonstrated concurrent ROCK-inhibitor confound.

The 2023 healthy-neuron result involved spine-neck morphology at 0.1 µM, with at least 10 neurons / 70 spines from one culture batch. It is not observed skin toxicity; the 2025 intraperitoneal CNS study does not qualify topical exposure.
The Darier paper section titled Solubility assay measures protein detergent solubility, not dissolved NDC-9009.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Staged work queue, not a validated cross-program probability or investment-return ranking.
final_shortlist.round5_delta: Actual CTIS dantrolene results recovered:16oral starters,10paired completers,6nonresponse discontinuations, uncontrolled PGA/DLQI signal, EASI/BSA nonsignificant, retinoid washout/restart and no direct barrier result. Final-submitted PDFs remain draft-labelled. Dantrolene becomes an adult clinical benchmark; it establishes neither topical delivery nor NDC benefit.

final_shortlist.name: Enasidenib for germline IDH2-R140Q D2HGA2
final_shortlist.decision: Defined clinical development priority: recommend a bounded pediatric article/exposure project linked to prospective organ function.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Clinical-stage work queue; no numerical cross-program success probability or asset-return rank.
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Enasidenib; mesylate tablet reference and documented pediatric sprinkle use. Intended infant presentation must be specified; historical clinical lot identity with EP4058028B1 is unverified.
final_shortlist.population: Direct human treatment anchor is germline heterozygous IDH2-R140Q. R140G, type-I D2HGDH disease and other IDH2 variants do not inherit efficacy.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: One clear severe-cardiomyopathy trajectory: LVEF 20–25% at entry, 35–40% at six months and 40–45% at eight months with later fluctuation and concurrent care. A second original child had normal baseline systolic function; Gold had milder baseline disease. Biochemical suppression is strong; neurological outcomes are less causally secure.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five outcome case records across three publications; original two and Gold are clearly distinct. Cross-publication linkage of two skin cases is unresolved. Metadata-only five-week-old report adds zero verified outcomes.
final_shortlist.material_route: Defined marketed tablet and research free-base routes; actual studied sprinkle and concrete minitablet patent. Public route and historical use do not establish received lot, present supply or infant administration compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATCC R140Q TF-1/parent route is biochemical, homozygous and cancer-line specific. Endogenous heterozygous mouse and genetic reversibility precedents exist. A new human cardiac model is optional when it discriminates a consequential exposure/function question.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: Current adult PK includes 7.9-day half-life, tenfold accumulation, 29-day steady state, active metabolite, interactions and plausible A3 antagonism. No infant dose rule or lifelong safety boundary. Direct pediatric ALT/CK observations require a coherent longitudinal exposure/laboratory timeline.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing clinical program and published granted pediatric minitablet composition/process claims prevent a first-pediatric-formulation or open-rights claim. Define an improvement in delivery, exposure, burden/tolerability or prospective clinical evidence; standalone value capture remains unresolved.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Qualify one intended pediatric article/administration route and parent/metabolite/chiral-D2HG measures, then link exposure to observed tolerability and a preselected growth-aware organ outcome with suitable comparison and concurrent-care accounting.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Reliable delivery and interpretable exposure/PD plus a useful organ-function or preservation signal justify confirmation; a larger product program requires independently supported clinical benefit and a real product advantage.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Redirect delivery failure or exposure-related harm; narrow tissue/genotype/timing claims when appropriate. Do not reject human observations from an unqualified model. Stop a standalone product thesis if no useful incremental contribution or practicable product route exists.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Full clinical lineage and 177-cell laboratory audit; specific public pediatric formulation, adult PK/DDI/A3 and model audit; staged clinical proof with independent challenge. Removed from the reserve list to avoid conflicting current dispositions.

final_shortlist.name: Ruxolitinib 1.5% cream for refractory Hailey–Hailey disease
final_shortlist.decision: Defined controlled clinical-proof priority: recommend marketed-article, protocol and measurement qualification followed by a contemporaneously controlled patient-benefit comparison.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Clinical-stage work queue; not an established proprietary asset or numerical cross-program investment rank.
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Prospective standardized Opzelura 1.5% cream, 15 mg/g ruxolitinib base equivalent as 19.8 mg/g phosphate. Historical cases verify active/concentration/route, not every brand, vehicle or lot.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Five distinguishable exact-strength case reports support useful local control. Monotherapy-style treatment, add-on induction and topical maintenance are kept separate. No controlled exact-rux HHD effect estimate was verified.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five selected single-patient reports, not a consecutive treated denominator. EADV duplicate and separate 1%+naltrexone report excluded from that count. Nine-patient preprint remains abstract-only and unpooled.
final_shortlist.material_route: Manufactured marketed cream defines a clinical article. Research free base/phosphate are assay routes, not equivalent clinical formulations. Qualified matched vehicle is one option; pragmatic randomized whole-product add-on comparison is a defined alternative.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATP2C1 engineered/organotypic research precedents, with parent identity and assay-stage limits. Optional mechanism work only; immune-free model negativity cannot rule out an inflammatory clinical mechanism.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: AD PK: 479-person 1.5% phaseIII subgroup, mean Css 35.7 nM; maximum-use n=40 mean 104 nM with high-exposure extremes. No HHD PK boundary. 281 nM is a laboratory proxy, not a universal safety threshold; follow current label/combination context.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing composition/formulation claims and branded franchise; current ANDA litigation. KB111 and guselkumab are active distinct HHD programs. Controlled data may be valuable, while a proprietary asset needs a differentiated benefit and executable rights/manufacturing/regulatory route.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Prespecified patient-level clinical estimand with concurrent care/control, masked lesion assessment, meaningful pain/recurrence/rescue/burden interpretation and exposure linked to applied grams, active erosion and healing. No forced withdrawal or automatic new-model gate.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Controlled useful clinical benefit or comparable efficacy with a meaningful burden/tolerability advantage, interpretable exposure and acceptable observed safety; exploratory evidence can justify independent confirmation.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Rule out a meaningful benefit only with an informative design and adequate delivery; redirect measurement/article failures. Stop the proposed product for reproducible unacceptable effective-exposure harm or no differentiated product contribution.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Five-report clinical audit, DERM101 concurrent-control benchmark, mechanistic citation correction, quantitative PK/high-exposure and official-patent audit, current competitors and a staged clinical proof. No new lead counted.

final_shortlist.name: 8015-P2 mitofusin activation for MFN2-CMT2A

alias_search_basis.scope: 622 coverage_records and 30 generated_concepts.proposals in research/portfolio-register.json; supplementary rg across ddiscov_snapshot and round2 files
alias_search_basis.caveat: New to reviewed inventory is not a claim of new invention, patent novelty, biological novelty, or unowned asset.

final_shortlist.exact_entity: The slower-eluting chiral SFC peak 8015-P2 defined in Weigele et al. 2024, with the article/supplement stereochemical and analytical reference; do not substitute parent 8015 mixture, MiM111, Chimera C, or generic piperine.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Exact P2 improves established sensory/motor phenotypes in approximately 50-week-old Mfn2 T105M knock-in mice and rats. The 2026 rat study randomized and blinded testing; dose cohorts contain four rats per dose and seven WT comparators. The 10 mg/kg cohort stopped at four weeks after normal-range values. A separate acute motility assay used 100 mg/kg, not the chronic dose.

biological_sample_counts.2026_rat_dose_response: 4 animals/dose; WT reference 7; counts of other cohorts differ and were not imputed
biological_sample_counts.2024_mouse_exact_P2: Histology 4 mice/group and synapse counts 3/group; functional panel n values reside in the figures and were not independently transcribed
biological_sample_counts.2024_human_8015_mixture: One T105M patient background; independent culture experiments are not donors
biological_sample_counts.2020_human_Chimera_C: Four patient backgrounds; chemically different article
biological_sample_counts.2020_MiM111_mouse: 6 mice/group; sample target reduced from planned 15 because effect was larger than anticipated

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. WO2023196340 includes a displayed granted US family member US12396968B2; ceased PCT status does not establish open rights.
final_shortlist.decision: Continue staged independent exact-compound human-function proof; no S-tier promotion.
final_shortlist.ranking_delta: Retain human-function proof priority with a more concrete first neuronal assay route. No new exact-P2 human functional response was established in round4.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

independent_challenge.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
independent_challenge.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

final_shortlist.model_route: NYSCF/CMTA catalog identifies AG0002-01-MR(MFN2 H361Y),AG0008-01-MR(c.2219G>C; protein annotation needs reconciliation),and AG0015-01-MR(R364W),with iPSC and fibroblast routes. Distribution is request-based; dates are not a stock check. No exact T105M patient stock verified. Each line requires independent neuronal/neuromuscular qualification and isogenic control; engineered T105M is a separate rebuild branch. March2026 CMTA account adds an operating R364W service based on one patient and a healthy comparator. Function means transport/morphology there, not useful nerve-muscle transmission. Do not infer T105M stock from the Summer2024 recruitment table or ready organoid function from a future grant. Round5 adds exact isogenic R94Q methods and a separate patient/isogenic electrical phenotype; choose the function actually impaired and demonstrate delayed modifiability. CMTA/PsychoGenics operating R364W rat service is distinct from unrestricted stock.
final_shortlist.round4_delta: CMTA describes an already-used BrainXell/ANANDA R364W motor-neuron screening assay. This improves a first mechanistic assay route but supplies no exact-P2 response or NMJ-force endpoint. Summer2024 T105M table was a donor wishlist, not inventory. R364W human-harm extrapolation in an older paper was withdrawn by correction.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Staged work queue, not a validated cross-program probability or investment-return ranking.
final_shortlist.round5_delta: Independent isogenic R94Q transport model has no overt patch-clamp deficit at tested age; a separate corrected patient line supplies network-burst phenotype. Operating R364W rat service and model grant support a second-allele challenge. Publisher supplement recovered:75binding+12enzyme/cell rows; MAO-A59% is binding. DMSO matching remains a transfer question.

independent_challenge.finding: Published PBS pH7.4 solubility is0.23 micromolar, versus5 micromolar nominal concentration in the Darier assay (about22-fold). This is a formulation/exposure uncertainty, not proof the assay is invalid or a ceiling on skin exposure.
independent_challenge.biological_failure_mode: Residual SERCA may be inactivated in an established lesion. Junction-assembly protection may not translate to delayed repair.
independent_challenge.comparator: NAC protects mechanical adhesion in the same primary disease model. CDN1163 is a separate same-target comparator; no superiority follows from next-generation wording.

final_shortlist.model_route: Public JCI170739 SERCA2-perturbed keratinocyte model can guide an independently qualified build. Original N/TERT-2G and mutant clones are not verified standard stock. Catalog Ker-CT or primary HEKa/HEKn are alternative parent routes,not validated replicas. ATCC Lei CapCRL-1098 is an archival Mission Collection fibroblast without a public ATP2A2 genotype,not ready patient epidermis. The published Addgene PX458 route has industry-access restrictions; an independently validated commercial RNP implementation is a separate alternative. Existing treated cultures represent three donors and two actuator-domain variants with approximately70% SERCA2 protein. Biopsy-only DD5–7 are not extra efficacy donors. Qualify residual functional target rather than assume every ATP2A2 variant responds.
round4_delta: Both culture variants lie in the SERCA2 actuator domain. Mean protein abundance is about 70% of control; it is not a measured 50%-protein-null model. Calcium imaging in the retrieved section used DD2.
DD5–7 were biopsy immunohistochemistry samples, not additional NDC-treated culture donors.
DD3–4 required Y27632 during maintenance; all DD cultures and CTL1–2 received it for consistency. It was removed 24–36 h before assays, so there is no demonstrated concurrent ROCK-inhibitor confound.

The 2023 healthy-neuron result involved spine-neck morphology at 0.1 µM, with at least 10 neurons / 70 spines from one culture batch. It is not observed skin toxicity; the 2025 intraperitoneal CNS study does not qualify topical exposure.
The Darier paper section titled Solubility assay measures protein detergent solubility, not dissolved NDC-9009.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Staged work queue, not a validated cross-program probability or investment-return ranking.
final_shortlist.round5_delta: Actual CTIS dantrolene results recovered:16oral starters,10paired completers,6nonresponse discontinuations, uncontrolled PGA/DLQI signal, EASI/BSA nonsignificant, retinoid washout/restart and no direct barrier result. Final-submitted PDFs remain draft-labelled. Dantrolene becomes an adult clinical benchmark; it establishes neither topical delivery nor NDC benefit.

final_shortlist.name: Alpha-1-antitrypsin for donor-lung repair during perfusion
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Plasma-derived human AAT; Zemaira is a specified manufactured starting product
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Eight donor-paired human lung experiments show physiological improvement; earlier abstract likely reports the same dataset. Pig ex vivo and recipient-treatment studies support separate claims. Independent2018 mouse transplantation work used active recombinant AAT, a non-inhibitory loop mutant, albumin and PR3/NE-deficient recipients. This strengthens protease-specific causality in cold preservation and does not establish exact warm-human formulation equivalence.
final_shortlist.research_material_route: FDA-approved product route establishes manufacturing precedent, not permission to relabel or evidence of EVLP compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: Declined human donor lungs on paired circuits; actual institutional organ access is not secured in this desktop review.
final_shortlist.exposure_risk: Warm 12-hour recirculation requires activity/stability/adsorption assessment; protein and electrolyte matching can change the apparent benefit.
final_shortlist.public_rights_note: CSL AAT organ-perfusion patent application identified. New value must be a better qualified repair regimen/product, not rediscovery of AAT use.
final_shortlist.next_decision_question: Does qualified dual NE/PR3 activity add durable organ function beyond physically matched perfusate and a simpler NE-selective comparator after washout?
final_shortlist.proposed_advance_condition: AAT supplies persistent useful gas-transfer/compliance benefit at qualified activity and adds value beyond the simpler comparator.
final_shortlist.proposed_stop_condition: Stop the differentiated AAT product thesis if physical matching or the simpler comparator explains the useful effect, or if activity is lost before the intended treatment window.
final_shortlist.decision: small formulation/potency gate before larger organ validation
round3_delta: Patent pilot compares 10 mg/mL AAT with saline; protein/oncotic matching is unestablished.
Current label defines approximately 50 mg/mL reconstitution, mannitol/phosphate excipients, functional elastase-neutralizing potency, and a three-hour postreconstitution use interval.

Calculated contribution from a 50 mg/mL stock at 10 mg/mL final: stock fraction 20%, mannitol approximately 24–34 mM, phosphate 3–4 mM. This is a proposed formulation calculation, not the 2026 paper's recipe.
Canadian trial record last updated July 2026 lists UHN randomized Zemaira lung-transplant prevention trial as not yet recruiting; ex vivo-only route not established by record.
round4_delta: Independent 2018 study compared active recombinant AAT with a non-inhibitory reactive-center mutant and albumin during cold preservation. PR3/NE-null recipients were also protected; this strengthens protease-specific causality.
The inspected cold-storage regimen used 1 mg/mL AAT, 18h storage and 4h recipient reperfusion. This is separate from the warm human EVLP experiment.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Reconcile nominal protein mass, antigen recovery, dual NE/PR3 functional potency and perfusate mass balance during warm recirculation; match electrolytes/excipients/protein. Compare with a simpler NE-selective intervention and require useful recipient-like drug-free reperfusion function. Do not transfer systemic posttransplant evidence to an ex-vivo-only pulse.

final_shortlist.round5_delta: Patent pig experiment reports3mg/mL added AAT versus0.5mg/mL measured antigen; cause unresolved, with electrolyte differences. Additional independent allograft/systemic-recipient evidence is not exact warm-EVLP replication. Separate mass, antigen recovery and functional NE/PR3 activity.

final_shortlist.name: Enasidenib for germline IDH2-R140Q D2HGA2

final_shortlist.priority_scope: Round8 next-action queue; 15/100 planning-effort points
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Enasidenib; mesylate tablet reference and documented pediatric sprinkle use. Intended infant presentation must be specified; historical clinical lot identity with EP4058028B1 is unverified.
final_shortlist.population: Direct human treatment anchor is germline heterozygous IDH2-R140Q. R140G, type-I D2HGDH disease and other IDH2 variants do not inherit efficacy.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: One clear severe-cardiomyopathy trajectory: LVEF 20–25% at entry, 35–40% at six months and 40–45% at eight months with later fluctuation and concurrent care. A second original child had normal baseline systolic function; Gold had milder baseline disease. Biochemical suppression is strong; neurological outcomes are less causally secure.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five outcome case records across three publications; original two and Gold are clearly distinct. Cross-publication linkage of two skin cases is unresolved. Metadata-only five-week-old report adds zero verified outcomes.
final_shortlist.material_route: Defined marketed tablet and research free-base routes; actual studied sprinkle and concrete minitablet patent. Public route and historical use do not establish received lot, present supply or infant administration compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATCC R140Q TF-1/parent route is biochemical, homozygous and cancer-line specific. Endogenous heterozygous mouse and genetic reversibility precedents exist. A new human cardiac model is optional when it discriminates a consequential exposure/function question.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: Current adult PK includes 7.9-day half-life, tenfold accumulation, 29-day steady state, active metabolite, interactions and plausible A3 antagonism. No infant dose rule or lifelong safety boundary. Direct pediatric ALT/CK observations require a coherent longitudinal exposure/laboratory timeline.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing clinical program and published granted pediatric minitablet composition/process claims prevent a first-pediatric-formulation or open-rights claim. Define an improvement in delivery, exposure, burden/tolerability or prospective clinical evidence; standalone value capture remains unresolved.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: One specified pediatric administration/exposure question linked to chiral D-2-HG and a preselected organ-function outcome. Define cardiac, CNS or preventive claim; compare vorasidenib attributes for a CNS product. Clinical evidence and proprietary value remain separate.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Reliable delivery and interpretable exposure/PD plus a useful organ-function or preservation signal justify confirmation; a larger product program requires independently supported clinical benefit and a real product advantage.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Redirect delivery failure or exposure-related harm; narrow tissue/genotype/timing claims when appropriate. Do not reject human observations from an unqualified model. Stop a standalone product thesis if no useful incremental contribution or practicable product route exists.

round4_delta: Both culture variants lie in the SERCA2 actuator domain. Mean protein abundance is about 70% of control; it is not a measured 50%-protein-null model. Calcium imaging in the retrieved section used DD2.

DD3–4 required Y27632 during maintenance; all DD cultures and CTL1–2 received it for consistency. It was removed 24–36 h before assays, so there is no demonstrated concurrent ROCK-inhibitor confound.

The 2023 healthy-neuron result involved spine-neck morphology at 0.1 µM, with at least 10 neurons / 70 spines from one culture batch. It is not observed skin toxicity; the 2025 intraperitoneal CNS study does not qualify topical exposure.
The Darier paper section titled Solubility assay measures protein detergent solubility, not dissolved NDC-9009.

final_shortlist.exact_entity: The slower-eluting chiral SFC peak 8015-P2 defined in Weigele et al. 2024, with the article/supplement stereochemical and analytical reference; do not substitute parent 8015 mixture, MiM111, Chimera C, or generic piperine.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Exact P2 improves established sensory/motor phenotypes in approximately 50-week-old Mfn2 T105M knock-in mice and rats. The 2026 rat study randomized and blinded testing; dose cohorts contain four rats per dose and seven WT comparators. The 10 mg/kg cohort stopped at four weeks after normal-range values. biological_sample_counts.2026_rat_dose_response: 4 animals/dose; WT reference 7; counts of other cohorts differ and were not imputed
biological_sample_counts.2024_mouse_exact_P2: Histology 4 mice/group and synapse counts 3/group; functional panel n values reside in the figures and were not independently transcribed

biological_sample_counts.2020_human_Chimera_C: Four patient backgrounds; chemically different article
biological_sample_counts.2020_MiM111_mouse: 6 mice/group; sample target reduced from planned 15 because effect was larger than anticipated

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. WO2023196340 includes a displayed granted US family member US12396968B2; ceased PCT status does not establish open rights.
final_shortlist.decision: Continue staged independent exact-compound human-function proof; no S-tier promotion.
final_shortlist.ranking_delta: Retain human-function proof priority with a more concrete first neuronal assay route. No new exact-P2 human functional response was established in round4.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

independent_challenge.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
independent_challenge.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

final_shortlist.model_route: NYSCF/CMTA catalog identifies AG0002-01-MR(MFN2 H361Y),AG0008-01-MR(c.2219G>C; protein annotation needs reconciliation),and AG0015-01-MR(R364W),with iPSC and fibroblast routes. Distribution is request-based; dates are not a stock check. No exact T105M patient stock verified. Each line requires independent neuronal/neuromuscular qualification and isogenic control; engineered T105M is a separate rebuild branch. March2026 CMTA account adds an operating R364W service based on one patient and a healthy comparator. Function means transport/morphology there, not useful nerve-muscle transmission. Do not infer T105M stock from the Summer2024 recruitment table or ready organoid function from a future grant. Round5 adds exact isogenic R94Q methods and a separate patient/isogenic electrical phenotype; choose the function actually impaired and demonstrate delayed modifiability. CMTA/PsychoGenics operating R364W rat service is distinct from unrestricted stock.
final_shortlist.round4_delta: CMTA describes an already-used BrainXell/ANANDA R364W motor-neuron screening assay. This improves a first mechanistic assay route but supplies no exact-P2 response or NMJ-force endpoint. Summer2024 T105M table was a donor wishlist, not inventory. R364W human-harm extrapolation in an older paper was withdrawn by correction.

final_shortlist.round5_delta: Independent isogenic R94Q transport model has no overt patch-clamp deficit at tested age; a separate corrected patient line supplies network-burst phenotype. retained_reserves.name: Fluoxetine in KCNC1 gain-of-function disorder
retained_reserves.decision: Conditional clinical-research reserve and methodological benchmark; no S-tier or precision-therapy confirmation.
retained_reserves.deciding_proof: The immediate contribution would be better variant-specific evidence, a credible exposure bridge, or a more selective article. Generic fluoxetine availability does not create exclusivity. First determine whether the claimed channel mechanism is plausible at clinical exposure; then predefine a meaningful developmental outcome, independent masked assessment, stable cointerventions and carryover handling. Reproducible useful function and tolerability advance the clinical-research case. Failure of exposure plausibility stops the *precision Kv3.1* claim even if a nonspecific symptomatic effect remains possible. Persistent trivial/null benefit stops expansion of this product thesis. No automatic treatment-withdrawal requirement is proposed.

retained_reserves.name: Lisdexamfetamine in KCNMA1-N999S PNKD
retained_reserves.decision: Strongest new prospective clinical-evidence question in this set; selected cases and weak exclusive-product contribution remain material.
retained_reserves.deciding_proof: This is the strongest new **clinical-evidence** question in this set: prospectively enroll eligible genotype-defined patients, record nonresponders, independently adjudicate events and quantify interrupted daily activity. Separate attention/mood changes from PNKD benefit and preserve growth, appetite, sleep and cardiovascular tradeoffs. Advance if useful PNKD control generalizes beyond selected responders with acceptable burden. Stop a broad product claim if the effect is confined to selected cases, is only an attention benefit, or requires unacceptable coverage-related harms. The obvious value is evidence and a better coverage/burden solution; no exclusive asset has been identified.

final_shortlist.name: Enasidenib for germline IDH2-R140Q D2HGA2
final_shortlist.decision: Defined clinical development priority: recommend a bounded pediatric article/exposure project linked to prospective organ function.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Round9 next-action queue; 15/100 planning-effort points
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Enasidenib; mesylate tablet reference and documented pediatric sprinkle use. Intended infant presentation must be specified; historical clinical lot identity with EP4058028B1 is unverified.
final_shortlist.population: Direct human treatment anchor is germline heterozygous IDH2-R140Q. R140G, type-I D2HGDH disease and other IDH2 variants do not inherit efficacy.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: One clear severe-cardiomyopathy trajectory: LVEF 20–25% at entry, 35–40% at six months and 40–45% at eight months with later fluctuation and concurrent care. A second original child had normal baseline systolic function; Gold had milder baseline disease. Biochemical suppression is strong; neurological outcomes are less causally secure.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five outcome case records across three publications; original two and Gold are clearly distinct. Cross-publication linkage of two skin cases is unresolved. Metadata-only five-week-old report adds zero verified outcomes.
final_shortlist.material_route: Defined marketed tablet and research free-base routes; actual studied sprinkle and concrete minitablet patent. Public route and historical use do not establish received lot, present supply or infant administration compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATCC R140Q TF-1/parent route is biochemical, homozygous and cancer-line specific. Endogenous heterozygous mouse and genetic reversibility precedents exist. A new human cardiac model is optional when it discriminates a consequential exposure/function question.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: Current adult PK includes 7.9-day half-life, tenfold accumulation, 29-day steady state, active metabolite, interactions and plausible A3 antagonism. No infant dose rule or lifelong safety boundary. Direct pediatric ALT/CK observations require a coherent longitudinal exposure/laboratory timeline.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing clinical program and published granted pediatric minitablet composition/process claims prevent a first-pediatric-formulation or open-rights claim. Define an improvement in delivery, exposure, burden/tolerability or prospective clinical evidence; standalone value capture remains unresolved.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: One specified pediatric administration/exposure question linked to chiral D-2-HG and a preselected organ-function outcome. Define cardiac, CNS or preventive claim; compare vorasidenib attributes for a CNS product. Clinical evidence and proprietary value remain separate.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Reliable delivery and interpretable exposure/PD plus a useful organ-function or preservation signal justify confirmation; a larger product program requires independently supported clinical benefit and a real product advantage.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Redirect delivery failure or exposure-related harm; narrow tissue/genotype/timing claims when appropriate. Do not reject human observations from an unqualified model. Stop a standalone product thesis if no useful incremental contribution or practicable product route exists.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Full clinical lineage and 177-cell laboratory audit; specific public pediatric formulation, adult PK/DDI/A3 and model audit; staged clinical proof with independent challenge. Removed from the reserve list to avoid conflicting current dispositions.
final_shortlist.round8_delta: R140Q-active vorasidenib added as CNS mechanism/exposure comparator; tumor PK is not normal infant-brain exposure or safety superiority. Cardiac treatment, neurological benefit and neonatal prevention split. Existing sprinkle requires a demonstrated new administration/exposure contribution.
round9_delta: A primary TGA2025 assessment adds the active vorasidenib metabolite AGI-69460 exposure issue. A late-cycle mean molar predose metabolite:parent ratio is not a normal infant-brain exposure measure or AUC ratio.

The cited assessment did not establish metabolite animal brain penetration and excluded it from the population PK model; observed adolescent representation was one patient under18. Metabolite R140Q potency and unbound normal-infant-brain exposure remain unresolved.
Retain enasidenib rank2 and15 planning points. Cardiac benefit, neurological treatment and neonatal prevention remain separate; parent-only exposure comparisons cannot establish CNS superiority.

final_shortlist.decision: Defined controlled clinical-proof priority: recommend marketed-article, protocol and measurement qualification followed by a contemporaneously controlled patient-benefit comparison.

final_shortlist.exact_entity: Prospective standardized Opzelura 1.5% cream, 15 mg/g ruxolitinib base equivalent as 19.8 mg/g phosphate. Historical cases verify active/concentration/route, not every brand, vehicle or lot.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Five distinguishable exact-strength case reports support useful local control. Monotherapy-style treatment, add-on induction and topical maintenance are kept separate. No controlled exact-rux HHD effect estimate was verified.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five selected single-patient reports, not a consecutive treated denominator. EADV duplicate and separate 1%+naltrexone report excluded from that count. Nine-patient preprint remains abstract-only and unpooled.
final_shortlist.material_route: Manufactured marketed cream defines a clinical article. Research free base/phosphate are assay routes, not equivalent clinical formulations. Qualified matched vehicle is one option; pragmatic randomized whole-product add-on comparison is a defined alternative.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATP2C1 engineered/organotypic research precedents, with parent identity and assay-stage limits. Optional mechanism work only; immune-free model negativity cannot rule out an inflammatory clinical mechanism.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: AD PK: 479-person 1.5% phaseIII subgroup, mean Css 35.7 nM; maximum-use n=40 mean 104 nM with high-exposure extremes. No HHD PK boundary. 281 nM is a laboratory proxy, not a universal safety threshold; follow current label/combination context.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing composition/formulation claims and branded franchise; current ANDA litigation. KB111 and guselkumab are active distinct HHD programs. Controlled data may be valuable, while a proprietary asset needs a differentiated benefit and executable rights/manufacturing/regulatory route.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Controlled standardized1.5% cream plus protocolized care against the same care; preselected meaningful pain/erosion/rescue/burden outcome, masked assessment, exposure and all-randomized/maintenance denominators. Procedure avoidance requires a relevant sweat-control comparison.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Controlled useful clinical benefit or comparable efficacy with a meaningful burden/tolerability advantage, interpretable exposure and acceptable observed safety; exploratory evidence can justify independent confirmation.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Rule out a meaningful benefit only with an informative design and adequate delivery; redirect measurement/article failures. Stop the proposed product for reproducible unacceptable effective-exposure harm or no differentiated product contribution.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Five-report clinical audit, DERM101 concurrent-control benchmark, mechanistic citation correction, quantitative PK/high-exposure and official-patent audit, current competitors and a staged clinical proof. No new lead counted.
final_shortlist.round8_delta: OnabotulinumtoxinA sweat-control benchmark added. Seven-person randomized study is separate from30-person mixed pilot with26HHD/4Darier and11HHD relapses. Late survivor efficacy is not all-randomized maintenance. Product contribution includes sustained control and lower treatment/rescue burden.
round9_delta: Bounded public-source comparator review found no new verified rank-changing HHD evidence beyond the preserved dossiers. Retain rank3 and10 planning points.
Keep exact1.5% article, concurrent-care comparison, all-randomized and maintenance denominators, exposure and useful pain/erosion/rescue-burden outcomes. No new HHD efficacy observation is claimed.

independent_challenge.finding: Published PBS pH7.4 solubility is0.23 micromolar, versus5 micromolar nominal concentration in the Darier assay (about22-fold). This is a formulation/exposure uncertainty, not proof the assay is invalid or a ceiling on skin exposure.
independent_challenge.biological_failure_mode: Residual SERCA may be inactivated in an established lesion. Junction-assembly protection may not translate to delayed repair.
independent_challenge.comparator: NAC protects mechanical adhesion in the same primary disease model. CDN1163 is a separate same-target comparator; no superiority follows from next-generation wording.

final_shortlist.model_route: Public JCI170739 SERCA2-perturbed keratinocyte model can guide an independently qualified build. Original N/TERT-2G and mutant clones are not verified standard stock. Catalog Ker-CT or primary HEKa/HEKn are alternative parent routes,not validated replicas. ATCC Lei CapCRL-1098 is an archival Mission Collection fibroblast without a public ATP2A2 genotype,not ready patient epidermis. The published Addgene PX458 route has industry-access restrictions; an independently validated commercial RNP implementation is a separate alternative. Existing treated cultures represent three donors and two actuator-domain variants with approximately70% SERCA2 protein. Biopsy-only DD5–7 are not extra efficacy donors. round4_delta: Both culture variants lie in the SERCA2 actuator domain. Mean protein abundance is about 70% of control; it is not a measured 50%-protein-null model. Calcium imaging in the retrieved section used DD2.
DD5–7 were biopsy immunohistochemistry samples, not additional NDC-treated culture donors.
DD3–4 required Y27632 during maintenance; all DD cultures and CTL1–2 received it for consistency. It was removed 24–36 h before assays, so there is no demonstrated concurrent ROCK-inhibitor confound.

The 2023 healthy-neuron result involved spine-neck morphology at 0.1 µM, with at least 10 neurons / 70 spines from one culture batch. It is not observed skin toxicity; the 2025 intraperitoneal CNS study does not qualify topical exposure.
The Darier paper section titled Solubility assay measures protein detergent solubility, not dissolved NDC-9009.

final_shortlist.exact_entity: The slower-eluting chiral SFC peak 8015-P2 defined in Weigele et al. 2024, with the article/supplement stereochemical and analytical reference; do not substitute parent 8015 mixture, MiM111, Chimera C, or generic piperine.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Exact P2 improves established sensory/motor phenotypes in approximately 50-week-old Mfn2 T105M knock-in mice and rats. The 2026 rat study randomized and blinded testing; dose cohorts contain four rats per dose and seven WT comparators. The 10 mg/kg cohort stopped at four weeks after normal-range values. A separate acute motility assay used 100 mg/kg, not the chronic dose.

biological_sample_counts.2026_rat_dose_response: 4 animals/dose; WT reference 7; counts of other cohorts differ and were not imputed
biological_sample_counts.2024_mouse_exact_P2: Histology 4 mice/group and synapse counts 3/group; functional panel n values reside in the figures and were not independently transcribed
biological_sample_counts.2024_human_8015_mixture: One T105M patient background; independent culture experiments are not donors
biological_sample_counts.2020_human_Chimera_C: Four patient backgrounds; chemically different article
biological_sample_counts.2020_MiM111_mouse: 6 mice/group; sample target reduced from planned 15 because effect was larger than anticipated

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. WO2023196340 includes a displayed granted US family member US12396968B2; ceased PCT status does not establish open rights.
final_shortlist.decision: Continue staged independent exact-compound human-function proof; no S-tier promotion.
final_shortlist.ranking_delta: Retain human-function proof priority with a more concrete first neuronal assay route. No new exact-P2 human functional response was established in round4.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

independent_challenge.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
independent_challenge.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

final_shortlist.model_route: NYSCF/CMTA catalog identifies AG0002-01-MR(MFN2 H361Y),AG0008-01-MR(c.2219G>C; protein annotation needs reconciliation),and AG0015-01-MR(R364W),with iPSC and fibroblast routes. Distribution is request-based; dates are not a stock check. No exact T105M patient stock verified. Each line requires independent neuronal/neuromuscular qualification and isogenic control; engineered T105M is a separate rebuild branch. March2026 CMTA account adds an operating R364W service based on one patient and a healthy comparator. Function means transport/morphology there, not useful nerve-muscle transmission. Do not infer T105M stock from the Summer2024 recruitment table or ready organoid function from a future grant. Round5 adds exact isogenic R94Q methods and a separate patient/isogenic electrical phenotype; choose the function actually impaired and demonstrate delayed modifiability. CMTA/PsychoGenics operating R364W rat service is distinct from unrestricted stock.
final_shortlist.round4_delta: CMTA describes an already-used BrainXell/ANANDA R364W motor-neuron screening assay. This improves a first mechanistic assay route but supplies no exact-P2 response or NMJ-force endpoint. Summer2024 T105M table was a donor wishlist, not inventory. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.

final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

retained_reserves.name: Fluoxetine in KCNC1 gain-of-function disorder
retained_reserves.decision: Conditional clinical-research reserve and methodological benchmark; no S-tier or precision-therapy confirmation.
retained_reserves.deciding_proof: The immediate contribution would be better variant-specific evidence, a credible exposure bridge, or a more selective article. Generic fluoxetine availability does not create exclusivity. First determine whether the claimed channel mechanism is plausible at clinical exposure; then predefine a meaningful developmental outcome, independent masked assessment, stable cointerventions and carryover handling. Reproducible useful function and tolerability advance the clinical-research case. Failure of exposure plausibility stops the *precision Kv3.1* claim even if a nonspecific symptomatic effect remains possible. Persistent trivial/null benefit stops expansion of this product thesis. No automatic treatment-withdrawal requirement is proposed.

final_shortlist.name: Selective PIK3C2B inhibition for MTM1 myotubular myopathy

final_shortlist.proposed_stop_condition: Wrong lot/model/measurement redirects qualification. Upper95% bound<M supports model-specific futility only with adequate target perturbation, exposure and delayed modifiability. final_shortlist.name: Enasidenib for germline IDH2-R140Q D2HGA2
final_shortlist.decision: Defined clinical development priority: recommend a bounded pediatric article/exposure project linked to prospective organ function.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Round10 next-action queue; 15/100 planning-effort points, not success probability or money
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Enasidenib; mesylate tablet reference and documented pediatric sprinkle use. Intended infant presentation must be specified; historical clinical lot identity with EP4058028B1 is unverified.
final_shortlist.population: Direct human treatment anchor is germline heterozygous IDH2-R140Q. R140G, type-I D2HGDH disease and other IDH2 variants do not inherit efficacy.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: One clear severe-cardiomyopathy trajectory: LVEF 20–25% at entry, 35–40% at six months and 40–45% at eight months with later fluctuation and concurrent care. A second original child had normal baseline systolic function; Gold had milder baseline disease. Biochemical suppression is strong; neurological outcomes are less causally secure.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five outcome case records across three publications; original two and Gold are clearly distinct. Cross-publication linkage of two skin cases is unresolved. Metadata-only five-week-old report adds zero verified outcomes.
final_shortlist.material_route: Defined marketed tablet and research free-base routes; actual studied sprinkle and concrete minitablet patent. Public route and historical use do not establish received lot, present supply or infant administration compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATCC R140Q TF-1/parent route is biochemical, homozygous and cancer-line specific. Endogenous heterozygous mouse and genetic reversibility precedents exist. A new human cardiac model is optional when it discriminates a consequential exposure/function question.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: Current adult PK includes 7.9-day half-life, tenfold accumulation, 29-day steady state, active metabolite, interactions and plausible A3 antagonism. No infant dose rule or lifelong safety boundary. Direct pediatric ALT/CK observations require a coherent longitudinal exposure/laboratory timeline.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing clinical program and published granted pediatric minitablet composition/process claims prevent a first-pediatric-formulation or open-rights claim. Define an improvement in delivery, exposure, burden/tolerability or prospective clinical evidence; standalone value capture remains unresolved.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: One specified pediatric administration/exposure question linked to chiral D-2-HG and a preselected organ-function outcome. Define cardiac, CNS or preventive claim; compare vorasidenib attributes for a CNS product. Clinical evidence and proprietary value remain separate.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Reliable delivery and interpretable exposure/PD plus a useful organ-function or preservation signal justify confirmation; a larger product program requires independently supported clinical benefit and a real product advantage.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Redirect delivery failure or exposure-related harm; narrow tissue/genotype/timing claims when appropriate. Do not reject human observations from an unqualified model. Stop a standalone product thesis if no useful incremental contribution or practicable product route exists.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Full clinical lineage and 177-cell laboratory audit; specific public pediatric formulation, adult PK/DDI/A3 and model audit; staged clinical proof with independent challenge. Removed from the reserve list to avoid conflicting current dispositions.
final_shortlist.round8_delta: R140Q-active vorasidenib added as CNS mechanism/exposure comparator; tumor PK is not normal infant-brain exposure or safety superiority. Cardiac treatment, neurological benefit and neonatal prevention split. Existing sprinkle requires a demonstrated new administration/exposure contribution.

final_shortlist.name: Ruxolitinib 1.5% cream for refractory Hailey–Hailey disease
final_shortlist.decision: Defined controlled clinical-proof priority: recommend marketed-article, protocol and measurement qualification followed by a contemporaneously controlled patient-benefit comparison.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Round10 next-action queue; 10/100 planning-effort points, not success probability or money
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Prospective standardized Opzelura 1.5% cream, 15 mg/g ruxolitinib base equivalent as 19.8 mg/g phosphate. Historical cases verify active/concentration/route, not every brand, vehicle or lot.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Five distinguishable exact-strength case reports support useful local control. Monotherapy-style treatment, add-on induction and topical maintenance are kept separate. No controlled exact-rux HHD effect estimate was verified.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five selected single-patient reports, not a consecutive treated denominator. EADV duplicate and separate 1%+naltrexone report excluded from that count. Nine-patient preprint remains abstract-only and unpooled.
final_shortlist.material_route: Manufactured marketed cream defines a clinical article. Research free base/phosphate are assay routes, not equivalent clinical formulations. Qualified matched vehicle is one option; pragmatic randomized whole-product add-on comparison is a defined alternative.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATP2C1 engineered/organotypic research precedents, with parent identity and assay-stage limits. Optional mechanism work only; immune-free model negativity cannot rule out an inflammatory clinical mechanism.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: AD PK: 479-person 1.5% phaseIII subgroup, mean Css 35.7 nM; maximum-use n=40 mean 104 nM with high-exposure extremes. No HHD PK boundary. 281 nM is a laboratory proxy, not a universal safety threshold; follow current label/combination context.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing composition/formulation claims and branded franchise; current ANDA litigation. KB111 and guselkumab are active distinct HHD programs. Controlled data may be valuable, while a proprietary asset needs a differentiated benefit and executable rights/manufacturing/regulatory route.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Controlled standardized1.5% cream plus protocolized care against the same care; preselected meaningful pain/erosion/rescue/burden outcome, masked assessment, exposure and all-randomized/maintenance denominators. final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.

Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.

final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

Four isolates represent three donors: DD1/DD2 same p.Asn39Asp donor; DD3/DD4 two p.Gln177Pro donors. Three experimental repeats are not three independent patient cohorts. Treat a qualified established, stable or predictable mature adhesion/permeability deficit, with donor structure, healthy-tissue effects and withdrawal/stress function preserved. Compare dantrolene and practical current care where the model can capture each mechanism. Require useful repair and a local/systemic window, not calcium-switch assembly or marker shifts.

final_shortlist.stop: Only junction assembly/prophylaxis improves, formulation or irritation explains the apparent effect, drug cannot be delivered to viable epidermis at active exposure, or simpler comparator performs as well without a meaningful product advantage.
final_shortlist.material_route: Public synthesis and analytical characterization; no batch acquired/authenticated. Published neurobiology studies used Neurodon-sourced material. Public synthesis provides a research route independent of contacting that company.
final_shortlist.exposure_gap: 5 µM nominal cell-medium concentration is not free epidermal exposure. No matched skin PK or quantitative SERCA healthy-skin window recovered.

final_shortlist.functional_evidence: 2026 patient keratinocyte dispase mechanical-adhesion rescue with 5 µM NDC-9009 during a 4-hour calcium switch. final_shortlist.stop_condition: Only junction assembly/prophylaxis improves, formulation or irritation explains the apparent effect, drug cannot be delivered to viable epidermis at active exposure, or simpler comparator performs as well without a meaningful product advantage.

Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.

final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.

final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.
