final_shortlist.name: Enasidenib for germline IDH2-R140Q D2HGA2
final_shortlist.decision: Defined clinical development priority: recommend a bounded pediatric article/exposure project linked to prospective organ function.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Round10 next-action queue; 15/100 planning-effort points, not success probability or money
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Enasidenib; mesylate tablet reference and documented pediatric sprinkle use. Intended infant presentation must be specified; historical clinical lot identity with EP4058028B1 is unverified.
final_shortlist.population: Direct human treatment anchor is germline heterozygous IDH2-R140Q. R140G, type-I D2HGDH disease and other IDH2 variants do not inherit efficacy.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: One clear severe-cardiomyopathy trajectory: LVEF 20–25% at entry, 35–40% at six months and 40–45% at eight months with later fluctuation and concurrent care. A second original child had normal baseline systolic function; Gold had milder baseline disease. Biochemical suppression is strong; neurological outcomes are less causally secure.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five outcome case records across three publications; original two and Gold are clearly distinct. Cross-publication linkage of two skin cases is unresolved. Metadata-only five-week-old report adds zero verified outcomes.
final_shortlist.material_route: Defined marketed tablet and research free-base routes; actual studied sprinkle and concrete minitablet patent. Public route and historical use do not establish received lot, present supply or infant administration compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATCC R140Q TF-1/parent route is biochemical, homozygous and cancer-line specific. Endogenous heterozygous mouse and genetic reversibility precedents exist. A new human cardiac model is optional when it discriminates a consequential exposure/function question.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: Current adult PK includes 7.9-day half-life, tenfold accumulation, 29-day steady state, active metabolite, interactions and plausible A3 antagonism. No infant dose rule or lifelong safety boundary. Direct pediatric ALT/CK observations require a coherent longitudinal exposure/laboratory timeline.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing clinical program and published granted pediatric minitablet composition/process claims prevent a first-pediatric-formulation or open-rights claim. Define an improvement in delivery, exposure, burden/tolerability or prospective clinical evidence; standalone value capture remains unresolved.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: One specified pediatric administration/exposure question linked to chiral D-2-HG and a preselected organ-function outcome. Define cardiac, CNS or preventive claim; compare vorasidenib attributes for a CNS product. Clinical evidence and proprietary value remain separate.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Reliable delivery and interpretable exposure/PD plus a useful organ-function or preservation signal justify confirmation; a larger product program requires independently supported clinical benefit and a real product advantage.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Redirect delivery failure or exposure-related harm; narrow tissue/genotype/timing claims when appropriate. Do not reject human observations from an unqualified model. Stop a standalone product thesis if no useful incremental contribution or practicable product route exists.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Full clinical lineage and 177-cell laboratory audit; specific public pediatric formulation, adult PK/DDI/A3 and model audit; staged clinical proof with independent challenge. Removed from the reserve list to avoid conflicting current dispositions.
final_shortlist.round8_delta: R140Q-active vorasidenib added as CNS mechanism/exposure comparator; tumor PK is not normal infant-brain exposure or safety superiority. Cardiac treatment, neurological benefit and neonatal prevention split. Existing sprinkle requires a demonstrated new administration/exposure contribution.
round9_delta: A primary TGA2025 assessment adds the active vorasidenib metabolite AGI-69460 exposure issue. A late-cycle mean molar predose metabolite:parent ratio is not a normal infant-brain exposure measure or AUC ratio.

The cited assessment did not establish metabolite animal brain penetration and excluded it from the population PK model; observed adolescent representation was one patient under18. Metabolite R140Q potency and unbound normal-infant-brain exposure remain unresolved.
Retain enasidenib rank2 and15 planning points. Cardiac benefit, neurological treatment and neonatal prevention remain separate; parent-only exposure comparisons cannot establish CNS superiority.
round10_delta: Correct the inherited blanket AGI-17011 absence statement: EMA p18 conflicts with clinical pp33-34 and 46, which report M2/AGI-17011 as a minor human plasma metabolite at 0.3% of single-dose circulating radioactivity exposure. Chronic pediatric contribution remains unknown.

The43-row ledger preserves analyte, exact assay/variant, formulation, age/species, compartment, bound/free basis, timing, statistic and denominator. Adult repeated-dose exposure and in-vitro binding arithmetic do not establish infant organ exposure.
FDA vorasidenib Table 21 reverses tumor:Cavg dose assignments relative to adjacent prose. Preserve the source conflict. PMDA AGI-69460 R172K activity does not supply R140Q potency.
Close CNS superiority as not identifiable from the bounded public evidence; retain 15 points and the separate cardiac question. No new D2HGA2 clinical outcome or infant dose established.

final_shortlist.name: Ruxolitinib 1.5% cream for refractory Hailey–Hailey disease
final_shortlist.decision: Defined controlled clinical-proof priority: recommend marketed-article, protocol and measurement qualification followed by a contemporaneously controlled patient-benefit comparison.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Round 13 next-action queue; 10/100 planning-effort points, not success probability or money
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Prospective standardized Opzelura 1.5% cream, 15 mg/g ruxolitinib base equivalent as 19.8 mg/g phosphate. Historical cases verify active/concentration/route, not every brand, vehicle or lot.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Five distinguishable exact-strength case reports support useful local control. Monotherapy-style treatment, add-on induction and topical maintenance are kept separate. No controlled exact-rux HHD effect estimate was verified.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five selected single-patient reports, not a consecutive treated denominator. EADV duplicate and separate 1%+naltrexone report excluded from that count. Nine-patient preprint remains abstract-only and unpooled.
final_shortlist.material_route: Manufactured marketed cream defines a clinical article. Research free base/phosphate are assay routes, not equivalent clinical formulations. Qualified matched vehicle is one option; pragmatic randomized whole-product add-on comparison is a defined alternative.
final_shortlist.model_route: Gupta final-publication author manuscript reports an ATP2C1 engineered N/TERT-2G model with a mechanical-attachment deficit, a second heterozygous clone and culture-level replication clarification. Only weak CDN1163 attachment improvement is reported; S1/S4 panels, quantitative rescue and exact clone alleles remain unverified. Parent naming/authentication and endpoint-specific comparator limits persist. Optional mechanism work only; immune-free negativity cannot rule out an inflammatory clinical mechanism.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: AD PK: 479-person 1.5% phaseIII subgroup, mean Css 35.7 nM; maximum-use n=40 mean 104 nM with high-exposure extremes. No HHD PK boundary. 281 nM is a laboratory proxy, not a universal safety threshold; follow current label/combination context.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing composition/formulation claims and branded franchise; current ANDA litigation. KB111 and guselkumab are active distinct HHD programs. Controlled data may be valuable, while a proprietary asset needs a differentiated benefit and executable rights/manufacturing/regulatory route.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Controlled standardized1.5% cream plus protocolized care against the same care; preselected meaningful pain/erosion/rescue/burden outcome, masked assessment, exposure and all-randomized/maintenance denominators. Procedure avoidance requires a relevant sweat-control comparison.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Controlled useful clinical benefit or comparable efficacy with a meaningful burden/tolerability advantage, interpretable exposure and acceptable observed safety; exploratory evidence can justify independent confirmation.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Rule out a meaningful benefit only with an informative design and adequate delivery; redirect measurement/article failures. Stop the proposed product for reproducible unacceptable effective-exposure harm or no differentiated product contribution.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Five-report clinical audit, DERM101 concurrent-control benchmark, mechanistic citation correction, quantitative PK/high-exposure and official-patent audit, current competitors and a staged clinical proof. No new lead counted.
final_shortlist.round8_delta: OnabotulinumtoxinA sweat-control benchmark added. Seven-person randomized study is separate from30-person mixed pilot with26HHD/4Darier and11HHD relapses. Late survivor efficacy is not all-randomized maintenance. Product contribution includes sustained control and lower treatment/rescue burden.
round9_delta: Bounded public-source comparator review found no new verified rank-changing HHD evidence beyond the preserved dossiers. Retain rank3 and10 planning points.
Keep exact1.5% article, concurrent-care comparison, all-randomized and maintenance denominators, exposure and useful pain/erosion/rescue-burden outcomes. No new HHD efficacy observation is claimed.
round10_delta: Four selected naltrexone case records across two primary reports add a documented active-care option for the HHD comparison. Cointerventions, author-estimated outcomes, recurrence and related presentation deduplication remain explicit.
This is not new ruxolitinib efficacy, an all-treated naltrexone response rate, a head-to-head comparison or a validated dose-escalation regimen.

Retain 10 points and the existing proof recommendation. Make the vehicle/add-on/replacement claim explicit, and preserve background care, useful control, pain, rescue burden and all-randomized maintenance denominators. The9-patient preprint remains abstract-level.
round13_delta: Newly read final-publication author manuscript adds a mechanical attachment assay and reports baseline fragility and only weak CDN1163 attachment improvement. Record this as a main-text author report; S4 panels, exact comparisons, effect sizes and replicate denominators remain uninspected.

A second heterozygous clone and a revised independent-culture replication description strengthen specified baseline model evidence. Cells, cultures, clones and patient backgrounds remain separate; no replication of every drug-rescue endpoint or independent study is inferred.

N/TERT-2G and baricitinib during clone generation were already present in the preprint. Correct extraction without claiming new biology, authenticating a stock or inferring ongoing JAK inhibition. Preserve N/TERT/Ker-CT and source figure/text ambiguities.

CDN1163 remains an endpoint-limited modifiability reference, not a qualified complete-barrier or reliable cohesion-rescue positive control. Treatment before detachment challenge and genetic rescue before replating do not establish delayed repair after tissue failure. Weak reported improvement is not zero effect.

Retain rank 3, 10 planning points and the controlled clinical-proof priority. The immune-free model stays optional and cannot veto an inflammation-mediated clinical benefit. Close the current supplement retrieval pass until new primary access or interpretable endpoint-specific evidence is available.

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.

Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.

final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

policy.decision_unit: Exact product in a defined disease, route and treatment window, paired with a stage-appropriate decision-changing preclinical or clinical proof.
policy.ranking: Rank the expected value of the next proof. Do not inherit priority from recency, number of mentions, an A label, a patent listing or supplier availability.
evidence_rules: Keep exact chemical/sequence identity, formulation, route, genotype, model maturity and timing attached to every claim.

Identify the independently assigned treatment unit: independently treated tissues can be exposure units. Preserve donor generality and independent-batch structure. Repeated twitches, images and time points are nested observations, not extra subjects.
Deduplicate abstracts, articles, patents and follow-up analyses reporting the same underlying dataset.
Require direct useful function after disease establishment; distinguish prevention, markers and surrogate mechanics.
Use the strongest practical active comparator and measure exposure; failure against vehicle is not the only possible failure.
Test combinations factorially and require added value over the best single component.
Update related candidates when a relevant current clinical or functional negative result appears; retain model/indication distinctions.
Have an independent reviewer seek a decisive disconfirming explanation before top-priority promotion.
A changed analog, stereoisomer, sequence or salt inherits a hypothesis, not the prior article efficacy claim.
Preservation and prevention can be valuable but do not count as demonstrated delayed reversal.
A positive functional result is scored against the strongest current public comparator; later primary negatives remain attached to the record.
An inaccessible full method remains explicitly unverified; secondary commentary cannot fill a primary donor count or dose.
Classify source purpose before inferring availability: recruitment wishlist, planned grant, service, catalog and received lot are distinct.
Use primary corrections and dated investigator/sponsor updates alongside registry labels; completed does not mean successful.
A late-start response at an assay ceiling is not equivalence, full force restoration or durable reversal.
Record conflicts in source regimens, units and cohort linkage rather than silently selecting the favorable interpretation.
Prior genetic correction establishes disease causality; require a post-deficit functional positive control before a qualified delayed-treatment target rejection.
Permit a predictable developmental trajectory with contemporaneous controls and baseline adjustment; distinguish compensation, preservation and mature reversal.
Prespecify both minimum useful effect and assay repeatability; do not equate an imprecise interval crossing the useful threshold with established futility.
Equal-free-concentration cultures characterize intrinsic sensitivity; connect effective exposure to measured or bounded relevant-tissue distribution before asserting a systemic window.
Keep bottle identity, nominal dose, time-varying species, metabolites, salt/congener composition and clinical combination identity distinct.
Track insufficient-response discontinuations, changing denominators and background-treatment changes; a completer estimate is not an all-treated causal response.
Read actual public result documents before using trial status; retain final-submitted versus internally draft-labelled and peer-reviewed status.
A binding-panel percentage is not catalytic inhibition or functional ion-current activity; nominal cross-assay dose ratios are not universal selectivity.
Stage the funding decision: one qualified starting background can justify an exploratory signal; independent backgrounds and fuller exposure belong to confirmation.
Useful ongoing control, developmental preservation and comparable efficacy with meaningful burden/tolerability benefit are legitimate intended product outcomes.
Existing programs and generic ingredients require a clear incremental contribution; they do not automatically erase the value of a bounded scientific project.
End repeated desktop review when a finite next qualification decision is supported; reopen for evidence likely to change that decision.
Existing exact-disease human evidence can justify article/exposure or controlled-clinical qualification without a mandatory new cell/animal rescue experiment.
A marketed concentration does not authenticate every historical brand, vehicle or lot; standardized prospective article identity remains explicit.
For fluctuating disease, retain a concurrent counterfactual, rescue/background-treatment handling and patient-level denominators, including responder-enriched maintenance.
Characterize observed exposure and tolerability within the studied population/follow-up; do not promote assay IC50 references or small-cohort experience to validated long-term safety limits.
Label numbers as published observations, formula-derived references, proposed engineering limits or calibration-dependent unknowns. Lock thresholds before treatment decoding.
A nonisogenic reference gap is not a genetically established rescuable deficit. Confirm narrow first-background benefit before conditionally extending generality.
Unknown provenance and denominators cannot pass a decision gate. Bounded target downgrade must not emit a universal target-rejection claim.
Apply product contribution and public-rights criteria symmetrically to BLU, branded products and generics; no owner-response scientific-selection gate.
policy.no_contact_gate: Unknown commercial terms do not block public scientific selection. Identify known claims, testable routes and remaining uncertainty without substituting an owner reply for a scientific decision.
proof_gate: demonstrated post-deficit modifiability before a negative reversal-target inference
prespecified useful-effect threshold and biological-unit uncertainty
S_tier_criteria: large useful functional restoration, preservation or ongoing control in the intended disease claim
orthogonal or independent support
reproducible material and feasible exposure
credible differentiation from the current comparator
no unresolved fatal safety signal at the required exposure
a compelling next development milestone with plausible value capture
policy.S_tier_result: No S-tier promotion. BLU has a defined qualification work order; enasidenib and ruxolitinib retain finite clinical-development priorities. Four new exact uses and two existing-use updates do not establish a new exclusive drug asset.
policy.S_tier_note: S is a decision standard, not a quota, probability estimate, prediction of investor interest, or guarantee of clinical success.
policy.fundability_definition: Evaluate the next stage separately: defined article, plausible model/clinical route, rationale, finite decision-changing output and explicit advance/redirect/stop branches can justify initial qualification. Confirmation and a larger asset investment require progressively stronger useful function, relevant exposure, differentiation and value capture. Do not require the proposed experiment result before funding its qualification. Clinical evidence-generation is labeled honestly when a standalone product contribution/value-capture route is not established; it must not silently replace the intended drug-development objective.

final_shortlist.functional_evidence: One clear severe-cardiomyopathy trajectory: LVEF 20–25% at entry, 35–40% at six months and 40–45% at eight months with later fluctuation and concurrent care. final_shortlist.model_route: ATCC R140Q TF-1/parent route is biochemical, homozygous and cancer-line specific. Endogenous heterozygous mouse and genetic reversibility precedents exist. A new human cardiac model is optional when it discriminates a consequential exposure/function question.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: Current adult PK includes 7.9-day half-life, tenfold accumulation, 29-day steady state, active metabolite, interactions and plausible A3 antagonism. No infant dose rule or lifelong safety boundary. Direct pediatric ALT/CK observations require a coherent longitudinal exposure/laboratory timeline.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing clinical program and published granted pediatric minitablet composition/process claims prevent a first-pediatric-formulation or open-rights claim. Define an improvement in delivery, exposure, burden/tolerability or prospective clinical evidence; standalone value capture remains unresolved.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: One specified pediatric administration/exposure question linked to chiral D-2-HG and a preselected organ-function outcome. Define cardiac, CNS or preventive claim; compare vorasidenib attributes for a CNS product. Clinical evidence and proprietary value remain separate.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Reliable delivery and interpretable exposure/PD plus a useful organ-function or preservation signal justify confirmation; a larger product program requires independently supported clinical benefit and a real product advantage.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Redirect delivery failure or exposure-related harm; narrow tissue/genotype/timing claims when appropriate. Do not reject human observations from an unqualified model. Stop a standalone product thesis if no useful incremental contribution or practicable product route exists.

final_shortlist.name: Ruxolitinib 1.5% cream for refractory Hailey–Hailey disease

final_shortlist.exact_entity: Prospective standardized Opzelura 1.5% cream, 15 mg/g ruxolitinib base equivalent as 19.8 mg/g phosphate. Historical cases verify active/concentration/route, not every brand, vehicle or lot.

final_shortlist.material_route: Manufactured marketed cream defines a clinical article. Research free base/phosphate are assay routes, not equivalent clinical formulations. Qualified matched vehicle is one option; pragmatic randomized whole-product add-on comparison is a defined alternative.
final_shortlist.model_route: Gupta final-publication author manuscript reports an ATP2C1 engineered N/TERT-2G model with a mechanical-attachment deficit, a second heterozygous clone and culture-level replication clarification. Only weak CDN1163 attachment improvement is reported; S1/S4 panels, quantitative rescue and exact clone alleles remain unverified. final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Controlled standardized1.5% cream plus protocolized care against the same care; preselected meaningful pain/erosion/rescue/burden outcome, masked assessment, exposure and all-randomized/maintenance denominators. final_shortlist.advance_condition: Controlled useful clinical benefit or comparable efficacy with a meaningful burden/tolerability advantage, interpretable exposure and acceptable observed safety; exploratory evidence can justify independent confirmation.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Rule out a meaningful benefit only with an informative design and adequate delivery; redirect measurement/article failures. Stop the proposed product for reproducible unacceptable effective-exposure harm or no differentiated product contribution.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Five-report clinical audit, DERM101 concurrent-control benchmark, mechanistic citation correction, quantitative PK/high-exposure and official-patent audit, current competitors and a staged clinical proof. No new lead counted.

round10_delta: Four selected naltrexone case records across two primary reports add a documented active-care option for the HHD comparison. Cointerventions, author-estimated outcomes, recurrence and related presentation deduplication remain explicit.

round13_delta: Newly read final-publication author manuscript adds a mechanical attachment assay and reports baseline fragility and only weak CDN1163 attachment improvement. round14_delta: Recovered complete official NCT05635838 results and the visible official SAP. One randomized HS cohort has 34/35 controlled-period starters, 24/32 completers and 10/3 noncompleters. final_shortlist.exact_entity: The slower-eluting chiral SFC peak 8015-P2 defined in Weigele et al. 2024, with the article/supplement stereochemical and analytical reference; do not substitute parent 8015 mixture, MiM111, Chimera C, or generic piperine.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Exact P2 improves established sensory/motor phenotypes in approximately 50-week-old Mfn2 T105M knock-in mice and rats. The 2026 rat study randomized and blinded testing; dose cohorts contain four rats per dose and seven WT comparators. The 10 mg/kg cohort stopped at four weeks after normal-range values. biological_sample_counts.2026_rat_dose_response: 4 animals/dose; WT reference 7; counts of other cohorts differ and were not imputed

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. WO2023196340 includes a displayed granted US family member US12396968B2; ceased PCT status does not establish open rights.
final_shortlist.decision: Continue staged independent exact-compound human-function proof; no S-tier promotion.
final_shortlist.ranking_delta: Retain human-function proof priority with a more concrete first neuronal assay route. No new exact-P2 human functional response was established in round4.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

independent_challenge.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
independent_challenge.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

Each line requires independent neuronal/neuromuscular qualification and isogenic control; engineered T105M is a separate rebuild branch. policy.decision_unit: Exact product in a defined disease, route and treatment window, paired with a stage-appropriate decision-changing preclinical or clinical proof.
policy.ranking: Select the expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar from feasible tranches, including stop or defer, using remaining costs, time, decision-changing information and capturable value. Do not inherit priority from sunk effort or historical allocation. Qualitative comparisons must not masquerade as numerical financial rankings when inputs are missing.
evidence_rules: Keep exact chemical/sequence identity, formulation, route, genotype, model maturity and timing attached to every claim.

Identify the independently assigned treatment unit: independently treated tissues can be exposure units. Preserve donor generality and independent-batch structure. Repeated twitches, images and time points are nested observations, not extra subjects.
Deduplicate abstracts, articles, patents and follow-up analyses reporting the same underlying dataset.
Require direct useful function after disease establishment; distinguish prevention, markers and surrogate mechanics.
Use the strongest practical active comparator and measure exposure; failure against vehicle is not the only possible failure.
Test combinations factorially and require added value over the best single component.
Update related candidates when a relevant current clinical or functional negative result appears; retain model/indication distinctions.
Have an independent reviewer seek a decisive disconfirming explanation before top-priority promotion.
A changed analog, stereoisomer, sequence or salt inherits a hypothesis, not the prior article efficacy claim.
Preservation and prevention can be valuable but do not count as demonstrated delayed reversal.
A positive functional result is scored against the strongest current public comparator; later primary negatives remain attached to the record.
An inaccessible full method remains explicitly unverified; secondary commentary cannot fill a primary donor count or dose.
Classify source purpose before inferring availability: recruitment wishlist, planned grant, service, catalog and received lot are distinct.
Use primary corrections and dated investigator/sponsor updates alongside registry labels; completed does not mean successful.
A late-start response at an assay ceiling is not equivalence, full force restoration or durable reversal.
Record conflicts in source regimens, units and cohort linkage rather than silently selecting the favorable interpretation.
Prior genetic correction establishes disease causality; require a post-deficit functional positive control before a qualified delayed-treatment target rejection.
Permit a predictable developmental trajectory with contemporaneous controls and baseline adjustment; distinguish compensation, preservation and mature reversal.
Prespecify both minimum useful effect and assay repeatability; do not equate an imprecise interval crossing the useful threshold with established futility.
Equal-free-concentration cultures characterize intrinsic sensitivity; connect effective exposure to measured or bounded relevant-tissue distribution before asserting a systemic window.
Keep bottle identity, nominal dose, time-varying species, metabolites, salt/congener composition and clinical combination identity distinct.
Track insufficient-response discontinuations, changing denominators and background-treatment changes; a completer estimate is not an all-treated causal response.
Read actual public result documents before using trial status; retain final-submitted versus internally draft-labelled and peer-reviewed status.
A binding-panel percentage is not catalytic inhibition or functional ion-current activity; nominal cross-assay dose ratios are not universal selectivity.
Stage the funding decision: one qualified starting background can justify an exploratory signal; independent backgrounds and fuller exposure belong to confirmation.
Useful ongoing control, developmental preservation and comparable efficacy with meaningful burden/tolerability benefit are legitimate intended product outcomes.
Existing programs and generic ingredients require a clear incremental contribution; they do not automatically erase the value of a bounded scientific project.
End repeated desktop review when a finite next qualification decision is supported; reopen for evidence likely to change that decision.
Existing exact-disease human evidence can justify article/exposure or controlled-clinical qualification without a mandatory new cell/animal rescue experiment.
A marketed concentration does not authenticate every historical brand, vehicle or lot; standardized prospective article identity remains explicit.
For fluctuating disease, retain a concurrent counterfactual, rescue/background-treatment handling and patient-level denominators, including responder-enriched maintenance.
Characterize observed exposure and tolerability within the studied population/follow-up; do not promote assay IC50 references or small-cohort experience to validated long-term safety limits.
Label numbers as published observations, formula-derived references, proposed engineering limits or calibration-dependent unknowns. Lock thresholds before treatment decoding.
A nonisogenic reference gap is not a genetically established rescuable deficit. Confirm narrow first-background benefit before conditionally extending generality.
Unknown provenance and denominators cannot pass a decision gate. Bounded target downgrade must not emit a universal target-rejection claim.
Apply product contribution and public-rights criteria symmetrically to BLU, branded products and generics; no owner-response scientific-selection gate.
An absent public qualification report is not an observed incumbent failure or demonstrated unmet formulation need.
A first new-indication development contribution can use an adequate existing article; a novel formulation is not a universal prerequisite for useful development or capture.
Evaluate regulatory incentives against the exact product and current law; designation, approval, award, rights, competition and revenue remain separate.
Preserve the option to stop, defer or redirect; do not require a fresh numerical allocation when costs, time and capture inputs are unknown.
policy.no_contact_gate: Unknown commercial terms do not block public scientific selection. Identify known claims, testable routes and remaining uncertainty without substituting an owner reply for a scientific decision.
proof_gate: demonstrated post-deficit modifiability before a negative reversal-target inference
prespecified useful-effect threshold and biological-unit uncertainty
S_tier_criteria: large useful functional restoration, preservation or ongoing control in the intended disease claim
orthogonal or independent support
reproducible material and feasible exposure
credible differentiation from the current comparator
no unresolved fatal safety signal at the required exposure
a compelling next development milestone with plausible value capture
policy.S_tier_result: No S-tier promotion. BLU has a defined qualification work order; enasidenib and ruxolitinib retain finite clinical-development priorities. Four new exact uses and two existing-use updates do not establish a new exclusive drug asset.
policy.S_tier_note: S is a decision standard, not a quota, probability estimate, prediction of investor interest, or guarantee of clinical success.
policy.fundability_definition: Evaluate the next stage separately: defined article, plausible model/clinical route, rationale, finite decision-changing output and explicit advance/redirect/stop branches can justify initial qualification. Confirmation and a larger asset investment require progressively stronger useful function, relevant exposure, differentiation and value capture. Do not require the proposed experiment result before funding its qualification. Clinical evidence-generation is labeled honestly when a standalone product contribution/value-capture route is not established; it must not silently replace the intended drug-development objective.

final_shortlist.proposed_advance_condition: Exploratory point>=M and lower95% bound>0 with qualified inputs and interpretable functional safety earns independent confirmation. Upper95% bound<M supports model-specific futility only with adequate target perturbation, exposure and delayed modifiability. Orthogonal selective and independent-background failure is needed for bounded target downgrade. Required-exposure harm or absent product contribution can stop the article/asset thesis.
final_shortlist.decision: Leading bounded qualification project: exact S article, independently specified assay, measured exposure and one post-deficit human-force model; conditional exploration and independent confirmation.

final_shortlist.priority_scope: Historical scientific planning scope: Round10 next-action queue; 15/100 planning-effort points, not success probability or money. Does not control Round 15 marginal-dollar selection.
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Enasidenib; mesylate tablet reference and documented pediatric sprinkle use. Intended infant presentation must be specified; historical clinical lot identity with EP4058028B1 is unverified.
final_shortlist.population: Direct human treatment anchor is germline heterozygous IDH2-R140Q. R140G, type-I D2HGDH disease and other IDH2 variants do not inherit efficacy.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: One clear severe-cardiomyopathy trajectory: LVEF 20–25% at entry, 35–40% at six months and 40–45% at eight months with later fluctuation and concurrent care. A second original child had normal baseline systolic function; Gold had milder baseline disease. Biochemical suppression is strong; neurological outcomes are less causally secure.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five outcome case records across three publications; original two and Gold are clearly distinct. Cross-publication linkage of two skin cases is unresolved. Metadata-only five-week-old report adds zero verified outcomes.
final_shortlist.material_route: Defined marketed tablet and research free-base routes; actual studied sprinkle and concrete minitablet patent. Public route and historical use do not establish received lot, present supply or infant administration compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATCC R140Q TF-1/parent route is biochemical, homozygous and cancer-line specific. Endogenous heterozygous mouse and genetic reversibility precedents exist. A new human cardiac model is optional when it discriminates a consequential exposure/function question.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: Current adult PK includes 7.9-day half-life, tenfold accumulation, 29-day steady state, active metabolite, interactions and plausible A3 antagonism. No infant dose rule or lifelong safety boundary. Direct pediatric ALT/CK observations require a coherent longitudinal exposure/laboratory timeline.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing clinical program and published granted pediatric minitablet composition/process claims prevent a first-pediatric-formulation or open-rights claim. Define an improvement in delivery, exposure, burden/tolerability or prospective clinical evidence; standalone value capture remains unresolved.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: One specified pediatric administration/exposure question linked to chiral D-2-HG and a preselected organ-function outcome. Define cardiac, CNS or preventive claim; compare vorasidenib attributes for a CNS product. Clinical evidence and proprietary value remain separate.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Reliable delivery and interpretable exposure/PD plus a useful organ-function or preservation signal justify confirmation; a larger product program requires independently supported clinical benefit and a real product advantage.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Redirect delivery failure or exposure-related harm; narrow tissue/genotype/timing claims when appropriate. Do not reject human observations from an unqualified model. Stop a standalone product thesis if no useful incremental contribution or practicable product route exists.

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. final_shortlist.decision: Continue staged independent exact-compound human-function proof; no S-tier promotion.
final_shortlist.ranking_delta: Retain human-function proof priority with a more concrete first neuronal assay route. No new exact-P2 human functional response was established in round4.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

independent_challenge.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
independent_challenge.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

policy.decision_unit: Exact product in a defined disease, route and treatment window, paired with a stage-appropriate decision-changing preclinical or clinical proof.
policy.ranking: Select the expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar from feasible tranches, including stop or defer, using remaining costs, time, decision-changing information and capturable value. Do not inherit priority from sunk effort or historical allocation. Qualitative comparisons must not masquerade as numerical financial rankings when inputs are missing.
evidence_rules: Keep exact chemical/sequence identity, formulation, route, genotype, model maturity and timing attached to every claim.

Identify the independently assigned treatment unit: independently treated tissues can be exposure units. Preserve donor generality and independent-batch structure. Repeated twitches, images and time points are nested observations, not extra subjects.
Deduplicate abstracts, articles, patents and follow-up analyses reporting the same underlying dataset.
Require direct useful function after disease establishment; distinguish prevention, markers and surrogate mechanics.
Use the strongest practical active comparator and measure exposure; failure against vehicle is not the only possible failure.
Test combinations factorially and require added value over the best single component.
Update related candidates when a relevant current clinical or functional negative result appears; retain model/indication distinctions.
Have an independent reviewer seek a decisive disconfirming explanation before top-priority promotion.
A changed analog, stereoisomer, sequence or salt inherits a hypothesis, not the prior article efficacy claim.
Preservation and prevention can be valuable but do not count as demonstrated delayed reversal.
A positive functional result is scored against the strongest current public comparator; later primary negatives remain attached to the record.
An inaccessible full method remains explicitly unverified; secondary commentary cannot fill a primary donor count or dose.
Classify source purpose before inferring availability: recruitment wishlist, planned grant, service, catalog and received lot are distinct.
Use primary corrections and dated investigator/sponsor updates alongside registry labels; completed does not mean successful.
A late-start response at an assay ceiling is not equivalence, full force restoration or durable reversal.
Record conflicts in source regimens, units and cohort linkage rather than silently selecting the favorable interpretation.
Prior genetic correction establishes disease causality; require a post-deficit functional positive control before a qualified delayed-treatment target rejection.
Permit a predictable developmental trajectory with contemporaneous controls and baseline adjustment; distinguish compensation, preservation and mature reversal.
Prespecify both minimum useful effect and assay repeatability; do not equate an imprecise interval crossing the useful threshold with established futility.
Equal-free-concentration cultures characterize intrinsic sensitivity; connect effective exposure to measured or bounded relevant-tissue distribution before asserting a systemic window.
Keep bottle identity, nominal dose, time-varying species, metabolites, salt/congener composition and clinical combination identity distinct.
Track insufficient-response discontinuations, changing denominators and background-treatment changes; a completer estimate is not an all-treated causal response.
Read actual public result documents before using trial status; retain final-submitted versus internally draft-labelled and peer-reviewed status.
A binding-panel percentage is not catalytic inhibition or functional ion-current activity; nominal cross-assay dose ratios are not universal selectivity.
Stage the funding decision: one qualified starting background can justify an exploratory signal; independent backgrounds and fuller exposure belong to confirmation.
Useful ongoing control, developmental preservation and comparable efficacy with meaningful burden/tolerability benefit are legitimate intended product outcomes.
Existing programs and generic ingredients require a clear incremental contribution; they do not automatically erase the value of a bounded scientific project.
End repeated desktop review when a finite next qualification decision is supported; reopen for evidence likely to change that decision.
Existing exact-disease human evidence can justify article/exposure or controlled-clinical qualification without a mandatory new cell/animal rescue experiment.
A marketed concentration does not authenticate every historical brand, vehicle or lot; standardized prospective article identity remains explicit.
For fluctuating disease, retain a concurrent counterfactual, rescue/background-treatment handling and patient-level denominators, including responder-enriched maintenance.
Characterize observed exposure and tolerability within the studied population/follow-up; do not promote assay IC50 references or small-cohort experience to validated long-term safety limits.
Label numbers as published observations, formula-derived references, proposed engineering limits or calibration-dependent unknowns. Lock thresholds before treatment decoding.
A nonisogenic reference gap is not a genetically established rescuable deficit. Confirm narrow first-background benefit before conditionally extending generality.
Unknown provenance and denominators cannot pass a decision gate. Bounded target downgrade must not emit a universal target-rejection claim.
Apply product contribution and public-rights criteria symmetrically to BLU, branded products and generics; no owner-response scientific-selection gate.
An absent public qualification report is not an observed incumbent failure or demonstrated unmet formulation need.
A first new-indication development contribution can use an adequate existing article; a novel formulation is not a universal prerequisite for useful development or capture.
Evaluate regulatory incentives against the exact product and current law; designation, approval, award, rights, competition and revenue remain separate.
Preserve the option to stop, defer or redirect; do not require a fresh numerical allocation when costs, time and capture inputs are unknown.

For APR-246/AEC, useful sustained control of chronic erosions can justify a product without mandatory withdrawal persistence or perfect cornification; stronger full-barrier and drug-free regeneration claims require separate evidence.

An illustrative small qualification tranche must be reconsidered if it requires major new article, vehicle, model or rights development. Published model existence does not establish access, cost, fidelity or exact-drug responsiveness.
policy.no_contact_gate: Unknown commercial terms do not block public scientific selection. Identify known claims, testable routes and remaining uncertainty without substituting an owner reply for a scientific decision.
proof_gate: demonstrated post-deficit modifiability before a negative reversal-target inference
prespecified useful-effect threshold and biological-unit uncertainty
S_tier_criteria: large useful functional restoration, preservation or ongoing control in the intended disease claim
orthogonal or independent support
reproducible material and feasible exposure
credible differentiation from the current comparator
no unresolved fatal safety signal at the required exposure
a compelling next development milestone with plausible value capture
policy.S_tier_result: No S-tier promotion in Round 16. APR-246/AEC is the first conditional marginal-dollar qualification priority while retaining its local translational challenger evidence tier. Existing scientific/clinical priorities remain.
policy.S_tier_note: S is a decision standard, not a quota, probability estimate, prediction of investor interest, or guarantee of clinical success.
policy.fundability_definition: Evaluate the next stage separately: defined article, plausible model/clinical route, rationale, finite decision-changing output and explicit advance/redirect/stop branches can justify initial qualification. Confirmation and a larger asset investment require progressively stronger useful function, relevant exposure, differentiation and value capture. Do not require the proposed experiment result before funding its qualification. Clinical evidence-generation is labeled honestly when a standalone product contribution/value-capture route is not established; it must not silently replace the intended drug-development objective.

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. WO2023196340 includes a displayed granted US family member US12396968B2; ceased PCT status does not establish open rights.
final_shortlist.decision: Continue staged independent exact-compound human-function proof; no S-tier promotion.
final_shortlist.ranking_delta: Retain human-function proof priority with a more concrete first neuronal assay route. No new exact-P2 human functional response was established in round4.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. policy.decision_unit: Exact product in a defined disease, route and treatment window, paired with a stage-appropriate decision-changing preclinical or clinical proof.
policy.ranking: Select the expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar from feasible tranches, including stop or defer, using remaining costs, time, decision-changing information and capturable value. Do not inherit priority from sunk effort or historical allocation. Qualitative comparisons must not masquerade as numerical financial rankings when inputs are missing.
evidence_rules: Keep exact chemical/sequence identity, formulation, route, genotype, model maturity and timing attached to every claim.

Identify the independently assigned treatment unit: independently treated tissues can be exposure units. Preserve donor generality and independent-batch structure. Repeated twitches, images and time points are nested observations, not extra subjects.
Deduplicate abstracts, articles, patents and follow-up analyses reporting the same underlying dataset.
Require direct useful function after disease establishment; distinguish prevention, markers and surrogate mechanics.
Use the strongest practical active comparator and measure exposure; failure against vehicle is not the only possible failure.
Test combinations factorially and require added value over the best single component.
Update related candidates when a relevant current clinical or functional negative result appears; retain model/indication distinctions.
Have an independent reviewer seek a decisive disconfirming explanation before top-priority promotion.
A changed analog, stereoisomer, sequence or salt inherits a hypothesis, not the prior article efficacy claim.
Preservation and prevention can be valuable but do not count as demonstrated delayed reversal.
A positive functional result is scored against the strongest current public comparator; later primary negatives remain attached to the record.
An inaccessible full method remains explicitly unverified; secondary commentary cannot fill a primary donor count or dose.
Classify source purpose before inferring availability: recruitment wishlist, planned grant, service, catalog and received lot are distinct.
Use primary corrections and dated investigator/sponsor updates alongside registry labels; completed does not mean successful.
A late-start response at an assay ceiling is not equivalence, full force restoration or durable reversal.
Record conflicts in source regimens, units and cohort linkage rather than silently selecting the favorable interpretation.
Prior genetic correction establishes disease causality; require a post-deficit functional positive control before a qualified delayed-treatment target rejection.
Permit a predictable developmental trajectory with contemporaneous controls and baseline adjustment; distinguish compensation, preservation and mature reversal.
Prespecify both minimum useful effect and assay repeatability; do not equate an imprecise interval crossing the useful threshold with established futility.
Equal-free-concentration cultures characterize intrinsic sensitivity; connect effective exposure to measured or bounded relevant-tissue distribution before asserting a systemic window.
Keep bottle identity, nominal dose, time-varying species, metabolites, salt/congener composition and clinical combination identity distinct.
Track insufficient-response discontinuations, changing denominators and background-treatment changes; a completer estimate is not an all-treated causal response.
Read actual public result documents before using trial status; retain final-submitted versus internally draft-labelled and peer-reviewed status.
A binding-panel percentage is not catalytic inhibition or functional ion-current activity; nominal cross-assay dose ratios are not universal selectivity.
Stage the funding decision: one qualified starting background can justify an exploratory signal; independent backgrounds and fuller exposure belong to confirmation.
Useful ongoing control, developmental preservation and comparable efficacy with meaningful burden/tolerability benefit are legitimate intended product outcomes.
Existing programs and generic ingredients require a clear incremental contribution; they do not automatically erase the value of a bounded scientific project.
End repeated desktop review when a finite next qualification decision is supported; reopen for evidence likely to change that decision.
Existing exact-disease human evidence can justify article/exposure or controlled-clinical qualification without a mandatory new cell/animal rescue experiment.
A marketed concentration does not authenticate every historical brand, vehicle or lot; standardized prospective article identity remains explicit.
For fluctuating disease, retain a concurrent counterfactual, rescue/background-treatment handling and patient-level denominators, including responder-enriched maintenance.
Characterize observed exposure and tolerability within the studied population/follow-up; do not promote assay IC50 references or small-cohort experience to validated long-term safety limits.
Label numbers as published observations, formula-derived references, proposed engineering limits or calibration-dependent unknowns. Lock thresholds before treatment decoding.
A nonisogenic reference gap is not a genetically established rescuable deficit. Confirm narrow first-background benefit before conditionally extending generality.
Unknown provenance and denominators cannot pass a decision gate. Bounded target downgrade must not emit a universal target-rejection claim.
Apply product contribution and public-rights criteria symmetrically to BLU, branded products and generics; no owner-response scientific-selection gate.
An absent public qualification report is not an observed incumbent failure or demonstrated unmet formulation need.
A first new-indication development contribution can use an adequate existing article; a novel formulation is not a universal prerequisite for useful development or capture.
Evaluate regulatory incentives against the exact product and current law; designation, approval, award, rights, competition and revenue remain separate.
Preserve the option to stop, defer or redirect; do not require a fresh numerical allocation when costs, time and capture inputs are unknown.

For APR-246/AEC, useful sustained control of chronic erosions can justify a product without mandatory withdrawal persistence or perfect cornification; stronger full-barrier and drug-free regeneration claims require separate evidence.

An illustrative small qualification tranche must be reconsidered if it requires major new article, vehicle, model or rights development. Published model existence does not establish access, cost, fidelity or exact-drug responsiveness.
Distinguish the next eligible information sprint from conditional development rank: an exhausted public-source pass does not automatically reduce the value of the candidate next development dollar.

For RM4404, keep injury model, regimen, endpoint, biological unit and time since treatment separate. Preliminary direct contrasts, final-paper healthy-reference comparisons and repeated histology readings cannot substitute for one another.

Useful ongoing control or finite-course corneal benefit can be valuable. The claim needs meaningful function and tolerability; a stronger off-treatment repair claim needs relevant follow-up and exposure interpretation. Full sterile commercialization work and every injury model are not universal first-qualification gates.
policy.no_contact_gate: Unknown commercial terms do not block public scientific selection. Identify known claims, testable routes and remaining uncertainty without substituting an owner reply for a scientific decision.
proof_gate: demonstrated post-deficit modifiability before a negative reversal-target inference
prespecified useful-effect threshold and biological-unit uncertainty
S_tier_criteria: large useful functional restoration, preservation or ongoing control in the intended disease claim
orthogonal or independent support
reproducible material and feasible exposure
credible differentiation from the current comparator
no unresolved fatal safety signal at the required exposure
a compelling next development milestone with plausible value capture
policy.S_tier_result: No S-tier promotion in Round 17. RM4404 retains its independent-validation evidence tier. Its completed source sprint follows APR closure without changing the independent review conditional development prefix APR1/RM2/BLU3 or prior scientific/clinical candidate dispositions.
policy.S_tier_note: S is a decision standard, not a quota, probability estimate, prediction of investor interest, or guarantee of clinical success.
policy.fundability_definition: Evaluate the next stage separately: defined article, plausible model/clinical route, rationale, finite decision-changing output and explicit advance/redirect/stop branches can justify initial qualification. Confirmation and a larger asset investment require progressively stronger useful function, relevant exposure, differentiation and value capture. Do not require the proposed experiment result before funding its qualification. Clinical evidence-generation is labeled honestly when a standalone product contribution/value-capture route is not established; it must not silently replace the intended drug-development objective.

final_shortlist.name: Enasidenib for germline IDH2-R140Q D2HGA2
final_shortlist.decision: Defined clinical-development priority retained. Evaluate a first-D2HGA2-indication contribution using an adequate existing article; hold automatic new-formulation spend until a meaningful residual administration need is documented. Scientific value and private capture are separate.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Historical scientific planning scope: Round10 next-action queue; 15/100 planning-effort points, not success probability or money. Does not control Round 15 marginal-dollar selection.
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Enasidenib; mesylate tablet reference and documented pediatric sprinkle use. Intended infant presentation must be specified; historical clinical lot identity with EP4058028B1 is unverified.
final_shortlist.population: Direct human treatment anchor is germline heterozygous IDH2-R140Q. R140G, type-I D2HGDH disease and other IDH2 variants do not inherit efficacy.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: One clear severe-cardiomyopathy trajectory: LVEF 20–25% at entry, 35–40% at six months and 40–45% at eight months with later fluctuation and concurrent care. A second original child had normal baseline systolic function; Gold had milder baseline disease. Biochemical suppression is strong; neurological outcomes are less causally secure.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five outcome case records across three publications; original two and Gold are clearly distinct. Cross-publication linkage of two skin cases is unresolved. Metadata-only five-week-old report adds zero verified outcomes.
final_shortlist.material_route: Defined marketed tablet and research free-base routes; actual studied sprinkle and concrete minitablet patent. Public route and historical use do not establish received lot, present supply or infant administration compatibility.
final_shortlist.model_route: ATCC R140Q TF-1/parent route is biochemical, homozygous and cancer-line specific. Endogenous heterozygous mouse and genetic reversibility precedents exist. A new human cardiac model is optional when it discriminates a consequential exposure/function question.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: Current adult PK includes 7.9-day half-life, tenfold accumulation, 29-day steady state, active metabolite, interactions and plausible A3 antagonism. No infant dose rule or lifelong safety boundary. Direct pediatric ALT/CK observations require a coherent longitudinal exposure/laboratory timeline.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing clinical program and published granted pediatric minitablet composition/process claims prevent a first-pediatric-formulation or open-rights claim. Define an improvement in delivery, exposure, burden/tolerability or prospective clinical evidence; standalone value capture remains unresolved.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: One specified pediatric administration/exposure question linked to chiral D-2-HG and a preselected organ-function outcome. Define cardiac, CNS or preventive claim; compare vorasidenib attributes for a CNS product. Clinical evidence and proprietary value remain separate.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Reliable delivery and interpretable exposure/PD plus a useful organ-function or preservation signal justify confirmation; a larger product program requires independently supported clinical benefit and a real product advantage.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Redirect delivery failure or exposure-related harm; narrow tissue/genotype/timing claims when appropriate. Do not reject human observations from an unqualified model. Stop a standalone product thesis if no useful incremental contribution or practicable product route exists.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Full clinical lineage and 177-cell laboratory audit; specific public pediatric formulation, adult PK/DDI/A3 and model audit; staged clinical proof with independent challenge. Removed from the reserve list to avoid conflicting current dispositions.
final_shortlist.round8_delta: R140Q-active vorasidenib added as CNS mechanism/exposure comparator; tumor PK is not normal infant-brain exposure or safety superiority. Cardiac treatment, neurological benefit and neonatal prevention split. Existing sprinkle requires a demonstrated new administration/exposure contribution.
round9_delta: A primary TGA2025 assessment adds the active vorasidenib metabolite AGI-69460 exposure issue. A late-cycle mean molar predose metabolite:parent ratio is not a normal infant-brain exposure measure or AUC ratio.

The cited assessment did not establish metabolite animal brain penetration and excluded it from the population PK model; observed adolescent representation was one patient under18. Metabolite R140Q potency and unbound normal-infant-brain exposure remain unresolved.
Retain enasidenib rank2 and15 planning points. Cardiac benefit, neurological treatment and neonatal prevention remain separate; parent-only exposure comparisons cannot establish CNS superiority.
round10_delta: Correct the inherited blanket AGI-17011 absence statement: EMA p18 conflicts with clinical pp33-34 and 46, which report M2/AGI-17011 as a minor human plasma metabolite at 0.3% of single-dose circulating radioactivity exposure. Chronic pediatric contribution remains unknown.

The43-row ledger preserves analyte, exact assay/variant, formulation, age/species, compartment, bound/free basis, timing, statistic and denominator. Adult repeated-dose exposure and in-vitro binding arithmetic do not establish infant organ exposure.
FDA vorasidenib Table 21 reverses tumor:Cavg dose assignments relative to adjacent prose. Preserve the source conflict. PMDA AGI-69460 R172K activity does not supply R140Q potency.
Close CNS superiority as not identifiable from the bounded public evidence; retain 15 points and the separate cardiac question. No new D2HGA2 clinical outcome or infant dose established.
