final_shortlist.name: Ruxolitinib 1.5% cream for refractory Hailey–Hailey disease
final_shortlist.decision: Defined controlled clinical-proof priority: recommend marketed-article, protocol and measurement qualification followed by a contemporaneously controlled patient-benefit comparison.
final_shortlist.priority_scope: Historical scientific planning scope: Round 14 next-action queue; 10/100 planning-effort points, not success probability or money. Does not control Round 15 marginal-dollar selection.
final_shortlist.exact_entity: Prospective standardized Opzelura 1.5% cream, 15 mg/g ruxolitinib base equivalent as 19.8 mg/g phosphate. Historical cases verify active/concentration/route, not every brand, vehicle or lot.
final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Five distinguishable exact-strength case reports support useful local control. Monotherapy-style treatment, add-on induction and topical maintenance are kept separate. No controlled exact-rux HHD effect estimate was verified.
final_shortlist.biological_units: Five selected single-patient reports, not a consecutive treated denominator. EADV duplicate and separate 1%+naltrexone report excluded from that count. Nine-patient preprint remains abstract-only and unpooled.
final_shortlist.material_route: Manufactured marketed cream defines a clinical article. Research free base/phosphate are assay routes, not equivalent clinical formulations. Qualified matched vehicle is one option; pragmatic randomized whole-product add-on comparison is a defined alternative.
final_shortlist.model_route: Gupta final-publication author manuscript reports an ATP2C1 engineered N/TERT-2G model with a mechanical-attachment deficit, a second heterozygous clone and culture-level replication clarification. Only weak CDN1163 attachment improvement is reported; S1/S4 panels, quantitative rescue and exact clone alleles remain unverified. Parent naming/authentication and endpoint-specific comparator limits persist. Optional mechanism work only; immune-free negativity cannot rule out an inflammatory clinical mechanism.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: AD PK: 479-person 1.5% phaseIII subgroup, mean Css 35.7 nM; maximum-use n=40 mean 104 nM with high-exposure extremes. No HHD PK boundary. 281 nM is a laboratory proxy, not a universal safety threshold; follow current label/combination context.
final_shortlist.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing composition/formulation claims and branded franchise; current ANDA litigation. KB111 and guselkumab are active distinct HHD programs. Controlled data may be valuable, while a proprietary asset needs a differentiated benefit and executable rights/manufacturing/regulatory route.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: Controlled standardized1.5% cream plus protocolized care against the same care; preselected meaningful pain/erosion/rescue/burden outcome, masked assessment, exposure and all-randomized/maintenance denominators. Procedure avoidance requires a relevant sweat-control comparison.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Controlled useful clinical benefit or comparable efficacy with a meaningful burden/tolerability advantage, interpretable exposure and acceptable observed safety; exploratory evidence can justify independent confirmation.
final_shortlist.stop_or_redirect_condition: Rule out a meaningful benefit only with an informative design and adequate delivery; redirect measurement/article failures. Stop the proposed product for reproducible unacceptable effective-exposure harm or no differentiated product contribution.
final_shortlist.round7_delta: Five-report clinical audit, DERM101 concurrent-control benchmark, mechanistic citation correction, quantitative PK/high-exposure and official-patent audit, current competitors and a staged clinical proof. No new lead counted.
final_shortlist.round8_delta: OnabotulinumtoxinA sweat-control benchmark added. Seven-person randomized study is separate from30-person mixed pilot with26HHD/4Darier and11HHD relapses. Late survivor efficacy is not all-randomized maintenance. Product contribution includes sustained control and lower treatment/rescue burden.
round9_delta: Bounded public-source comparator review found no new verified rank-changing HHD evidence beyond the preserved dossiers. Retain rank3 and10 planning points.
Keep exact1.5% article, concurrent-care comparison, all-randomized and maintenance denominators, exposure and useful pain/erosion/rescue-burden outcomes. No new HHD efficacy observation is claimed.
round10_delta: Four selected naltrexone case records across two primary reports add a documented active-care option for the HHD comparison. Cointerventions, author-estimated outcomes, recurrence and related presentation deduplication remain explicit.
This is not new ruxolitinib efficacy, an all-treated naltrexone response rate, a head-to-head comparison or a validated dose-escalation regimen.

Retain 10 points and the existing proof recommendation. Make the vehicle/add-on/replacement claim explicit, and preserve background care, useful control, pain, rescue burden and all-randomized maintenance denominators. The9-patient preprint remains abstract-level.
round13_delta: Newly read final-publication author manuscript adds a mechanical attachment assay and reports baseline fragility and only weak CDN1163 attachment improvement. Record this as a main-text author report; S4 panels, exact comparisons, effect sizes and replicate denominators remain uninspected.

A second heterozygous clone and a revised independent-culture replication description strengthen specified baseline model evidence. Cells, cultures, clones and patient backgrounds remain separate; no replication of every drug-rescue endpoint or independent study is inferred.

N/TERT-2G and baricitinib during clone generation were already present in the preprint. Correct extraction without claiming new biology, authenticating a stock or inferring ongoing JAK inhibition. Preserve N/TERT/Ker-CT and source figure/text ambiguities.

CDN1163 remains an endpoint-limited modifiability reference, not a qualified complete-barrier or reliable cohesion-rescue positive control. Treatment before detachment challenge and genetic rescue before replating do not establish delayed repair after tissue failure. Weak reported improvement is not zero effect.

Retain rank 3, 10 planning points and the controlled clinical-proof priority. The immune-free model stays optional and cannot veto an inflammation-mediated clinical benefit. Close the current supplement retrieval pass until new primary access or interpretable endpoint-specific evidence is available.

round14_delta: Recovered complete official NCT05635838 results and the visible official SAP. One randomized HS cohort has 34/35 controlled-period starters, 24/32 completers and 10/3 noncompleters. final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. WO2023196340 includes a displayed granted US family member US12396968B2; ceased PCT status does not establish open rights.

final_shortlist.ranking_delta: Retain human-function proof priority with a more concrete first neuronal assay route. No new exact-P2 human functional response was established in round4.
final_shortlist.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.
final_shortlist.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
final_shortlist.stop_condition: No useful exact-P2 benefit despite adequate exposure and engagement in a model with a qualified post-deficit functional positive control; only parent mixture works; benefit is generic hyperexcitability/growth; or measured relevant-tissue exposure impairs useful healthy function. A model without a disease-functional deficit is not a target-negative result.

independent_challenge.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
independent_challenge.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

policy.decision_unit: Exact product in a defined disease, route and treatment window, paired with a stage-appropriate decision-changing preclinical or clinical proof.
policy.ranking: Select the expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar from feasible tranches, including stop or defer, using remaining costs, time, decision-changing information and capturable value. Do not inherit priority from sunk effort or historical allocation. Qualitative comparisons must not masquerade as numerical financial rankings when inputs are missing.
evidence_rules: Keep exact chemical/sequence identity, formulation, route, genotype, model maturity and timing attached to every claim.

Identify the independently assigned treatment unit: independently treated tissues can be exposure units. Preserve donor generality and independent-batch structure. Repeated twitches, images and time points are nested observations, not extra subjects.
Deduplicate abstracts, articles, patents and follow-up analyses reporting the same underlying dataset.
Require direct useful function after disease establishment; distinguish prevention, markers and surrogate mechanics.
Use the strongest practical active comparator and measure exposure; failure against vehicle is not the only possible failure.
Test combinations factorially and require added value over the best single component.
Update related candidates when a relevant current clinical or functional negative result appears; retain model/indication distinctions.
Have an independent reviewer seek a decisive disconfirming explanation before top-priority promotion.
A changed analog, stereoisomer, sequence or salt inherits a hypothesis, not the prior article efficacy claim.
Preservation and prevention can be valuable but do not count as demonstrated delayed reversal.
A positive functional result is scored against the strongest current public comparator; later primary negatives remain attached to the record.
An inaccessible full method remains explicitly unverified; secondary commentary cannot fill a primary donor count or dose.
Classify source purpose before inferring availability: recruitment wishlist, planned grant, service, catalog and received lot are distinct.
Use primary corrections and dated investigator/sponsor updates alongside registry labels; completed does not mean successful.
A late-start response at an assay ceiling is not equivalence, full force restoration or durable reversal.
Record conflicts in source regimens, units and cohort linkage rather than silently selecting the favorable interpretation.
Prior genetic correction establishes disease causality; require a post-deficit functional positive control before a qualified delayed-treatment target rejection.
Permit a predictable developmental trajectory with contemporaneous controls and baseline adjustment; distinguish compensation, preservation and mature reversal.
Prespecify both minimum useful effect and assay repeatability; do not equate an imprecise interval crossing the useful threshold with established futility.
Equal-free-concentration cultures characterize intrinsic sensitivity; connect effective exposure to measured or bounded relevant-tissue distribution before asserting a systemic window.
Keep bottle identity, nominal dose, time-varying species, metabolites, salt/congener composition and clinical combination identity distinct.
Track insufficient-response discontinuations, changing denominators and background-treatment changes; a completer estimate is not an all-treated causal response.
Read actual public result documents before using trial status; retain final-submitted versus internally draft-labelled and peer-reviewed status.
A binding-panel percentage is not catalytic inhibition or functional ion-current activity; nominal cross-assay dose ratios are not universal selectivity.
Stage the funding decision: one qualified starting background can justify an exploratory signal; independent backgrounds and fuller exposure belong to confirmation.
Useful ongoing control, developmental preservation and comparable efficacy with meaningful burden/tolerability benefit are legitimate intended product outcomes.
Existing programs and generic ingredients require a clear incremental contribution; they do not automatically erase the value of a bounded scientific project.
End repeated desktop review when a finite next qualification decision is supported; reopen for evidence likely to change that decision.
Existing exact-disease human evidence can justify article/exposure or controlled-clinical qualification without a mandatory new cell/animal rescue experiment.
A marketed concentration does not authenticate every historical brand, vehicle or lot; standardized prospective article identity remains explicit.
For fluctuating disease, retain a concurrent counterfactual, rescue/background-treatment handling and patient-level denominators, including responder-enriched maintenance.
Characterize observed exposure and tolerability within the studied population/follow-up; do not promote assay IC50 references or small-cohort experience to validated long-term safety limits.
Label numbers as published observations, formula-derived references, proposed engineering limits or calibration-dependent unknowns. Lock thresholds before treatment decoding.
A nonisogenic reference gap is not a genetically established rescuable deficit. Confirm narrow first-background benefit before conditionally extending generality.
Unknown provenance and denominators cannot pass a decision gate. Bounded target downgrade must not emit a universal target-rejection claim.
Apply product contribution and public-rights criteria symmetrically to BLU, branded products and generics; no owner-response scientific-selection gate.
An absent public qualification report is not an observed incumbent failure or demonstrated unmet formulation need.
A first new-indication development contribution can use an adequate existing article; a novel formulation is not a universal prerequisite for useful development or capture.
Evaluate regulatory incentives against the exact product and current law; designation, approval, award, rights, competition and revenue remain separate.
Preserve the option to stop, defer or redirect; do not require a fresh numerical allocation when costs, time and capture inputs are unknown.

For APR-246/AEC, useful sustained control of chronic erosions can justify a product without mandatory withdrawal persistence or perfect cornification; stronger full-barrier and drug-free regeneration claims require separate evidence.

An illustrative small qualification tranche must be reconsidered if it requires major new article, vehicle, model or rights development. Published model existence does not establish access, cost, fidelity or exact-drug responsiveness.
Distinguish the next eligible information sprint from conditional development rank: an exhausted public-source pass does not automatically reduce the value of the candidate next development dollar.

For RM4404, keep injury model, regimen, endpoint, biological unit and time since treatment separate. Preliminary direct contrasts, final-paper healthy-reference comparisons and repeated histology readings cannot substitute for one another.

Useful ongoing control or finite-course corneal benefit can be valuable. The claim needs meaningful function and tolerability; a stronger off-treatment repair claim needs relevant follow-up and exposure interpretation. Full sterile commercialization work and every injury model are not universal first-qualification gates.

For BLU, initial article/exposure/model qualification and conditional human-function work have separate illustrative cost/time envelopes and stop options. Initial qualification need not already deliver human functional benefit; neither phase is automatically funded.

Institutional manuscript metadata do not establish read content or model qualification. A human tissue assay, sponsor targeting claim, relative starting dose or planned follow-up does not establish exact-BLU clinical benefit, systemic safety or a permanent comparator-excluded market.

Post-deficit modifiability is required for the corresponding strong negative reversal inference; do not turn it into a universal gate for every ongoing-control or preservation claim. Preserve the existing asymmetry between informative positives and inadequately qualified negatives.
policy.no_contact_gate: Unknown commercial terms do not block public scientific selection. Identify known claims, testable routes and remaining uncertainty without substituting an owner reply for a scientific decision.
proof_gate: demonstrated post-deficit modifiability before a negative reversal-target inference
prespecified useful-effect threshold and biological-unit uncertainty
S_tier_criteria: large useful functional restoration, preservation or ongoing control in the intended disease claim
orthogonal or independent support
reproducible material and feasible exposure
credible differentiation from the current comparator
no unresolved fatal safety signal at the required exposure
a compelling next development milestone with plausible value capture
policy.S_tier_result: No S-tier promotion in Round18. BLU retains its bounded scientific qualification project, with no new human force result or financial-rank promotion. APR and RM current records, claim scopes and source closures remain intact.
policy.S_tier_note: S is a decision standard, not a quota, probability estimate, prediction of investor interest, or guarantee of clinical success.
policy.fundability_definition: Evaluate the next stage separately: defined article, plausible model/clinical route, rationale, finite decision-changing output and explicit advance/redirect/stop branches can justify initial qualification. Confirmation and a larger asset investment require progressively stronger useful function, relevant exposure, differentiation and value capture. Do not require the proposed experiment result before funding its qualification. Clinical evidence-generation is labeled honestly when a standalone product contribution/value-capture route is not established; it must not silently replace the intended drug-development objective.

DD3–4 required Y27632 during maintenance; all DD cultures and CTL1–2 received it for consistency. It was removed 24–36 h before assays, so there is no demonstrated concurrent ROCK-inhibitor confound.

The 2023 healthy-neuron result involved spine-neck morphology at 0.1 µM, with at least 10 neurons / 70 spines from one culture batch. It is not observed skin toxicity; the 2025 intraperitoneal CNS study does not qualify topical exposure.

final_shortlist.functional_evidence: Exact P2 improves established sensory/motor phenotypes in approximately 50-week-old Mfn2 T105M knock-in mice and rats. The 2026 rat study randomized and blinded testing; dose cohorts contain four rats per dose and seven WT comparators. The 10 mg/kg cohort stopped at four weeks after normal-range values. A separate acute motility assay used 100 mg/kg, not the chronic dose.

biological_sample_counts.2020_human_Chimera_C: Four patient backgrounds; chemically different article

final_shortlist.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2. Allele-specific mitochondrial shape is not a reliable substitute for measured fusion or drug-response selection. The2020 correction withdrew the incorrect R364W-based harm inference; it did not retract the whole paper.
final_shortlist.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
final_shortlist.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index. The single10micromolar panel does not establish >10000fold universal selectivity: MAO-A59% is radioligand displacement, hERG-14% is binding, and neither is a functional clinical margin.
final_shortlist.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. new_candidate_screens.decision: Advance independent bounded human functional proof; strongest new neuro/muscle lead in this round, below fully qualified S-tier.

Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations.

new_candidate_screens.proposed_next_proof: In an independently implemented erythroid process, compare enucleated-cell yield, hemoglobin content, deformability, oxygen affinity and residual reagent against the existing transferrin process, then test relevant scale. Require an all-in process advantage rather than reduced transferrin mass alone.
new_candidate_screens.functional_evidence: Human cultured reticulocyte hemoglobinization and oxygen-association/dissociation behavior were demonstrated with the iron-loaded complex. The study reports n>=3 experiment summaries; donor independence should be checked for a confirmatory design.
new_candidate_screens.deciding_proof: In an independently implemented erythroid process, compare enucleated-cell yield, hemoglobin content, deformability, oxygen affinity and residual reagent against the existing transferrin process, then test relevant scale. Require an all-in process advantage rather than reduced transferrin mass alone.
new_candidate_screens.advance_condition: Independent scaled process improves usable red-cell yield/quality or all-in manufacturing cost with acceptable residual clearance, not merely transferrin mass.
new_candidate_screens.stop_condition: No usable process advantage, impaired red-cell quality, or residual/scale burden erases benefit.

new_candidate_screens.name: PZL-A as the active comparator for the POLG rescue lane
new_candidate_screens.previous_link: Round2 R-N01 sulbactam/POLG cited PZL-A as a comparator; do not count PZL-A as a wholly new round3 family.
new_candidate_screens.exact_entity: PZL-A, CAS 3068830-89-4, published allosteric POLG activator. Do not equate with the separate clinical asset PX578.
new_candidate_screens.evidence: The 2025 Nature study reports exact-molecule restoration of mtDNA replication and respiration/ATP in patient fibroblasts carrying two compound-heterozygous genotype combinations, with experiment-level n=3. Most cellular rescue follows experimentally induced mtDNA depletion; native established-tissue benefit remains a separate question.
new_candidate_screens.material_route: Published structure and several research catalog listings, including Selleck and Probechem. Current stock, lot identity and potency have not been confirmed by receipt.
new_candidate_screens.current_competition: Pretzel's October30 2026 release reports UK authorization after US IND clearance for PX578, a completed healthy-volunteer Phase1, and planned late2026 Phase2 POLARIS. Sponsor statements are not patient efficacy or proof that PX578 equals PZL-A.
new_candidate_screens.decision: make PZL-A the mandatory exact-molecule benchmark; lower priority of generic sulbactam repurposing thesis
new_candidate_screens.proposed_next_proof: Compare authenticated sulbactam with PZL-A in endogenous, patient-derived POLG systems without relying solely on tagged overexpression or artificial depletion. Require feasible free exposure, respiratory function and mtDNA-quality readouts. Advance sulbactam only for a demonstrable advantage or complementary genotype/exposure niche; do not claim first-in-class POLG rescue.
new_candidate_screens.functional_evidence: The 2025 Nature study reports exact-molecule restoration of mtDNA replication and respiration/ATP in patient fibroblasts carrying two compound-heterozygous genotype combinations, with experiment-level n=3. Most cellular rescue follows experimentally induced mtDNA depletion; native established-tissue benefit remains a separate question.

new_candidate_screens.stop_condition: Only artificial tagged/depletion systems improve, feasible exposure fails, or the current comparator answers the proposed need without additional advantage.

existing_candidate_updates.name: BLU3797/PIK3C2B: human-model and assay-transfer delta
existing_candidate_updates.functional_evidence: No new BLU3797 human force result or new independent drug efficacy study was found. Prior mouse and genetic reversal evidence remains; this update changes feasibility and measurement requirements, not efficacy score.

newly_resolved.finding: Coriell GM06813 catalog identifies an MTM1 exon8 frameshift (646delT with nearby648C>A); GM24509 identifies c.1180G>C, p.D394H. They are distinct mutation backgrounds. Patent WO2025085810A2 examples10–12 explicitly describe these fibroblasts being reprogrammed at iXCell, then differentiated into immature myotubes. The catalog cells are fibroblasts, not ready force tissues.

Addgene238834 publicly lists a NanoLuc-PIK3C2B vector. The BLU study used tailored fusion constructs and an in-house tracer. The public vector supplies one component; the exact published NanoBRET assay is not turnkey.

The main article discloses stereodefined identity and key final steps from advanced Intermediate3, with analytical data. End-to-end starting-material synthesis was not verified; narrow the old claim of a complete public route accordingly.

still_unresolved.finding: No human/mouse plasma fu, unbound muscle/brain partition coefficient or chronic exposure-linked EEG/liver margin was located. Total plasma with serum-adjusted cellular potency cannot supply those values.

Reported target-engagement potency for PIK3C2B is68.2nM; the enumerated live-cell panel omits PIK3C2A and class-I PIK3CB. Broad single-concentration kinome screening does not substitute for these cellular curves.

BLU2720 is weaker, not an assumed inactive control. PI-701 has limited selectivity characterization; PITCOIN compounds center on C2alpha and should not be mislabeled C2beta comparators. Genetic PIK3C2B perturbation is the cleaner publicly defined orthogonal route.

existing_candidate_updates.genetic_safety_delta: The primary epilepsy study explicitly notes reduced penetrance, including an unaffected transmitting father, and one variant retaining catalytic activity. This limits deterministic interpretation. Heterozygous loss-of-function and induced-seizure susceptibility still make neuronal target inhibition a specific hazard; constitutional genetics does not provide a drug concentration threshold.
existing_candidate_updates.exact_entity: BLU3797 article-defined S stereoisomer, authenticated independently; only then interpret either supplier lot or custom material.
existing_candidate_updates.model_route: Initial Curi p.L463S 3D line plus separately qualified GM06813 frameshift and GM24509 p.D394H derived models. Each requires identity, maturation, isogenic restoration/correction control, and pre-randomization stable force deficit. Distinct catalog genotypes are not three validated human responses.
existing_candidate_updates.decision: Retain first neuro/muscle bounded-proof priority. Raise operational confidence in a no-outreach model route, but do not raise biological maturity or call S-tier.
existing_candidate_updates.ranking_delta: More concrete and less dependent on unique investigator material; narrower claims about exact chemical route and assay transfer. No evidence-based reason to replace BLU as first proof solely because P2 is new.
existing_candidate_updates.deciding_proof: Before scaling efficacy, release an assay/material qualification package: authenticate BLU stereochemistry and impurity profile; build/validate public genetic and engagement controls; measure free medium and tissue exposure and C2alpha/PIK3CB cellular selectivity. Then test post-deficit force/fatigue in independent MTM1 backgrounds and compare the same free-exposure range in neurons and hepatobiliary tissue. Use target knockdown/restoration to distinguish target failure from compound failure.
existing_candidate_updates.advance_condition: Reproducible established human-force rescue with target concordance and a usable neural/hepatic separation; exact material and model can be independently rebuilt.
existing_candidate_updates.stop_condition: Qualified MTM1-restorable models fail to recover with engaged PIK3C2B inhibition; required muscle engagement conflicts with neuronal/liver function; or model/assay failure prevents an interpretable test. A compound-specific failure may justify a separately scored peripheral chemistry project, not automatic carry-forward of BLU efficacy.

existing_candidate_updates.name: Potency-qualified alpha-1-antitrypsin ex vivo lung conditioning
existing_candidate_updates.novelty: Refinement of existing BE-N01/AAT_EVLP; not counted as a new candidate.
existing_candidate_updates.exactarticle: Plasma-derived AAT with Zemaira as a defined manufactured starting product; final perfusate composition and functional potency specification proposed, not yet validated.
existing_candidate_updates.function: Existing human report: eight donor blocks split into paired lungs, 12-hour physiology. Exact numerical benefit and dose not primary-verified from full methods.
existing_candidate_updates.treatment_window: Injured-donor conditioning/peri-reperfusion protection; durable reversal of recipient graft failure unproven.
new_evidence_delta: Patent pilot compares 10 mg/mL AAT with saline; protein/oncotic matching is unestablished.
Current label defines approximately 50 mg/mL reconstitution, mannitol/phosphate excipients, functional elastase-neutralizing potency, and a three-hour postreconstitution use interval.

Calculated contribution from a 50 mg/mL stock at 10 mg/mL final: stock fraction 20%, mannitol approximately 24–34 mM, phosphate 3–4 mM. This is a proposed formulation calculation, not the 2026 paper's recipe.
Canadian trial record last updated July 2026 lists UHN randomized Zemaira lung-transplant prevention trial as not yet recruiting; ex vivo-only route not established by record.
existing_candidate_updates.decision: Retain leading organ proof; make matching, potency and postwashout function decisive.
existing_candidate_updates.decidingproof: Qualified active AAT exposure compared with optimized perfusate matched for physical composition, followed by washout and recipient-blood challenge, then ex vivo-only transplant validation.
existing_candidate_updates.go: Meaningful donor-level oxygenation/compliance benefit survives matching and washout, with interpretable recipient carryover and consistent lot potency.
existing_candidate_updates.stop: Formulation matching explains benefit, drug-free reperfusion erases it, or molecular changes fail to translate to graft function.
existing_candidate_updates.material_route: Manufactured starting product known; neither EVLP finished-product qualification nor actual supply secured.
existing_candidate_updates.rights_pipeline: CSL organ-perfusion family and UHN clinical program identified; no blanket commercial-clearance claim.
existing_candidate_updates.retrievallimits: 2026 full methods unavailable. Patent 10 mg/mL and pig 3 mg/mL doses must not be assigned to the human paper. A survival-model abstract's existence does not establish durability.

new_evidence: A 2020 PLC-zeta-null sperm study directly compared recombinant human PLC-zeta, strontium, ionomycin and TPEN. It reported 326 MII oocytes across control and treatment conditions; that is not 326 independent donors. Recombinant PLC-zeta and ionomycin blastocyst rates were 41% and 50%, respectively, and a superiority benefit for recombinant PLC-zeta was not established. This is not proof of inferiority or equivalence.

September 2026 R385Q mechanistic work found retained recombinant catalytic activity and normal calcium oscillations after cRNA injection into mouse oocytes, supporting protein insufficiency rather than an obligatory catalytic defect in that variant. This is not a recombinant-protein treatment trial.

A 2024 39-couple retrospective ionophore study included 10 PLC-zeta-deficient patients with a fertilization improvement signal. Its historical comparison does not establish an unbiased treatment effect, but demonstrates that PLC-zeta deficiency alone does not identify an ionophore-refractory niche.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: The physiological-oscillation narrative does not establish product differentiation. Reagent identity remains buildable from public sequence, but an independent developmental advantage or a functionally confirmed refractory subgroup must be earned before top-tier investment.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: Use a sequence-defined, lot-qualified reagent in a donor-clustered comparison against ionomycin. Prespecify normal development rather than activation alone, and test the intended deficient subgroup. Continue only for a reproducible developmental or handling advantage; do not assume superiority from oscillation shape.

existing_candidate_updates.decision: retain conditional proof; strengthen formulation and comparator gates
new_evidence: The primary paper reports a corneal-sensitivity improvement and day-7 nerve measurements in the steroid-delayed model; Figure 8 labels n=3. This adds a functional signal beyond nerve staining but remains a small, single-paper result.

The paper reports a critical aggregation concentration of 205 micromolar, a 0.4 wt% formulation, and cell assays at 10-400 nanomolar with peak proliferation at 50 nanomolar. The active species and relevant free exposure therefore cannot be inferred from nominal gel concentration alone.
Single-motif, scrambled-peptide and blank-hydrogel controls exist in the delayed-healing experiment. It would be inaccurate to say the paper used no material controls.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: A practical reduced-frequency repair product remains plausible. The intended product should be the exact biotin-D-Phe peptide gel, with assembly, release, optical quality and functional potency qualified together. Small delayed-model groups and a missing insulin comparison prevent promotion to a development-ready winner.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: First test two independently prepared peptide lots for identity, assembly, release and clarity in tear-like medium. Then compare the exact formulation with validated topical insulin, free IGF-1 and a characterized vehicle in paired donor corneal tissue under washout. Advance on durable barrier/adhesion recovery with a meaningful dosing or functional advantage, and separately validate sensation in a relevant innervated persistent-defect model. Do not call an ex vivo cornea a sensation model.
existing_candidate_updates.remaining_retrieval_limit: Full supplementary methods, delayed-treatment biological-unit accounting, and all dosing/randomization/blinding details were not verified. Indexed primary text and Figure 8 legend were retrieved; this is not a claim of complete supplemental audit.

existing_candidate_updates.decision: retain focused human iron-transfer proof; strengthen active comparator
new_evidence: The 2022 hinokitiol study's human macrophages came from three ferroportin-disease patients with G80S, N174I or A77D variants. These findings support a donor-based ferroportin-defect model, not exact-FeM efficacy in those donors.

A separate 2023 primary study found iron-loaded deferiprone supported human cultured-red-cell hemoglobinization and oxygen-binding behavior while recycling transferrin. In that culture setting, hinokitiol was less effective than deferiprone/deferoxamine in supporting proliferation and transferrin reloading. That is a different task from extracting macrophage iron under hepcidin restriction.

A 2026 public neurodegeneration patent application explicitly depicts FeM-1269, providing additional public-rights context. It does not establish a human clinical program or clear rights for the proposed anemia use.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: The decisive advantage must lie in accessing sequestered iron and delivering it usefully, rather than merely supplying iron to erythroblasts. The available human-culture comparator makes a vague 'better iron carrier' claim too weak.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: Separate macrophage extraction from erythroid delivery. Use isotope-tracked donor iron, persistent hepcidin restriction, holo-transferrin as a positive control, and a defined iron-loaded-deferiprone delivery benchmark. Match delivered iron where the question is erythroid uptake, and keep loaded and unloaded chelator conditions distinct. Require heme incorporation and maturation without harmful labile-iron redistribution. A result limited to the delivery arm is insufficient for the inflammatory-anemia thesis.

existing_candidate_updates.decision: retain independent-replication reserve; no automatic evidence upgrade
new_evidence: A targeted current search again recovered the 2020 injected-protein study and the 2024 CPTX-expressing-cell study, without a separately verified independent delayed-contusion replication of the exact injected protein. This is a bounded search result, not proof that no other study exists.
Primary methods specify local intraspinal injection. A later review describes intrathecal dosing; the review is not sufficient evidence for substituting a different delivery route.
The current company named CPTx develops DNA-based genetic medicines. A shared name is not evidence that it owns or develops the synaptic-organizer protein.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: A new synthesis of the public research protein plus an independent delayed-injury function/safety experiment remains concrete. Existing reviews and a separate cell product do not close that decision. Delivery and persistent excitation remain substantive product issues.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: Use the published protein and local route as the reference. Before a larger behavioral study, establish tissue distribution and a window between useful evoked transmission and spontaneous/pathological activation. Then evaluate delayed incomplete contusion with baseline stratification, blinded coordinated function and matched rehabilitation. Treat intrathecal delivery, tag removal or a carrier as separate comparability changes.

cross_challenges.finding: One-patient human data use parent8015 mixture; four-patient earlier work uses Chimera C. Exact P2 evidence is in animal systems. Small-n nonsignificance versus WT is not equivalence.
cross_challenges.proof_change: Measure low-dose free exposure directly and separate nerve-mediated from directly stimulated muscle force; acute100mg/kg motility data do not establish PD coverage at chronic1-10mg/kg doses.

cross_challenges.finding: Published PBS pH7.4 solubility is0.23 micromolar, versus5 micromolar nominal concentration in the Darier assay (about22-fold). This is a formulation/exposure uncertainty, not proof the assay is invalid or a ceiling on skin exposure.
cross_challenges.biological_failure_mode: Residual SERCA may be inactivated in an established lesion. Junction-assembly protection may not translate to delayed repair.
cross_challenges.comparator: NAC protects mechanical adhesion in the same primary disease model. CDN1163 is a separate same-target comparator; no superiority follows from next-generation wording.

cross_challenges.finding: Primary abstract supports preservation in declined human lungs during perfusion. Delayed rescue, exact human dose/n and recipient benefit are not verified.
cross_challenges.material_boundary: Free base CAS2271358-64-4 and HCl CAS2271358-65-5 are not interchangeable lot specifications; exact human-study formulation remains to be reconciled.
cross_challenges.competitive_boundary: University explicitly identifies FXT-001 as FiriX lead. Count as an active external program and conditional differentiated proof, not unclaimed material.

family_counting_rules: 8015-P2, parent8015, trans-MiM111 and ChimeraC appear in one mitofusin family record and are not independent discoveries or interchangeable evidence.

Prior BLU refinement is not a new candidate.
Surlorian and ignaseclant are new to the reviewed inventory but active external programs/benchmarks, not newly available assets.

new_candidates.name: 8015-P2 mitofusin activation for MFN2-CMT2A

alias_search_basis.scope: 622 coverage_records and 30 generated_concepts.proposals in research/portfolio-register.json; supplementary rg across ddiscov_snapshot and round2 files
alias_search_basis.caveat: New to reviewed inventory is not a claim of new invention, patent novelty, biological novelty, or unowned asset.

new_candidates.exact_entity: The slower-eluting chiral SFC peak 8015-P2 defined in Weigele et al. 2024, with the article/supplement stereochemical and analytical reference; do not substitute parent 8015 mixture, MiM111, Chimera C, or generic piperine.
new_candidates.functional_evidence: Exact P2 improves established sensory/motor phenotypes in approximately 50-week-old Mfn2 T105M knock-in mice and rats. The 2026 rat study randomized and blinded testing; dose cohorts contain four rats per dose and seven WT comparators. The 10 mg/kg cohort stopped at four weeks after normal-range values. A separate acute motility assay used 100 mg/kg, not the chronic dose.

biological_sample_counts.2026_rat_dose_response: 4 animals/dose; WT reference 7; counts of other cohorts differ and were not imputed
biological_sample_counts.2024_mouse_exact_P2: Histology 4 mice/group and synapse counts 3/group; functional panel n values reside in the figures and were not independently transcribed
biological_sample_counts.2024_human_8015_mixture: One T105M patient background; independent culture experiments are not donors
biological_sample_counts.2020_human_Chimera_C: Four patient backgrounds; chemically different article
biological_sample_counts.2020_MiM111_mouse: 6 mice/group; sample target reduced from planned 15 because effect was larger than anticipated

new_candidates.evidence_boundaries: Human evidence uses the 8015 mixture (2024) or Chimera C (2020), not exact P2. Multiple species largely share the research group and T105M allele. Failure to differ from WT is not an equivalence test. The 8015 mixture binding and brain-partition values cannot be assigned to P2.
new_candidates.material_route: 2024 public synthesis scheme and chiral separation permit a specified custom-chemistry brief. 2026 material was a company gift, not demonstrated catalog stock; authenticate stereochemistry, peak identity and purity before interpretation.
new_candidates.exposure_and_safety: P2 glucuronidation and enterohepatic recirculation are described. Quantitative human unbound target-tissue exposure and a chronic functional safety margin remain unresolved. Do not treat a limited target panel divided by fusion EC50 as a clinical therapeutic index.
new_candidates.current_pipeline_and_rights: FDA orphan designation dated 2025-10-06 is for a generic small-molecule mitofusin activator sponsored by Mitochondria in Motion Discovery, not proof that P2 has clinical clearance. WO2023196340 includes a displayed granted US family member US12396968B2; ceased PCT status does not establish open rights.
new_candidates.decision: Advance independent bounded human functional proof; strongest new neuro/muscle lead in this round, below fully qualified S-tier.
new_candidates.ranking_delta: New high-priority challenge to the existing shortlist. Retain BLU3797 as first proof priority pending cross-workstream comparison; P2 merits its own staged experiment rather than another literature-only watchlist.
new_candidates.deciding_proof: After a stable deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations.
new_candidates.advance_condition: Replicated recovery of established useful human function with exact P2, not only mitochondrial morphology, at an interpretable tissue exposure and tolerable functional window. A T105M-only result narrows the claim instead of supporting all CMT2A.
new_candidates.stop_condition: No P2 functional benefit in genetically rescuable models; parent mixture alone works; apparent benefit comes from hyperexcitability or generalized tissue growth; required exposure impairs healthy tissue or mitochondrial quality control.

new_candidates.name: Pip8b2-conjugated Dnm2 exon-6 PMO for DNM2 centronuclear myopathy

alias_search_basis.scope: 622 coverage_records and 30 generated_concepts.proposals in research/portfolio-register.json; supplementary rg across ddiscov_snapshot and round2 files
alias_search_basis.caveat: New to reviewed inventory is not a claim of new invention, patent novelty, biological novelty, or unowned asset.

new_candidates.exact_entity: Published murine PMO6 sequence GGCCTCAAACCTCCGCTATACCTGG conjugated to the article-defined Pip8b2 peptide Ac-RXRRBRRYQFLIRBRXRB-OH (B beta-alanine; X aminohexanoyl). Linkage and analytical specification must follow the methods; this is not yet a selected human oligo.
new_candidates.functional_evidence: In Dnm2 R369W/+ mice, three 12.5 mg/kg intravenous doses at 8, 10 and 12 weeks improved specific force at 16 weeks from 11.2 to 15.6 mN/mg; disease-control n=5 and treated n=4. Late treatment did not correct fibre size. Muscle DNM2 fell without measured liver/kidney downregulation. Total Dnm2 RNA did not fall substantially in vivo: do not claim demonstrated nonsense-mediated decay.

biological_sample_counts.late_force: Disease PCtrl 5, disease PPMO6 4, WT PCtrl 4, WT PPMO6 4
biological_sample_counts.early_liver_necrosis: 1/9 in both disease-control and treated groups; no causal inference from this sparse finding

new_candidates.evidence_boundaries: Short mouse hepatic findings do not establish human PPMO chronic safety; the earlier DYN101 chemistry looked tolerable in mice but failed clinically on hepatic/hematological tolerability. The Brain PPMO6 code is not interchangeable with PPMO6 numbering in the later human patent.
new_candidates.material_route: Exact mouse sequence/peptide and synthesis methods are public. Human-targeted exon-skipping sequences are disclosed separately in WO2025085810A2, but selecting a human product and proving functional rescue are additional work.
new_candidates.exposure_and_safety: Define muscle protein knockdown against liver, renal, cardiac and innate-immune effects. Skeletal-muscle targeting and transient dosing are hypotheses to establish for a human sequence, not properties inherited from a mouse dose.
new_candidates.current_pipeline_and_rights: Sarepta/Murdoch patent WO2025085810A2 demonstrates human MTM1 patient-derived immature myotube transcript/protein knockdown; not human force or the same test article. Existing DNM2-directed rights and DYN101 comparator make product differentiation explicit.
new_candidates.decision: Advance a bounded human-sequence/functional translation package; second strongest new lead. Do not call the mouse construct a ready human asset.
new_candidates.ranking_delta: Adds a mechanistically distinct, publicly specified force-rescue route beside PIK3C2B. Does not inherit BLU efficacy or MTM1 applicability from a DNM2 R369W mouse.
new_candidates.deciding_proof: Select and authenticate a publicly specified human DNM2 splice oligo; verify its exact splice product and absence of persistent harmful truncated protein. In mature DNM2-mutant human muscle, compare post-deficit force and fatigue with a sequence-matched non-targeting conjugate, unconjugated PMO and an orthogonal DNM2 reduction control at matched protein suppression. Evaluate MTM1 muscle separately only if the intended indication expands.
new_candidates.advance_condition: Human sequence yields reproducible force rescue after disease establishment, with durable exposure-linked muscle suppression and a credible separation from off-muscle or conjugate toxicity.
new_candidates.stop_condition: Only transcript/protein change; no useful force recovery; toxicity appears at the degree of suppression required; human targeting requires a materially different conjugate whose effects have not been qualified.

new_candidates.name: CKD504 for GARS1-CMT2D

alias_search_basis.scope: 622 coverage_records and 30 generated_concepts.proposals in research/portfolio-register.json; supplementary rg across ddiscov_snapshot and round2 files
alias_search_basis.caveat: New to reviewed inventory is not a claim of new invention, patent novelty, biological novelty, or unowned asset.

new_candidates.exact_entity: Published clinical code CKD504/CKD-504. An unambiguous code-to-structure mapping and independently reproducible test article were not established in this review.
new_candidates.functional_evidence: CKD504 at 1–2 micromolar improved MEA activity in engineered P234KY and one patient P724H neuronal background. The engineered cells received drug through 15 days of maturation, and WT firing increased too; single-cell evoked action-potential waveforms were not deficient.

candidate_updates.name: Potency-qualified alpha-1-antitrypsin ex vivo lung conditioning
candidate_updates.novelty: Refinement of existing BE-N01/AAT_EVLP; not counted as a new candidate.
candidate_updates.exactarticle: Plasma-derived AAT with Zemaira as a defined manufactured starting product; final perfusate composition and functional potency specification proposed, not yet validated.
candidate_updates.function: Existing human report: eight donor blocks split into paired lungs, 12-hour physiology. Exact numerical benefit and dose not primary-verified from full methods.
candidate_updates.treatment_window: Injured-donor conditioning/peri-reperfusion protection; durable reversal of recipient graft failure unproven.
new_evidence_delta: Patent pilot compares 10 mg/mL AAT with saline; protein/oncotic matching is unestablished.
Current label defines approximately 50 mg/mL reconstitution, mannitol/phosphate excipients, functional elastase-neutralizing potency, and a three-hour postreconstitution use interval.

Calculated contribution from a 50 mg/mL stock at 10 mg/mL final: stock fraction 20%, mannitol approximately 24–34 mM, phosphate 3–4 mM. This is a proposed formulation calculation, not the 2026 paper's recipe.
Canadian trial record last updated July 2026 lists UHN randomized Zemaira lung-transplant prevention trial as not yet recruiting; ex vivo-only route not established by record.
candidate_updates.decision: Retain leading organ proof; make matching, potency and postwashout function decisive.
candidate_updates.decidingproof: Qualified active AAT exposure compared with optimized perfusate matched for physical composition, followed by washout and recipient-blood challenge, then ex vivo-only transplant validation.
candidate_updates.go: Meaningful donor-level oxygenation/compliance benefit survives matching and washout, with interpretable recipient carryover and consistent lot potency.
candidate_updates.stop: Formulation matching explains benefit, drug-free reperfusion erases it, or molecular changes fail to translate to graft function.
candidate_updates.material_route: Manufactured starting product known; neither EVLP finished-product qualification nor actual supply secured.
candidate_updates.rights_pipeline: CSL organ-perfusion family and UHN clinical program identified; no blanket commercial-clearance claim.
candidate_updates.retrievallimits: 2026 full methods unavailable. Patent 10 mg/mL and pig 3 mg/mL doses must not be assigned to the human paper. A survival-model abstract's existence does not establish durability.

Independent2019 study found no protein-solubilization improvement in human lens material with25-hydroxycholesterol; assay and sample differences prevent declaring perfect direct replication.

new_candidates.stop: Stop if only subjective opacity scoring or protein-solubilization assays move, or matched human lenses remain unresponsive.

unfinished_public_source_gaps: Dantrolene EUCT actual results document content not retrieved.
KUS121 phase2 numerical results not retrieved.
NDC-9009 exact patent-claim mapping and free skin exposure unresolved.

cross_domain.source_warning: Refs are retrieval identifiers; parent must reopen sources before citing them in final response. Supplier listings identify routes, not authenticated material, stock, licensing or clinical usability.

integrating_review.scope: New decision-changing findings for existing shortlist and POLG comparator; no outreach or experimental execution.

new_evidence: A 2020 PLC-zeta-null sperm study directly compared recombinant human PLC-zeta, strontium, ionomycin and TPEN. It reported 326 MII oocytes across control and treatment conditions; that is not 326 independent donors. Recombinant PLC-zeta and ionomycin blastocyst rates were 41% and 50%, respectively, and a superiority benefit for recombinant PLC-zeta was not established. This is not proof of inferiority or equivalence.

September 2026 R385Q mechanistic work found retained recombinant catalytic activity and normal calcium oscillations after cRNA injection into mouse oocytes, supporting protein insufficiency rather than an obligatory catalytic defect in that variant. This is not a recombinant-protein treatment trial.

A 2024 39-couple retrospective ionophore study included 10 PLC-zeta-deficient patients with a fertilization improvement signal. Its historical comparison does not establish an unbiased treatment effect, but demonstrates that PLC-zeta deficiency alone does not identify an ionophore-refractory niche.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: The physiological-oscillation narrative does not establish product differentiation. Reagent identity remains buildable from public sequence, but an independent developmental advantage or a functionally confirmed refractory subgroup must be earned before top-tier investment.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: Use a sequence-defined, lot-qualified reagent in a donor-clustered comparison against ionomycin. Prespecify normal development rather than activation alone, and test the intended deficient subgroup. Continue only for a reproducible developmental or handling advantage; do not assume superiority from oscillation shape.

existing_candidate_updates.decision: retain conditional proof; strengthen formulation and comparator gates
new_evidence: The primary paper reports a corneal-sensitivity improvement and day-7 nerve measurements in the steroid-delayed model; Figure 8 labels n=3. This adds a functional signal beyond nerve staining but remains a small, single-paper result.

The paper reports a critical aggregation concentration of 205 micromolar, a 0.4 wt% formulation, and cell assays at 10-400 nanomolar with peak proliferation at 50 nanomolar. The active species and relevant free exposure therefore cannot be inferred from nominal gel concentration alone.
Single-motif, scrambled-peptide and blank-hydrogel controls exist in the delayed-healing experiment. It would be inaccurate to say the paper used no material controls.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: A practical reduced-frequency repair product remains plausible. The intended product should be the exact biotin-D-Phe peptide gel, with assembly, release, optical quality and functional potency qualified together. Small delayed-model groups and a missing insulin comparison prevent promotion to a development-ready winner.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: First test two independently prepared peptide lots for identity, assembly, release and clarity in tear-like medium. Then compare the exact formulation with validated topical insulin, free IGF-1 and a characterized vehicle in paired donor corneal tissue under washout. Advance on durable barrier/adhesion recovery with a meaningful dosing or functional advantage, and separately validate sensation in a relevant innervated persistent-defect model. Do not call an ex vivo cornea a sensation model.
existing_candidate_updates.remaining_retrieval_limit: Full supplementary methods, delayed-treatment biological-unit accounting, and all dosing/randomization/blinding details were not verified. Indexed primary text and Figure 8 legend were retrieved; this is not a claim of complete supplemental audit.

existing_candidate_updates.decision: retain focused human iron-transfer proof; strengthen active comparator
new_evidence: The 2022 hinokitiol study's human macrophages came from three ferroportin-disease patients with G80S, N174I or A77D variants. These findings support a donor-based ferroportin-defect model, not exact-FeM efficacy in those donors.

A separate 2023 primary study found iron-loaded deferiprone supported human cultured-red-cell hemoglobinization and oxygen-binding behavior while recycling transferrin. In that culture setting, hinokitiol was less effective than deferiprone/deferoxamine in supporting proliferation and transferrin reloading. That is a different task from extracting macrophage iron under hepcidin restriction.

A 2026 public neurodegeneration patent application explicitly depicts FeM-1269, providing additional public-rights context. It does not establish a human clinical program or clear rights for the proposed anemia use.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: The decisive advantage must lie in accessing sequestered iron and delivering it usefully, rather than merely supplying iron to erythroblasts. The available human-culture comparator makes a vague 'better iron carrier' claim too weak.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: Separate macrophage extraction from erythroid delivery. Use isotope-tracked donor iron, persistent hepcidin restriction, holo-transferrin as a positive control, and a defined iron-loaded-deferiprone delivery benchmark. Match delivered iron where the question is erythroid uptake, and keep loaded and unloaded chelator conditions distinct. Require heme incorporation and maturation without harmful labile-iron redistribution. A result limited to the delivery arm is insufficient for the inflammatory-anemia thesis.

existing_candidate_updates.decision: retain independent-replication reserve; no automatic evidence upgrade
new_evidence: A targeted current search again recovered the 2020 injected-protein study and the 2024 CPTX-expressing-cell study, without a separately verified independent delayed-contusion replication of the exact injected protein. This is a bounded search result, not proof that no other study exists.
Primary methods specify local intraspinal injection. A later review describes intrathecal dosing; the review is not sufficient evidence for substituting a different delivery route.
The current company named CPTx develops DNA-based genetic medicines. A shared name is not evidence that it owns or develops the synaptic-organizer protein.
existing_candidate_updates.reasoning: A new synthesis of the public research protein plus an independent delayed-injury function/safety experiment remains concrete. Existing reviews and a separate cell product do not close that decision. Delivery and persistent excitation remain substantive product issues.
existing_candidate_updates.proposed_next_proof: Use the published protein and local route as the reference. Before a larger behavioral study, establish tissue distribution and a window between useful evoked transmission and spontaneous/pathological activation. Then evaluate delayed incomplete contusion with baseline stratification, blinded coordinated function and matched rehabilitation. Treat intrathecal delivery, tag removal or a carrier as separate comparability changes.

# Independent challenge: FXT-001 / UAMC-3203 in donor-organ perfusion

**Reviewer:** neuromuscular workstream, independent of the organ recommendation. **Evidence cut:** 4 November 2026. Primary abstract, publisher summary, investigator institutional sources and exact supplier forms checked. The large author PDF was not retried, and its full methods are not represented as inspected.

## Decision

**A credible organ-preservation lead, but the reviewed public evidence does not establish a delayed-repair or post-transplant benefit.** An early-perfusion preservation product can be valuable without reversing pre-existing injury. The immediate task is to decide whether a new experiment adds a differentiated product claim beyond an active external program, not to discard preservation because it is prevention.

## What the primary source supports

The Cell paper reports an early, transient lipid-peroxidation signal in human liver transplantation; protection in porcine liver/lung perfusion; and preserved viability in split-perfused declined human lungs while controls deteriorate. The abstract separately identifies FXT-002/003 as optimized analogues. It supplies no human-donor count, exact perfusate formulation, delayed-start comparison or recipient outcome. Those details cannot be reconstructed from the title or transferred from the analogue experiments. [F1]

The investigator university describes reduced lung fluid accumulation and retained elasticity, and an observational analysis of 116 liver recipients. Those recipients are not 116 drug-treated transplant patients. The institution's broad promotional statement that FXT-001 is suitable for clinical use is not regulatory clearance or demonstrated clinical safety. [F2]

**Decision-changing boundary:** “treated declined lungs deteriorated less during perfusion” and “drug restored a deteriorating lung after injury was established” require different experimental timelines. Only the former is established by the retrieved abstract. If the organ team has primary full-method timing, preserve that specific source; this check does not independently verify it. The relevant human biological n remains unknown in this independent abstract-only assessment.

## Exact article and active development

MCE explicitly distinguishes **UAMC-3203/FXT-001 free base, HY-112909, CAS2271358-64-4**, from **hydrochloride, HY-112909A, CAS2271358-65-5**. This supports a public research-material route but does not identify which form, vehicle or lot produced the human-organ result. Any proposed perfusate must specify active-moiety equivalents, salt, vehicle, solubility and circuit stability. A catalog purity claim is not a received-lot authentication result. [F3–F4]

The university's current spin-off page identifies **FiriX Therapeutics** and names **FXT-001 as its lead**. The article also discloses founders and related patents. It would therefore be wrong to pitch this as an inactive, unowned opportunity based on catalog access or the absence of a clinical-trial result. These facts do not prevent an independent scientific test; they increase the need for an incremental proposition. [F1, F5]

## The proof that would change my decision

Two useful questions should be kept separate:

1. **Preservation product:** Does a specified, authenticated FXT-001 formulation preserve donor-organ performance beyond optimized perfusion, with durable benefit after drug washout and acceptable residual recipient exposure? This should include the strongest relevant active comparator, not simply worsening vehicle lungs.
2. **Repair product:** After a prespecified physiological injury threshold is documented, does delayed FXT-001 addition reverse dysfunction? It needs a delayed-start arm and recovery relative to its own injured baseline. Failure here would narrow the claim to preservation rather than automatically invalidate an early-treatment product.

For either, organ-level gas exchange, compliance, vascular behavior and edema/weight should be interpreted together. A favorable oxidative marker alone is insufficient. Keep donor-pair counts separate from repeated perfusion measurements and do not assign optimized-analogue PK or safety to FXT-001. A later transplantation experiment would address durability under a recipient environment; ex vivo stability does not answer that question.

**Advance** a bounded, differentiated formulation/timing/washout proof if the full primary methods and exact article can be specified. **Hold S-tier promotion** while post-implant translation, exact test form and the independent value proposition remain unresolved. **Stop a duplicate program pitch** if it only repeats the already public early-perfusion result. None of these scientific decisions requires outreach.

## Sources

- **F1:** [Veeckmans et al., Cell 2026, PMID42105762](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42105762/), DOI10.1016/j.cell.2026.04.024. [Publisher summary](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0092867426004599). Same study, not independent sources of efficacy.
- **F2:** [Investigator university release, 8 May2026](https://blog.uantwerpen.be/fbd/new-class-of-drugs-protects-donor-organs-during-transplantation/). Institutional primary communication, not a replacement for complete methods.
- **F3:** [MCE UAMC-3203 free-base catalog](https://www.medchemexpress.com/us/en/UAMC-3203.html).
- **F4:** [MCE UAMC-3203 hydrochloride catalog](https://www.medchemexpress.com/uamc-3203-hydrochloride.html). [Catalog comparison](https://www.medchemexpress.com/search.html?fa=&fp=&ft=&q=FXT001).
- **F5:** [University of Antwerp spin-off register](https://www.uantwerpen.be/en/about-uantwerp/faculties/faculty-of-science/research/spin-offs/), ; [science-park FiriX profile](https://www.wetenschapsparkuantwerpen.be/en/home/firix-therapeutics/).

# Independent challenge: exact 8015-P2 for MFN2-CMT2A

**4 November2026. Decision: retain as a high-priority functional-proof opportunity; do not call the human bridge established or the result S-tier.** The parent team's proposed exact-P2, post-onset human neuromuscular experiment addresses a real gap. It should be strengthened by exposure measurement, human donor/genotype replication and a design separating neuronal from direct muscle effects.

## Source facts that must remain attached to the claim

### 2024 mouse and human-cell paper

The human fibroblast and reprogrammed-motor-neuron figures used **8015**, before stereoisomer separation, from **one T105M patient**. Their endpoints were mitochondrial morphology/polarization and motility. Pure P2 was the slower-eluting chiral-SFC fraction; it was more potent than P1. Exact-P2 mouse sensory-neuron work used100nM for48h; the late-disease knock-in mouse experiment began around50weeks and used50mg/kg daily for6weeks. PK experiments had small n and identified enterohepatic recirculation. The same research organization supplied compounds under an MTA. These are not patient neuromuscular-force results and are not multiple independent human donors. [2024 primary paper, PMID39284622](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11493442/); refs ``, ``, ``.

### 2026 rat paper

The rats were treated after baseline phenotyping at50weeks; randomization and blinded functional/pathology assessment are reported. The regimen was **oral treatment Monday–Friday**, not seven days weekly. Dose-response arms used n4/group and WT n7. A100mg/kg acute experiment measured nerve-mitochondrial motility, whereas chronic efficacy used1–10mg/kg. The paper defined some “normalization” by nonsignificance versus WT; this is not equivalence testing. Improved CMAP, strength, sensation and MRI muscle volume support useful function. The paper also argues that direct muscle repair contributes to the rapid response. A10µM off-target panel found59% MAO-A inhibition; the panel is not comprehensive systemic safety. Same-group authorship and company interest limit independent replication. [2026 primary paper, PMID42653381](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13513834/); refs ``, ``, ``, ``, ``.

### Exact identity and public rights record

The later primary description identifies P2 as the trans-(1R,2R)-cyclopropyl enantiomer. Its full chemical name is independently printed in a2026 worm study: (1r,4r)-4-hydroxy-N-[(1R,2R)-2-(4-phenylbutyl)cyclopropyl]cyclohexane-1-carboxamide. The2024 abbreviation for undifferentiated8015 must not be copied blindly as a P2 identity. The worm study adds an exact-compound source, not human-CMT validation. [Primary source](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13664537/), ref ``.

The cited patent family WO2023196340A1 has an issued US family member, **US12396968B2**, granted26August2025, plus a continuation. A “ceased” PCT page is not proof that the compound is unprotected. Claim mapping was not completed, and no freedom-to-operate conclusion is offered. [Issued US patent](https://patents.google.com/patent/US12396968B2/en), ref ``; [family record](https://patents.google.com/patent/US20240050386A1/en), ref ``.

## What changes in the proposed proof

| Potential overstatement | Required correction | Experimental implication |
|---|---|---|
| P2 already rescues several human patients | The relevant2024 human data use mixture8015 from one patient | Authenticate pure P2 and test independent donor backgrounds |
| More mitochondrial motility means recovered neuromuscular function | Motility is a mechanistic readout, not force/transmission | Include evoked contraction or qualified neuromuscular transmission |
| Rat outcomes are statistically identical to normal | Nonsignificance at n4 does not establish equivalence | Estimate effect sizes/confidence intervals and prespecify a meaningful restoration margin |
| Strong acute target engagement establishes coverage at low chronic dose | Acute and chronic doses differ markedly | Measure free exposure and target engagement during the effective regimen |
| Two species provide independent replication | Mouse and rat studies share a research group | An independent laboratory/model execution is valuable |
| Rapid force recovery proves axonal regeneration | Direct muscle response can improve integrated output | Separate neuronal, muscle and coculture contributions |
| High selectivity ratio establishes a safety margin | Limited panel and potency ratio cannot establish chronic organ safety | Tie functional exposure to cytotoxicity and relevant off-target/organ assessments |

These qualifications narrow the interpretation without erasing the encouraging late-disease animal results. Unlike a prevention-only hit, P2 has a legitimate established-disease rationale. The most valuable next experiment therefore asks whether its specific chemical identity carries that result into human neuromuscular function.

## Recommended bounded experiment

First qualify a reproducible functional deficit in mature human MFN2-T105M neurons coupled to a competent muscle system. Use independent donor backgrounds and isogenic correction where possible. Replicates within a clone, imaging fields and mitochondria should remain nested observations. If a mature deficit cannot be produced, the model has failed qualification; improved morphology in immature cells should not be relabeled as therapeutic rescue.

Treat after the functional deficit is established. Compare authenticated P2 with vehicle, P1 and the8015 mixture; an earlier chemically distinct mitofusin activator can serve as a pathway comparator. The P1 control is valuable for stereospecificity but cannot substitute for a practical efficacy comparator. Keep concentrations on a measured, unbound exposure scale where feasible and verify that purity/stability persists in the medium.

The primary decision should be restoration of an evoked neuromuscular function with a predefined biologically meaningful margin. Mitochondrial transport, membrane potential and axonal morphology should explain the response rather than determine the outcome alone. Measure persistence and rebound after washout. A response confined to continuous high exposure can still be useful, but it creates a different dosing and safety question than durable recovery.

Use compartment-restricted treatment or separately qualified neuronal and muscle assays to identify the source of recovery. This protects against both errors: crediting a direct muscle effect as axonal regrowth, and dismissing a useful muscle contribution because the original narrative was neuron-centered. Extend to another mechanistically distinct pathogenic MFN2 genotype only after the anchor genotype reproduces; broad CMT2A positioning should not precede that evidence.

**Advance** if pure P2 independently restores the chosen human function after onset, at a plausible exposure with a separable safety window, and with reproducibility across donor backgrounds. The resulting donor-response, exposure and mechanism dataset would be a transferable development milestone.

**Stop or narrow** if only the mixture works; only mitochondrial shape/motility improves; the necessary exposure is implausible; force reflects nonspecific excitation or muscle toxicity; the result depends on one clone; or healthy systems are impaired near the active concentration. If T105M responds but other alleles do not, preserve a genotype-specific opportunity rather than stretching the label.

## Ranking implication

P2 may outrank NDC-9009 on breadth of established-animal functional rescue, while NDC-9009 has a more local delivery concept and direct patient-skin mechanics. Their uncertainties differ and should not be collapsed into one numeric score. P2's next proof is human neuromuscular function with exact identity and exposure; NDC-9009's is delayed mature-skin repair and a local exposure window. Neither presently establishes an obviously fundable development package, but both support concrete experiments without waiting for owner correspondence.
