new_candidate_screens.name: Alvelestat for pancreas preservation before islet isolation
new_candidate_screens.novelty_basis: No alvelestat/AZD9668 occurrence in the original inventory, round2 generated proposals, or round3 candidate records. Published use is not claimed to be new to science.
new_candidate_screens.exact_entity: Alvelestat (AZD9668/MPH-966), research material from AdooQ in the source study, as an additive to extracellular-type trehalose-Kyoto pancreas-preservation solution.
new_candidate_screens.functional_evidence: A 2022 primary study compared 10 porcine pancreatic isolations per group. Treated pancreata yielded more islets and higher glucose-stimulated insulin function. At a marginal transplanted islet quantity, 11/20 recipient mice reached the study's glycemic criterion versus1/20 controls; each group of20 mice came from10 isolations, two recipients per isolation.
new_candidate_screens.biological_unit: Ten pancreatic donor/isolation units per group; recipient outcomes are nested two per isolation. Twenty recipients are not20 independent drug-treated donor pancreata.
new_candidate_screens.treatment_timing: Preservation of an already procured organ before a prolonged cold-storage/isolation challenge. This is prevention of additional processing injury, not reversal of established diabetes in the donor or regeneration of lost human islets.
new_candidate_screens.comparator: Same preservation workflow without alvelestat. The paper discusses sivelestat and ulinastatin but does not establish head-to-head superiority over an optimized active preservation regimen.
new_candidate_screens.research_material_route: Defined small molecule and named research supplier in the primary methods. No current stock, received lot, salt/formulation equivalence, GMP supply or residual clearance qualification established in this review.
new_candidate_screens.model_route: Porcine pancreas isolation route is described. Human donor-isolation access has not been secured or independently reproduced here.
new_candidate_screens.exposure_product_gap: Need measured residual drug and NE activity through storage, washout and isolation; preserve digestion performance and viable functional yield at scale.
new_candidate_screens.public_commercial_facts: Mereo and Sentynl announced an option/license agreement for alvelestat in AATD lung disease on11August2026, with Phase3 initiation projected for early2027 conditional on option exercise. That is an active external program, not an islet-use license or approval. NIH lists one related graft-rejection application as abandoned; this does not establish global clearance.
new_candidate_screens.decision: Reserve for an independently differentiated islet-manufacturing proof; does not displace the leading programs.
new_candidate_screens.deciding_proof: Test donor-level functional islet yield and sustained glucose-responsive output against optimized preservation plus an active NE-inhibitor comparator, with blinded allocation, explicit recipient clustering and residual-product clearance.
new_candidate_screens.advance_condition: A reproducible human-relevant increase in usable functional islets, or reduced donor/isolation burden, that remains after washout and exceeds the strongest practical comparator.
new_candidate_screens.stop_condition: Higher counts without useful secretion or graft function, no advantage over an existing preservation additive, or residual and processing burdens that erase the gain.

independent_unit.unit: independent transplanted mouse graft/recipient; separate paired human donor blocks
independent_unit.count_boundary: New mouse arm-level sample sizes were not recovered reliably. Neither lung sides nor tissue fields are additional donors.

evidence: Independent 2018 study compared active recombinant AAT with a non-inhibitory reactive-center mutant and albumin during cold preservation. PR3/NE-null recipients were also protected; this strengthens protease-specific causality.

existing_candidate_updates.exact_article: Exact UAMC-3203 chemical form and active-moiety concentration must be fixed; free base and hydrochloride are distinct material records.

independent_challenges.candidate_name: RM4404/WAY-262611 for delayed corneal nerve repair
independent_challenges.conclusion: Useful delayed functional signal merits independent replication. Randomization is reported. The mechanical-injury analysis treats two eyes of a mouse as independent, and its late durability comparisons are often against uninjured animals rather than direct drug-versus-vehicle tests. Supplement S2 supplies explicit drug-versus-vehicle tests, including a one-injured-eye chemical model. Do not claim equivalence to normal or count N22 eye observations as22 mice.
independent_challenges.product_note: Methods describe drug dilution from DMSO stocks into micelles; the high and low drug concentrations imply different DMSO fractions. Drug-free vehicle is described as similarly prepared, but explicit dose-matched solvent composition is not resolved. Treat this as a formulation-control qualification item, not a proven explanation of efficacy.
independent_challenges.deciding_proof: Independent, masked animal-level delayed-treatment replication with characterized formulation and matched vehicle, meaningful active comparator, post-withdrawal sensation, corneal optics and epithelial safety.
independent_challenges.additional_independent_review: A second workstream independently checked the primary paper. Section 2.9 reports blinded secondary imaging review; primary-quantifier and sensory-assessor blinding remain unresolved. At day30 axonal medians357.7 vehicle versus362.1 RM4404 do not demonstrate structural superiority from separate healthy-reference tests. Four days off treatment in the short regimen is not pharmacokinetic washout; do not merge it with the longer mechanical-injury cohort.

new_candidate_screens.candidate: RM4404/WAY-262611 for delayed corneal sensory repair
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: WAY-262611 (CAS 1123231-07-1) in the disclosed Kolliphor HS-15 micellar preparation RM4404; not a new chemical entity.
new_candidate_screens.disease_or_use: Persistent corneal hypoesthesia after stromal nerve injury.

novelty_basis.note: New to this portfolio is not patent novelty or absence of an existing commercial program.

evidence: The mouse mechanical-injury study dosed on days 7–14 and observed sensation to day 30, 16 days after dosing ended. A separate days 5–10 protocol measured day-14 function in mechanical and chemical models; this is four days off treatment, not verified pharmacokinetic washout.
Supplemental S2: day-14 surgical-model medians 4.5 at either dose versus 2.79 vehicle, total N=22 across three arms; chemical-model medians 4.585/4.625 versus 2.040 vehicle, total N=12.

Randomization and blinded secondary imaging review were reported. Primary quantifier and sensory-assessor blinding remain unresolved. Both surgical-model eyes were analyzed as independent; chemical-model injury involved one eye per mouse. Main day-30 tests against healthy controls establish neither equivalence nor a reported direct drug–vehicle contrast.

At day 30, axonal-network medians were 357.7 with vehicle and 362.1 with RM4404 (healthy 394.6). Different significance results against healthy controls do not establish a drug–vehicle structural advantage.
new_candidate_screens.independent_biological_unit: Animal is the biological block. Surgical-model eyes and repeat thresholds are nested; N=22 must not be described as 22 independent mice. Chemical-model N=12 is total across three arms, not 12 treated animals.
limitations: No retrieved independent-laboratory replication, active repair comparator, human tissue efficacy or unbound corneal exposure.
Primary-quantifier and sensory-assessor blinding remain unresolved; section 2.9 does describe blinded secondary reexamination of imaging. The supplemental questionnaire was not recovered.
Stock arithmetic implies 0.2% versus 2% DMSO. The vehicle is called similarly prepared without explicit accounting: qualification ambiguity, not proven confounding.
Stored-particle TEM does not establish chemical potency, release, sterility or shelf life.

readiness.identity: Parent compound and formulation publicly specified.
readiness.material_route: Original Sigma317700 and independent Cayman17704 listing. No qualified lot received or physical stock confirmed.
readiness.model: Public mouse strains and injury model; an independent team must qualify the disease deficit and analysis unit.
readiness.exposure: Nominal topical 20/200 µM; relevant tissue/free exposure unknown.
readiness.rights: UConn intellectual-property disclosure and US provisional application acknowledged; exact status/claim scope not mapped.

new_candidate_screens.verdict: New high-priority reserve for independent functional replication; no S-tier promotion.

new_candidate_screens.stop_or_deprioritize_if: Effect disappears under animal-level analysis or solvent matching, reflects only reflex excitability, has no comparative value, or harms normal tissue.

evidence: Two children received compassionate treatment; one had an opposite-palm vehicle comparison. Re-epithelialization and pain improvement were reported, but the treated palm remained incompletely cornified at week 33.
Patient keratinocyte differentiation improved without reducing p63 aggregates.
Published chemical quality controls and three-week refrigerated formulation stability provide a material starting point.

Time and wound-care effects remain possible; a contralateral control helps one case but does not establish generalizability.
Systemic oncology tolerability cannot qualify chronic exposure of damaged pediatric skin.

existing_candidate_updates.verdict: Retain conditional proof priority; no promotion
evidence_deltas: Both culture variants lie in the SERCA2 actuator domain. Mean protein abundance is about 70% of control; it is not a measured 50%-protein-null model. Calcium imaging in the retrieved section used DD2.
DD5–7 were biopsy immunohistochemistry samples, not additional NDC-treated culture donors.
DD3–4 required Y27632 during maintenance; all DD cultures and CTL1–2 received it for consistency. It was removed 24–36 h before assays, so there is no demonstrated concurrent ROCK-inhibitor confound.

The 2023 healthy-neuron result involved spine-neck morphology at 0.1 µM, with at least 10 neurons / 70 spines from one culture batch. It is not observed skin toxicity; the 2025 intraperitoneal CNS study does not qualify topical exposure.
The Darier paper section titled Solubility assay measures protein detergent solubility, not dissolved NDC-9009.
existing_candidate_updates.decision_implication: Qualify models by measured residual SERCA function and an established, rescuable adhesion/barrier deficit. Total protein and ATP2A2 diagnosis alone do not establish suitability. Link drug exposure to ER refilling and tissue function; keep genotype and donor strata separate.
existing_candidate_updates.advance_if: Delayed mature-epidermis cohesion/barrier benefit exceeds appropriate NAC, CDN1163 and clinical-route comparators at measured exposure while preserving healthy epidermis.
existing_candidate_updates.stop_or_narrow_if: Only junction assembly improves, benefit depends on a stressor/vehicle, no useful comparator margin exists, or the disease state lacks activatable residual protein.

existing_candidate_updates.verdict: Strengthen comparator rationale; actual trial outcomes remain unknown
evidence_deltas: The October 8, 2026 primary abstract reports mitochondrial calcium/respiration and adhesion improvement partly via MCU; full dose and donor denominators were not recovered.
Listing ATP2A2-knockout models does not establish which model showed the adhesion result; no knockout-specific rescue is inferred.

Official registry confirms trial completion in September 2025. A mirror lists SUM-151495 version 2, dated September 8 and submitted September 10, 2026. Actual efficacy, adverse events and actual enrollment remain unread; planned 20 is not actual N.
existing_candidate_updates.decision_implication: Dantrolene provides an alternative calcium/mitochondrial comparator. Oral trial completion establishes neither topical efficacy nor failure. Investigator outreach is not a scientific-selection gate.

comparative_priority_note.APR246_vs_NDC9009: APR-246 has stronger human species/timing evidence and a more concrete published formulation. NDC also lacks mature-lesion rescue and a topical margin; the public record does not establish overall superiority. Small independent qualification of both is justified. Promote APR-246 ahead if durable barrier and a useful margin are established or NDC remains prevention-only.

existing_candidate_updates.name: AAT in donor-lung EVLP
existing_candidate_updates.exact_article: Potency-qualified plasma-derived AAT product in a defined warm-EVLP perfusate; recombinant AAT cold-storage study is supporting mechanism, not identical finished product.

independent_unit.unit: independent transplanted mouse graft/recipient; separate paired human donor blocks
independent_unit.count_boundary: New mouse arm-level sample sizes were not recovered reliably. Neither lung sides nor tissue fields are additional donors.

evidence: Independent 2018 study compared active recombinant AAT with a non-inhibitory reactive-center mutant and albumin during cold preservation. PR3/NE-null recipients were also protected; this strengthens protease-specific causality.
The inspected cold-storage regimen used 1 mg/mL AAT, 18h storage and 4h recipient reperfusion. This is separate from the warm human EVLP experiment.
limitations: Exact 2026 human AAT dose/formulation remains unverified; do not import the mouse dose.
Short post-transplant mouse protection is not long-term recipient outcome or proof of complete drug removal.
Label NE potency alone does not establish PR3 neutralization or activity after warm-circuit exposure.
existing_candidate_updates.verdict: RETAIN_CORE_PRIORITY; mechanistic confidence increases; human formulation and durable-graft gates remain.
existing_candidate_updates.decisive_next_proof: Qualify NE and PR3 inhibition in the actual warm perfusate, then compare AAT with physically matched protein/excipient control and an NE-selective comparator. Require postwashout function under recipient-like reperfusion.
existing_candidate_updates.go_rule: AAT supplies persistent useful gas-transfer/compliance benefit at qualified activity and adds value beyond the simpler comparator.
existing_candidate_updates.stop_rule: Stop the differentiated AAT product thesis if physical matching or the simpler comparator explains the useful effect, or if activity is lost before the intended treatment window.
existing_candidate_updates.material_route: Existing manufactured AAT is a public supply route. No lot, stock, warm-circuit compatibility or clinical product identity has been established here.
existing_candidate_updates.model_readiness: Bench activity qualification can precede scarce organs. Local organ access remains unverified; it is separate from scientific merit.
existing_candidate_updates.rights_and_program: Previously identified CSL/UHN context persists. The independent mechanism does not establish new commercial rights.

existing_candidate_updates.name: FXT-001/UAMC-3203 in graft conditioning
existing_candidate_updates.exact_article: Exact UAMC-3203 chemical form and active-moiety concentration must be fixed; free base and hydrochloride are distinct material records.

independent_unit.unit: organ donor in Cell study; individual animal in independent counter-context studies

evidence: Newly located author dataset is DOI10.17632/n7jbyznw8g.1 and describes NMR/MS data. Its metadata was inspected; spectra/files and donor-level physiology were not.

Independent 2024 APAP work found UAMC-3203 protection associated with Sab/pJNK effects despite little lipid peroxidation. Drug benefit alone therefore cannot identify ferroptosis as the causal injury mechanism.
A randomized rat study beginning treatment 3 days after stroke found mixed cognitive outcomes, including worse aversive learning.
limitations: APAP and repeated systemic post-stroke exposure do not demonstrate toxicity or failure of brief ex vivo lung dosing. They limit broad mechanism/safety claims.
Cell full organ methods remain unrecovered. Human dose, exact salt, effect magnitude and washout cannot be filled from secondary accounts.
FXT-002/003 PK/safety findings cannot be assigned to FXT-001.
existing_candidate_updates.verdict: RETAIN_SECONDARY_COMPARATOR; no S-tier or broad safety promotion.
existing_candidate_updates.decisive_next_proof: Specify the exact material and quantify recipient carryover. In a function-led comparison, use orthogonal lipid-peroxidation/death evidence and avoid treating reduced oxidation alone as organ recovery.
existing_candidate_updates.go_rule: Proceed to differentiated preservation proof if organ function persists under drug-free reperfusion and exposure is reproducible.
existing_candidate_updates.stop_rule: Stop a duplicate business thesis or broad repair claim if it only repeats the existing preservation result, or if functional benefit vanishes after withdrawal.
existing_candidate_updates.material_route: Public free-base and HCl research listings; author analytical-data metadata improves traceability but is not authenticated physical material.
existing_candidate_updates.model_readiness: Published organ setting exists; a qualified local circuit, donor supply and exact protocol remain to be established.
existing_candidate_updates.rights_and_program: Current science-park listing still identifies FiriX as developer of FXT-001; no abandoned-asset inference.

new_candidate_screens.name: Sivelestat as a donor-lung protease comparator
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: Sivelestat sodium tetrahydrate, ONO-5046; use active-moiety equivalents when comparing preparations.

independent_unit.unit: rat graft/recipient; patient for systemic trials

evidence: Donor flush before 16h cold storage improved 48h transplanted-rat oxygenation; high-dose and control values were about379 versus134mmHg.
Pig EVLP abstract supports NE inhibition through four-hour recipient reperfusion, but exact inhibitor identity was not resolved in its retrieved text.
Systemic STRIVE lacked primary benefit and had a late mortality signal; 2026 cardiac-surgery study reported less ARDS in a different perioperative setting.
limitations: Neither human clinical population establishes ex vivo-only efficacy.
A simple NE inhibitor is not a substitute for demonstrated dual NE/PR3 inhibition.
No treated-human-donor-lung study was verified.
new_candidate_screens.verdict: ACTIVE_COMPARATOR; not a standalone top-priority promotion.
new_candidate_screens.decisive_next_proof: Compare matched NE suppression with AAT in a clinically relevant protein milieu, then test persistent graft function and residual recipient exposure.
new_candidate_screens.go_rule: A simpler product is justified only by equivalent-or-better useful function with a measurable handling/exposure advantage.
new_candidate_screens.stop_rule: Stop if benefit requires prolonged systemic exposure, disappears after washout, or offers no advantage over optimized AAT/perfusion.
new_candidate_screens.material_route: Public identity and manufactured-drug precedent; the rat paper specifies sodium tetrahydrate. Current stock, specific commercial lot and perfusate qualification not established.
new_candidate_screens.model_readiness: Published rat/pig transplant models; qualified local models and human organ supply not established.
new_candidate_screens.rights_and_program: Old, extensively developed compound and known graft-use literature; no novelty/FTO claim.

new_candidate_screens.name: Bis-T-23 for selected proteinuric podocytopathy
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: Bis-T-23/Ryngo1-23/AG1717, CAS171674-76-3; exact E/E chemical identity must be reconciled across supplier metadata.

independent_unit.unit: individual rodent; glomeruli and cells are nested

evidence: Treatment began 12 days after PAN injury when proteinuria was high; six daily treatments reduced proteinuria at days18 and24.
Genetic ACTN4 and other models support a post-deficit cytoskeletal strategy; later multi-nephron work supplies related rather than fully independent corroboration.
Independent 2025 NOS1AP-null mice did not reduce albuminuria, including early postdose sampling.
limitations: The effect is genotype/context dependent; it is not universal repair of monogenic proteinuria.
No human therapeutic exposure or durable human filtration-barrier rescue was verified.
Dynamin-mediated trafficking and other cellular functions may be affected; public catalog also describes endocytosis inhibition.
new_candidate_screens.verdict: RESEARCH_RESERVE; strongest new kidney proof candidate in this workstream, below current leaders.
new_candidate_screens.decisive_next_proof: Use independently built, mutation-defined human podocyte barrier models with established leakage. Compare genuine albumin selectivity and survival with existing supportive therapy, track free exposure and preserve endocytosis.
new_candidate_screens.go_rule: Advance if post-deficit barrier repair reproduces across responsive genotypes and independent lots within a functional safety window.
new_candidate_screens.stop_rule: Stop broad CKD/genetic-disease claims if benefit is absent in human functional models or achievable exposure perturbs essential trafficking.
new_candidate_screens.material_route: Abcam AB146050 and other public chemical listings; a public dynamin-stabilizer patent discloses material. No received lot or stock verified. Supplier textual structure fields should not replace LC-MS/NMR identity.
new_candidate_screens.model_readiness: Published rodent models and public engineered-cell approach; patient-specific mature filtration model still a development task.
new_candidate_screens.rights_and_program: US8809386B2 displays active on the retrieved patent page; neither old publication nor catalog access implies commercial clearance.

new_candidate_screens.name: Emricasan for injured donor-liver NMP
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: Emricasan/IDN-6556/PF-03491390, irreversible pan-caspase inhibitor; published liver study used MCE material in DMSO.

independent_unit.unit: individual donor liver; serial biopsies not independent

evidence: Five consecutive discarded human livers received emricasan before NMP; four met hepatocellular viability criteria, while one did not. Eleven controls were historical and stratified by outcome.
Caspase/cytokine suppression was clear; liver investigators explicitly did not establish definitive functional rehabilitation. Bile production did not differ.
An earlier99-patient randomized preservation trial provides human exposure precedent, with organ-only and organ-plus-recipient regimens; it is not the NMP cohort.
limitations: Historical/outcome-stratified controls cannot establish a four-of-five causal rescue rate.
Injured cholangiocyte function and recipient durability remain unproven for the proposed NMP product.
new_candidate_screens.verdict: HOLD_FOR_FUNCTIONAL_CAUSALITY; useful comparator, not leading asset.
new_candidate_screens.decisive_next_proof: A contemporaneous donor-balanced comparison must demonstrate improved hepatocellular and biliary function after a defined injury and drug-free reperfusion, beyond caspase inhibition.
new_candidate_screens.go_rule: Advance only on clinically useful functional recovery and retained bile-duct integrity at reproducible exposure.
new_candidate_screens.stop_rule: Stop if only inflammatory/apoptosis biomarkers change, function mirrors historical selection, or cell-death suppression masks nonviable tissue.
new_candidate_screens.material_route: Exact published research supplier/formulation route exists; no lot qualification or clinical supply established.
new_candidate_screens.model_readiness: Published human NMP implementation and public GEO datasets; local organ access unverified. Transcriptomic reanalysis cannot establish treatment randomization.
new_candidate_screens.rights_and_program: US20240268372A1 displays pending and specifically addresses caspase inhibition in organ preservation; no FTO conclusion.

new_candidate_screens.name: RTR tripeptide for lung-graft reperfusion injury
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: L-arginine–threonine–arginine (RTR), PGP-neutralizing tripeptide; terminal chemistry, counterion, purity and activity must be fixed for a new lot.

independent_unit.unit: individual transplanted mouse; human BAL donor for observational associations
independent_unit.count_boundary: Human cohorts assess target association, not treatment. Tissue fields do not increase mouse N.

evidence: 2026 primary study gave recipient-IV RTR immediately before reperfusion after18h cold ischemia; oxygenation/compliance improved at4h, with four mice per main functional group.
Human BAL target associations and syngeneic replication within the same study support biology, not independent therapeutic efficacy.
limitations: Ex vivo-only administration is a new route hypothesis.
No delayed established-PGD rescue, durable graft survival, human treatment, exposure window or active comparator was demonstrated.
new_candidate_screens.verdict: EARLY_RESERVE; public short-peptide build route, insufficient translational validation.
new_candidate_screens.decisive_next_proof: Independently verify peptide identity/PGP neutralization and distinguish sequence-specific activity from charge effects. Establish whether an ex vivo pulse retains functional benefit under recipient-like reperfusion versus AAT/sivelestat.
new_candidate_screens.go_rule: Advance only if a defined local route yields useful persistent graft function with a measured exposure margin.
new_candidate_screens.stop_rule: Stop if only recipient systemic predosing works, a matched control peptide reproduces the benefit, or effects are limited to short-term markers.
new_candidate_screens.material_route: Public three-residue sequence makes independent synthesis plausible; exact published finished material not fully reconciled and no lot or stock claimed.
new_candidate_screens.model_readiness: Published murine transplantation model; human donor intervention and local access remain unverified.
new_candidate_screens.rights_and_program: Current claim-specific commercial mapping not completed; short public sequence does not establish unencumbered use.

new_candidate_screens.name: QX77/CA77 for cystinosis tubular transport
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: QX77/CA77, CAS1798331-92-6; not the distinct analogue CA77.1.

independent_unit.unit: engineered HK-2 CTNS-null line and independent culture experiments

evidence: At20µM nominal exposure for48–72h, engineered CTNS-null HK-2 cells improved Rab11 trafficking and megalin localization.
2024 work found QX77/CA77 increased Rab11-FIP4; broader genetic Rab11-FIP4 rescue findings cannot all be attributed to the small molecule.
limitations: Membrane receptor localization is not measured whole-tubule solute/protein recovery.
Cell counts are not independent patients; no therapeutic human kidney exposure or in-vivo Fanconi rescue was established.
new_candidate_screens.verdict: DISCOVERY_HOLD; functional transport and exposure must precede promotion.
new_candidate_screens.decisive_next_proof: In independent CTNS-deficient polarized human proximal tubules, require improved receptor-mediated uptake and vectorial transport, including a cysteamine background, across a measured free-exposure range.
new_candidate_screens.go_rule: Advance if transport improvement exceeds cysteamine alone without losing polarity or viability and reproduces in donor-derived disease material.
new_candidate_screens.stop_rule: Stop if only localization/vesicle-motion markers improve or functional concentration exceeds the tolerable exposure window.
new_candidate_screens.material_route: MCE HY-112483 public exact identity and catalog; lot/stock unverified. Independent reconstruction requires identity and potency assays.
new_candidate_screens.model_readiness: Published CRISPR HK-2 approach provides a rebuild route, not a ready patient-derived transport model; no exact deposited clone assumed.
new_candidate_screens.rights_and_program: No claim-specific clearance or current clinical efficacy established in this bounded search.

new_candidate_screens.name: Genistein for cystinosis renal progression
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: Genistein, defined flavonoid; the mouse study used a specified dietary product, not an unspecified nutraceutical mix.

independent_unit.unit: individual female mouse; repeated urinary samples nested

evidence: Two-to16-month treatment preserved architecture and improved relative creatinine clearance (median0.62 versus0.44 untreated; WT normalized1).

Urinary Fanconi measures did not improve significantly; cysteamine comparator performed better on several tubular parameters. This was early prolonged treatment rather than reversal of an established deficit.
limitations: A glomerular progression signal does not establish proximal-tubular functional restoration.
Add-on benefit with cysteamine was not established; the comparison was separate treatment arms.
High mouse dietary exposure and reproductive/endocrine effects require a translational window.
new_candidate_screens.verdict: DEPRIORITIZE_FANCONI_RESCUE_THESIS; progression-adjunct hypothesis remains distinct and unproven.
new_candidate_screens.decisive_next_proof: Only reopen with added transport/function over cysteamine in an established-deficit human model at plausible free exposure.
new_candidate_screens.go_rule: Require additive clinically relevant function, not lower lysosomal staining alone.
new_candidate_screens.stop_rule: Stop the present rescue thesis if tubular losses remain unchanged or benefit requires preventive high-dose exposure.
new_candidate_screens.material_route: Public exact chemical and published commercial dietary source; finished formulation/lot and achievable kidney exposure not qualified.
new_candidate_screens.model_readiness: Published Ctns-null mouse study; a suitable human transport assay needs qualification.
new_candidate_screens.rights_and_program: No independent differentiated product, exclusivity or commercial-rights conclusion established.

new_candidate_screens.name: Luteolin for cystinosis Fanconi dysfunction
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: Luteolin, defined flavonoid (not genistein); published dietary exposure differs from the earlier50µM cellular screen.
evidence: Earlier cellular/zebrafish results suggested improved endocytosis and lysosomal biology.

Six-month mouse treatment at150mg/kg/day improved selected cellular markers but did not improve Fanconi dysfunction or renal inflammation. Filtration remained normal during observation, so that study cannot test rescue of impaired GFR.
limitations: The tested mechanism-marker effects did not translate to the intended tubular function.
A new exposure or formulation strategy would be a new hypothesis, not validation of the original result.
new_candidate_screens.verdict: STOP_CURRENT_FANCONI_PRODUCT_THESIS; retain as an informative negative comparator.
new_candidate_screens.decisive_next_proof: No further same-regimen promotion. Reopen only after a specific changed article/exposure produces independent post-deficit functional transport benefit.
new_candidate_screens.go_rule: A redesigned intervention must demonstrate function beyond the prior negative study.
new_candidate_screens.stop_rule: Do not progress based on repeated p62/LAMP1/apoptosis marker normalization.
new_candidate_screens.material_route: Published commercial reagent route and defined chemical; ease of acquisition does not repair the functional evidence.
new_candidate_screens.model_readiness: Published mouse and cellular models; no treatment effect on the required physiological endpoint established.
new_candidate_screens.rights_and_program: No new differentiated asset or commercial-rights determination.

retrieval_limits: Large FXT Cell author PDF was not retried. Public publisher access did not expose full organ methods; author data-deposit metadata is not donor-level physiology.
AAT2018 full direct PMC page hit a browser-check response; primary abstract, indexed methods/results and captions were inspected. Arm-level N is not invented.

process_lessons: Screen positive cellular findings together with their long-term functional follow-up: luteolin and genistein show why mechanistic normalization cannot substitute for the selected organ task.
Negative independent context data should bound a candidate, not be erased or generalized to every context: NOS1AP limits Bis-T-23; systemic STRIVE is not an ex vivo sivelestat trial.
A mechanistic comparator can increase the information value of a leader experiment even when it is not a new standalone venture.
A verified sequence/chemical identity, a catalog listing, physical stock, authenticated lot, model access and commercial rights remain separate facts.

new_candidates.name: Alvelestat for pancreas preservation before islet isolation
new_candidates.novelty_basis: No alvelestat/AZD9668 occurrence in the original inventory, round2 generated proposals, or round3 candidate records. Published use is not claimed to be new to science.
new_candidates.exact_entity: Alvelestat (AZD9668/MPH-966), research material from AdooQ in the source study, as an additive to extracellular-type trehalose-Kyoto pancreas-preservation solution.
new_candidates.functional_evidence: A 2022 primary study compared 10 porcine pancreatic isolations per group. Treated pancreata yielded more islets and higher glucose-stimulated insulin function. At a marginal transplanted islet quantity, 11/20 recipient mice reached the study's glycemic criterion versus1/20 controls; each group of20 mice came from10 isolations, two recipients per isolation.
new_candidates.biological_unit: Ten pancreatic donor/isolation units per group; recipient outcomes are nested two per isolation. Twenty recipients are not20 independent drug-treated donor pancreata.
new_candidates.treatment_timing: Preservation of an already procured organ before a prolonged cold-storage/isolation challenge. This is prevention of additional processing injury, not reversal of established diabetes in the donor or regeneration of lost human islets.
new_candidates.comparator: Same preservation workflow without alvelestat. The paper discusses sivelestat and ulinastatin but does not establish head-to-head superiority over an optimized active preservation regimen.
new_candidates.research_material_route: Defined small molecule and named research supplier in the primary methods. No current stock, received lot, salt/formulation equivalence, GMP supply or residual clearance qualification established in this review.
new_candidates.model_route: Porcine pancreas isolation route is described. Human donor-isolation access has not been secured or independently reproduced here.
new_candidates.exposure_product_gap: Need measured residual drug and NE activity through storage, washout and isolation; preserve digestion performance and viable functional yield at scale.
new_candidates.public_commercial_facts: Mereo and Sentynl announced an option/license agreement for alvelestat in AATD lung disease on11August2026, with Phase3 initiation projected for early2027 conditional on option exercise. That is an active external program, not an islet-use license or approval. NIH lists one related graft-rejection application as abandoned; this does not establish global clearance.
new_candidates.decision: Reserve for an independently differentiated islet-manufacturing proof; does not displace the leading programs.
new_candidates.deciding_proof: Test donor-level functional islet yield and sustained glucose-responsive output against optimized preservation plus an active NE-inhibitor comparator, with blinded allocation, explicit recipient clustering and residual-product clearance.
new_candidates.advance_condition: A reproducible human-relevant increase in usable functional islets, or reduced donor/isolation burden, that remains after washout and exceeds the strongest practical comparator.
new_candidates.stop_condition: Higher counts without useful secretion or graft function, no advantage over an existing preservation additive, or residual and processing burdens that erase the gain.

existing_candidate_updates.new_evidence_delta: Two public patent disclosures describe the matching S upstream intermediate, creating a plausible joined reconstruction route. Newly inspected source workbook verifies strong dose-dependent, ceiling-limited wire-hang observations but exposes an unresolved P22 schedule mismatch in the small late-start comparison, incomplete baseline records, and unlinked panel denominators.
existing_candidate_updates.decision: Retain leading staged human-function proof; improve route-definition confidence and narrow late-treatment evidence interpretation. No S-tier promotion.

independent_challenges.candidate_name: RM4404/WAY-262611 for delayed corneal nerve repair
independent_challenges.conclusion: Useful delayed functional signal merits independent replication. Randomization is reported. The mechanical-injury analysis treats two eyes of a mouse as independent, and its late durability comparisons are often against uninjured animals rather than direct drug-versus-vehicle tests. Supplement S2 supplies explicit drug-versus-vehicle tests, including a one-injured-eye chemical model. Do not claim equivalence to normal or count N22 eye observations as22 mice.
independent_challenges.product_note: Methods describe drug dilution from DMSO stocks into micelles; the high and low drug concentrations imply different DMSO fractions. Drug-free vehicle is described as similarly prepared, but explicit dose-matched solvent composition is not resolved. Treat this as a formulation-control qualification item, not a proven explanation of efficacy.
independent_challenges.deciding_proof: Independent, masked animal-level delayed-treatment replication with characterized formulation and matched vehicle, meaningful active comparator, post-withdrawal sensation, corneal optics and epithelial safety.
independent_challenges.additional_independent_review: A second workstream independently checked the primary paper. Section 2.9 reports blinded secondary imaging review; primary-quantifier and sensory-assessor blinding remain unresolved. At day30 axonal medians357.7 vehicle versus362.1 RM4404 do not demonstrate structural superiority from separate healthy-reference tests. Four days off treatment in the short regimen is not pharmacokinetic washout; do not merge it with the longer mechanical-injury cohort.

new_validation_priorities.name: RM4404/WAY-262611 for delayed corneal sensory repair
new_validation_priorities.decision: Retain conditional independent-validation priority. Selected for the next eligible public-source sprint after APR closure; the independent review development rank remains second, behind APR and ahead of BLU. Article, useful function, exposure, cost and capture remain unqualified.
new_validation_priorities.reason: Source-specific sensory and structural support survives the audit, including direct unilateral chemical-model contrasts. Biological-unit, timing, exact-article and clinical-claim limitations keep the next useful-function decision consequential. No fresh recovered evidence clearly favors switching this bounded sprint.
new_validation_priorities.deciding_proof: An interpretable existing-article and matched-control route to independent useful corneal function in an appropriate existing injury context, with adequate biological units, masking, tissue condition and tolerability. Distinguish protective recovery from reflex/pain effects and interpret actual exposure if making an off-treatment claim. One informative route may precede broader models and full sterile development; major scope expansion requires a new marginal-dollar comparison.
new_validation_priorities.round5_delta: Published Calbiochem317700 is WAY262611HCl, while Cayman17704 is free base. Reconcile salt/molar loading/release and matched solvent. Public2025 provisional title located; claims not recovered. No blanket FTO assertion.

round17_marginal_decision.objective: Expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar
round17_marginal_decision.selected_uncertainty: Whether RM4404 offers reproducible useful corneal function with an interpretable article/exposure and a bounded product contribution, rather than a sensory-surrogate or major sterile-product project
round17_marginal_decision.basis: Next eligible public-source sprint after APR closure, following independent conditional development order APR1/RM2/BLU3 and testing fresh evidence that could reverse the selection

round17_delta: RM is the selected public-source sprint, not an automatic new first development asset. APR1/RM2/BLU3 is retained as the independent review conditional order; no calculated return or new allocation.

A 2025 institutional abstract publicly reports direct delayed-CMI sensory contrasts but lacks denominators and uses different methods from the final report. No additional independent cohort or final clustered result is credited.

Figure 18 three-digit counts are nested readings from three mice per group; its mixed statistical notation remains unresolved. Stronger unilateral chemical-model contrasts and early-regimen off-dosing results remain separate from late CMI limits.

Early-versus-delayed comparison changes treatment phase and time since dosing together. A ceiling-limited blink endpoint cannot independently establish sensory quality, optics, barrier protection or absence of hypersensitivity.

Literal filtration wording, fresh batch preparation and carrier-specific primary evidence narrow product inference. Salt/solvent, chemical stability, release, exact ocular exposure and tolerance remain unqualified; neither blanket carrier rejection nor full CMC as an initial universal gate is justified.

Cenegermin extension permits additional treatment and defines responder-specific outcomes; its SAP prespecifies observed-case analysis. Numeric result tables were not recovered. Orunea is an initiated epithelial-healing study, not a completed sensory result.
Known-family rights and retained economics remain unresolved. Close the bounded source pass; reopen only for a named substantive artifact or fact that changes the next commitment.

local_qualification_comparison.interpretation: Different diseases and products compete for qualification resources; APR-246 is not a same-indication comparator for Darier.
local_qualification_comparison.NDC9009: Round 19 completes the selected source sprint and retains conditional rank4 under the original useful-function scope. C18 disclosure and sponsor overlap refine capture; SGT210 controlled failure strengthens the vehicle/incremental-benefit question without establishing NDC failure. Repair, prevention and control require claim-specific evidence. No new NDC human result or executable cost established.
local_qualification_comparison.RM4404: Selected next public-source sprint after APR closure; completed Round 17 retains conditional independent validation and development position two in APR1/RM2/BLU3. Model-specific direct effects survive, while nested histology, timing, article/exposure and useful-function limits constrain the next small tranche. Major sterile/model/rights work requires a new comparison. The APR priority and ongoing-control amendment remain unchanged.
local_qualification_comparison.APR246: First conditional marginal-dollar qualification priority after Round 16. Existing human lesions and more concrete article/model routes support useful ongoing-control qualification. Perfect cornification and withdrawal persistence are not universal gates; actual function, exposure, transfer, access and capture remain unresolved.
local_qualification_comparison.reallocation_rule: Compare the value and tractability of the next proof across NDC/Darier, RM4404/cornea, APR-246/AEC and ruxolitinib/HHD. Different diseases are not same-indication comparators. A clinically useful matched-lesion proof or a clearer exposure/product route can outrank an incumbent without waiting for its experiment.
local_qualification_comparison.ruxolitinib_HHD: Round7 supplies a defined clinical-proof dossier with five exact-strength case reports, source/PK audits and current competition. A concurrent clinical comparison is the next proof; direct calcium-pump repair and a new proprietary formulation are not presumed. See round7 files.
local_qualification_comparison.roflumilast_Darier: One prior detailed 0.3% cream case remains the same-indication clinical comparator. Round 19 separates a co-treated sequential roflumilast-to-apremilast poster and a sparse oral roflumilast conference summary. No pooled monotherapy rate, barrier restoration, HHD transfer or independently owned asset follows.

round5.counting_rule: Twelve exact intervention-use screens, not12new molecular families. Seven existing candidates comprise four core programs, two local challengers and the existing dantrolene comparator. new_candidate_screens.name: Pantethine for PPCS-deficiency dilated cardiomyopathy
new_candidate_screens.novelty: New molecule/use in schema4; literal pantethine and PPCS searches had no prior records.
new_candidate_screens.decision: Conditional non-core reserve; exact chemical species and exposure bridge are first gating experiments.
new_candidate_screens.exact_product: Oral pantethine supplementation is the clinical claim. The functional in-vitro paper labels its reagent pantethine but cites Sigma 16702, currently (R)-pantetheine monomer, CAS 496-65-1. Pantethine is a disulfide, CAS 16816-67-4. Interconversion is plausible; historical vial identity and molar basis are unresolved.
new_candidate_screens.evidence: Zhang 2025 reports four pantethine-treated patients with standard cardiac care and models from two patient iPSC backgrounds. Cardiac patches received 500 micromolar reagent on days 7–21; force decline stabilized without significant force increase, and force-frequency behavior remained abnormal. Day-60 cardiomyocytes treated at 100 micromolar for five days showed partial calcium/sarcomere improvement. Recovery after arrest included concurrent ICD, beta-blocker and ACE inhibition.

denominator.human: Four treated patients described in Zhang 2025; two are follow-up of previously reported cases. A separately verified infant case with homozygous p.Ala243Pro is distinct from that series. These are selected records, not an exhaustive patient census or a controlled responder rate.
denominator.controls: Two control lines; one clone per line.
denominator.patches: Controls: 8 across 2 lines. Patient 95595: 15 untreated, 13 treated. Patient 103596: 9 untreated, 8 treated. Patches/cells are not independent patients.

new_candidate_screens.timing_and_function: Some functional deficits existed before treatment. Evidence is partial rescue/stabilization; no normalization of established cardiac force, no prospective controlled human attribution, no established withdrawal durability.
new_candidate_screens.material_model_route: Public chemical specifications and cardiac protocol are available. HMGUi003-A is marked not readily obtainable. MRIi028-A allows research but prohibits commercial development/for-profit use. A separately licensed parental iPSC line with engineered PPCS variants is a possible new route requiring model qualification; it does not confer permission to use restricted patient lines commercially.
new_candidate_screens.exposure_and_safety: Historical four-child pantethine metabolism study found rapid conversion and no detectable intact parent in plasma by its assay. This is not proof of absent active metabolite exposure in PPCS. Heat-inactivated-serum bath activity at 100–500 micromolar has not been connected to free human myocardial exposure of the actual active species.
new_candidate_screens.comparator: Standard heart-failure care background; genetic correction as causal control; chemically authenticated pantethine/pantetheine and appropriate precursor/metabolite controls for pathway specificity.
new_candidate_screens.value: Potentially inexpensive and disease-specific. Small reported case count, product identity, commercial model permissions and reproducible functional efficacy prevent a fundable-asset claim.
new_candidate_screens.deciding_proof: Resolve the reagent discrepancy analytically and test the clinically generated species at measured feasible exposure after a qualified, predictable force/fatigue deficit in independent commercially usable PPCS models. Prespecify preservation versus reversal as distinct claims. A controlled useful functional effect with an acceptable arrhythmia and mitochondrial window would justify the next development tranche.
new_candidate_screens.go: Reproducible reversal of established force/fatigue deficit at defensible human exposure, with a precise molecule/formulation and independent-genotype support.
new_candidate_screens.stop: Stop the full-reversal claim if the result only slows deterioration; preserve a separate preservation hypothesis if clinically useful and supported. Stop the exact-product thesis for infeasible exposure, an undocumented active chemical species that cannot be defined, or no qualified model route compatible with the intended use. Do not reject pathway biology solely because an original patient line has restricted terms.
new_candidate_screens.advance_condition: Reproducible reversal of established force/fatigue deficit at defensible human exposure, with a precise molecule/formulation and independent-genotype support.
new_candidate_screens.stop_condition: Stop the full-reversal claim if the result only slows deterioration; preserve a separate preservation hypothesis if clinically useful and supported. Stop the exact-product thesis for infeasible exposure, an undocumented active chemical species that cannot be defined, or no qualified model route compatible with the intended use. Do not reject pathway biology solely because an original patient line has restricted terms.

new_candidate_screens.name: Topical gentamicin sulfate for susceptible LAMA3/LAMB3 nonsense JEB
new_candidate_screens.novelty: Gentamicin already appears in schema4 under SERPINB7/Nagashima palmoplantar keratosis. This exact JEB intervention/use is new and is counted once.
new_candidate_screens.decision: Human functional reserve; qualify differentiated product value and treatment-area safety before advancement.
new_candidate_screens.exact_product: The topical study used 0.5% gentamicin sulfate in white petrolatum, applied to selected wounds for two weeks. This product is separate from intravenous gentamicin regimens.
new_candidate_screens.evidence: Three children supplied primary keratinocytes and underwent open-label topical treatment. Functional laminin-332 and improved wound closure persisted through three months. A separate five-child IV series supports biological activity but is not a replication of the topical formulation. Open-label local comparisons do not exclude wound-care or antimicrobial effects.

denominator.independence: Do not sum topical and IV participants as eight unique people; overlap was not excluded. Wounds and biopsies are within-patient observations.
denominator.genotypes: Topical patients: LAMB3 C325X/c.629-12T>A; LAMA3 Y63X/Y63X; LAMA3 Q625X/c.4909+1G>A.

new_candidate_screens.timing_and_function: Treats existing wounds and includes cell adhesion/laminin assembly rather than expression alone. Short treatment followed by later closure is encouraging; durability of mechanical resilience and full barrier after withdrawal remain unproven.
new_candidate_screens.material_model_route: Standardized research/clinical gentamicin identities and published patient-cell/engineered readthrough models provide a public replication route. Precise susceptibility must be established per allele; research product existence is not validated batch quality or stock.
new_candidate_screens.exposure_and_safety: No renal, auditory or anti-laminin safety signal was observed in the small short-course studies. Limited-area observations do not establish repeated large-body-area exposure safety, cumulative ototoxicity or nephrotoxicity.
new_candidate_screens.comparator: Matched vehicle, optimized wound care and an antibacterial comparator lacking the desired readthrough action; genotype-matched controls.
new_candidate_screens.value: Closer to human functional evidence than many candidates. An off-the-shelf antibiotic protocol has uncertain new-venture differentiation; a defined safer pulse formulation or validated genotype-response strategy would need to add measurable value.
new_candidate_screens.deciding_proof: Independent established-wound/skin-resilience benefit attributable to readthrough, with measured systemic exposure and superiority to an antimicrobial-active control.
new_candidate_screens.go: Durable functional adhesion/barrier advantage with a clinically meaningful product improvement and bounded exposure.
new_candidate_screens.stop: Benefit is indistinguishable from antibacterial/wound-care effects or the required exposure lacks an acceptable repeated-use window.
new_candidate_screens.product_qualification_addendum: Gentamicin is a congener mixture. Match composition and disease-specific readthrough potency; antibacterial potency and total mass alone do not establish equivalent rescue activity. A separate gentamicin-B1 readthrough paper was retracted after the supplied material proved to be G418; this does not invalidate the 2020 topical JEB results.
new_candidate_screens.advance_condition: Durable functional adhesion/barrier advantage with a clinically meaningful product improvement and bounded exposure.
new_candidate_screens.stop_condition: Benefit is indistinguishable from antibacterial/wound-care effects or the required exposure lacks an acceptable repeated-use window.

new_candidate_screens.name: Low-dose efavirenz for cognitive dysfunction in juvenile/adult NPC1
new_candidate_screens.decision: Hold for controlled functional benefit on contemporary standard care.
new_candidate_screens.exact_product: Oral low-dose efavirenz, 25 mg daily initially and 100 mg after week 26 in the 52-week pilot; distinct from standard HIV exposure.
new_candidate_screens.evidence: All 16 participants, ages 15–60, completed a miglustat-background open-label pilot. Its 100% response means no threshold-defined deterioration in at least two of three cognitive domains, not universal restoration. Continuous cognitive outcomes were mixed; disability/ataxia were stable and a swallowing signal was reported. Favorable/unfavorable clusters were generated from the response data.

denominator.posthoc_clusters: Seven favorable and nine unfavorable response-defined clusters are not externally validated predictive strata.

new_candidate_screens.timing_and_function: Established human disease was treated, but uncontrolled stability and repeated cognitive tests cannot isolate drug effect or establish restored function.
new_candidate_screens.material_model_route: Known oral molecule and published dose range. No proprietary access response is needed for the next evidence decision. Formulation and low-dose accuracy would require qualification.
new_candidate_screens.exposure_and_safety: No efavirenz-attributed adverse event in this small NPC pilot. A tiny Alzheimer target-engagement study supports CYP46A1 modulation, not NPC efficacy. High-concentration efavirenz ataxia in a different population makes exposure monitoring relevant without proving low-dose NPC harm.
new_candidate_screens.comparator: Contemporary NPC care must account for FDA-approved levacetylleucine and arimoclomol plus miglustat, as applicable. The trial's historical 'miglustat only' context is not current US care.
new_candidate_screens.value: Repurposing simplicity is favorable; incremental function over current care and a protectable/otherwise fundable product package are not established.
new_candidate_screens.deciding_proof: Prespecified controlled add-on improvement in cognition/swallowing or daily function at measured exposure, rather than a permissive stability composite or post-hoc subgroup.
new_candidate_screens.go: A replicated, patient-important functional advantage over current background treatment with a clean exposure-response window.
new_candidate_screens.stop: Only post-hoc selection or non-deterioration by permissive criteria supports efficacy.

existing_candidate_updates.name: Selective PIK3C2B inhibition for MTM1 myotubular myopathy
existing_candidate_updates.decision: first bounded human-function proof, after material/model qualification
existing_candidate_updates.delta: New cell audit887 values; human isogenic precedents; PIK3C3 all-zero/finite-IC50 conflict; enzyme-concentration qualification; terminal-only PK; exact comparator47 prioritized for qualification; four independent proof-design corrections accepted.
existing_candidate_updates.deciding_proof: Authenticate BLU, qualify a human MTM1 force/fatigue deficit and a post-deficit functional positive control, then compare delayed BLU, target-genetic perturbation and a qualified second chemistry with active comparator. Preserve absolute force, donor/batch structure and minimum useful effect; connect muscle benefit to relevant unbound tissue exposures.

existing_candidate_updates.name: 8015-P2 mitofusin activation for MFN2-CMT2A
existing_candidate_updates.decision: Continue staged independent exact-compound human-function proof; no S-tier promotion.
existing_candidate_updates.delta: Independent isogenic R94Q transport model has no overt patch-clamp deficit at tested age; a separate corrected patient line supplies network-burst phenotype. Operating R364W rat service and model grant support a second-allele challenge. Publisher supplement recovered:75binding+12enzyme/cell rows; MAO-A59% is binding. DMSO matching remains a transfer question.
existing_candidate_updates.deciding_proof: After a qualified, stable or predictably changing deficit, compare independently authenticated P2, parent mixture, less-active P1 and vehicle in mature human motor-neuron/muscle co-cultures spanning T105M and another MFN2 pathogenic background, with isogenic correction controls. Measure evoked NMJ-mediated force, transmission reliability, fatigue, direct-muscle-stimulated force and free exposure. Treat transport/morphology as mechanistic covariates. Separate continuous from pulsed exposure and measure healthy neuronal/cardiac function at the same free concentrations. Qualify delayed functional modifiability separately from genetic correction before differentiation; match final solvents and interpret tissue distribution rather than assuming equal culture exposure establishes the systemic window.

existing_candidate_updates.name: RM4404 / WAY-262611 corneal sensory repair
existing_candidate_updates.decision: Retain independent-validation priority outside core; require exact salt/formulation and sensory-comparator qualification.
new_findings: The paper's Calbiochem/Sigma catalog 317700 is currently labeled WAY-262611 hydrochloride; Cayman 17704 is the free base. Same active moiety does not establish equal micellar loading, molar basis or release. Historical batch identity needs analytical qualification, not an assumed substitution.

The original discovery uses a DKK1-associated functional Wnt/TCF reporter. A reviewed direct binding constant or cell-specific target-occupancy result was not established; pharmacological phenotype alone does not prove exclusive DKK1 engagement in corneal Schwann cells.

The inventor's institutional profile names a 2025 US provisional for corneal nerve regeneration via DKK1 inhibition. No application number or claim text was located in this bounded search; there is no public basis for asserting licensing availability or freedom to operate.

Oxervate's randomized label studies established epithelial healing, but mean sensitivity changes were not clinically significant. A separate early-stage open-label cenegermin study reports sensory improvement, so neither 'cenegermin restores nothing' nor 'RM4404 is superior' is supported.
existing_candidate_updates.denominator: Retain round4's animal-versus-eye accounting: supplementary mechanical-model N=22 eye observations across three groups; chemical N=12 across three groups with one injured eye per mouse. These are not human efficacy denominators.
existing_candidate_updates.preserved_corrections: Randomization and blinded secondary image review were reported; primary sensory-assessor masking remains unclear. The 7–14 dpi course was observed at day30, but days off treatment are not measured pharmacological washout. At day30, axon-length significance versus healthy tissue is not an RM-versus-vehicle effect.
existing_candidate_updates.exact_product: Paper-defined WAY-262611 in Kolliphor HS15 micelles. Salt, final DMSO, loading, free versus encapsulated drug, release and stability must be measured. TEM appearance after storage does not establish potency, sterility or shelf life.
existing_candidate_updates.model_and_comparator: Independent delayed-injury model with animal-level allocation, masked sensation, matched final solvent and cenegermin/appropriate repair control; intended human hypoesthesia population must match actual model. Add optical/epithelial integrity and pain discrimination.
existing_candidate_updates.exposure_and_safety: Local delivery is plausible but ocular free exposure, target engagement, epithelial safety and hyperalgesia are not resolved.
existing_candidate_updates.rights_scope: Named provisional and institutional commercialization statements are public evidence of rights activity. Actual enforceable claim scope was not established.
existing_candidate_updates.deciding_proof: Delayed functional sensation benefit exceeding matched vehicle, durable after measured clearance, with a useful comparator and no optical, epithelial or pain penalty.
existing_candidate_updates.go: Independent animal-level replication and qualified exact formulation plus clinically relevant functional advantage.
existing_candidate_updates.stop: Effect disappears with solvent/salt correction, reflects sensitization rather than repair, or is supported only by healthy-reference normalization.

existing_candidate_updates.name: APR-246 / PRIMA-1MET topical treatment for AEC skin erosions
existing_candidate_updates.decision: Retain serious local translational challenger; coverage is not established mature barrier restoration.
new_findings: The cell experiment began APR-246 two days before calcium-induced differentiation. This is not reversal of a mature defective barrier. LOR/SPRR1A remained unrescued, matching incomplete clinical cornification; p63 aggregate clearance was not demonstrated.
Biopsies came from nonerosive arm skin, which healed normally after sampling. A genotype-positive culture may not reproduce the anatomical/environmental lesion context.

The paper reports 0.6 mg/g cream and a literal 5 mg APR-246 per day; taken literally these imply about 8.33 g cream/day. This is a reporting/transfer ambiguity, not proof of dosing error. Applied mass, area and tissue exposure require an independently defined formulation specification.

The US issued patent's claim1 includes AEC, PRIMA-1MET and ectodermal dysplasia affecting at least one cornea; dependent cream/skin claims retain that predicate. This is neither a blanket all-skin claim nor proof that topical skin treatment of patients with corneal disease is outside it.
The European published application has broader proposed wound-healing/p63-compound claims; published claims are not a verified granted/current enforceable scope.

A later JEB keratinocyte paper reports partial adhesion rescue in three patient lines with overlapping investigators. It supports broader phenotype activity, not independent AEC clinical or mature-barrier replication.
existing_candidate_updates.denominator: Original clinical evidence remains two children with TP63 SAM variants I576T and I537T. Their patient-derived experiments are linked evidence, not an independent cohort. Later JEB three-line result is a different use and not counted as a new lead in this round.
existing_candidate_updates.exact_product: PRIMA-1MET/APR-246, CAS5291-32-7, catalog3710; not PRIMA-1 catalog1862. The original topical article used 0.6mg/g in Seraqua and reported three-week refrigerated stability, not an established commercial dosage product.
existing_candidate_updates.model_and_comparator: Established-lesion or independently qualified AEC skin model, matched vehicle and optimized wound care, at least two disease backgrounds and regional/healthy-skin controls. Functional readouts should measure permeability and mechanical resilience plus cornification after withdrawal.
existing_candidate_updates.exposure_and_safety: MQ/thiol-redox biology provides an alternative/complementary mechanism and a testable exposure-window concern. Cancer-cell glutathione effects do not prove dermal toxicity. One-week healthy-mouse irritation data reported without display do not establish chronic safety.
existing_candidate_updates.rights_scope: US12521392B2 granted January13,2026, assignees APHP/INSERM/UniversitéParisCité; claim-level review is preliminary and territory/product/patient-population dependent. EP3823622A1 publication is not a freedom-to-operate result.
existing_candidate_updates.deciding_proof: A defined topical dose restores durable mechanical/barrier function after established deficit, with a healthy-skin exposure window; clinical coverage/pain improvement alone cannot settle this.
existing_candidate_updates.go: Independent durable functional barrier restoration, measured local exposure and a tractable product/territory claim path.
existing_candidate_updates.stop: Surface coverage persists without mature resilience, apparent rescue is confined to differentiation pretreatment, or active exposure injures healthy repair.

existing_candidate_updates.name: Dantrolene sodium / Darier
existing_candidate_updates.decision: Adult clinical benchmark and mechanistic comparator; weak positive available-case signal, not durable barrier restoration or topical proof.
existing_candidate_updates.supersedes: Actual SUM-151495 result tables unread; do not infer outcome from trial completion.
existing_candidate_updates.deciding_proof: A controlled useful-function and tolerability comparison retaining all starters, with background treatment and nonresponse attrition handled explicitly. A topical product needs its own delivery/function proof.
existing_candidate_updates.advance_condition: Independent controlled benefit on clinically useful outcomes, with an interpretable functional/safety window and a distinct product proposition.
existing_candidate_updates.stop_condition: Do not promote completer-only lesion ratings or retinoid-confounded follow-up into durable barrier repair or topical feasibility.

candidate_updates.name: Enasidenib for germline IDH2-R140Q D2HGA2
candidate_updates.decision: Defined clinical development priority: recommend a bounded pediatric article/exposure project linked to prospective organ function.
candidate_updates.priority_scope: Clinical-stage work queue; no numerical cross-program success probability or asset-return rank.
candidate_updates.exact_entity: Enasidenib; mesylate tablet reference and documented pediatric sprinkle use. Intended infant presentation must be specified; historical clinical lot identity with EP4058028B1 is unverified.
candidate_updates.population: Direct human treatment anchor is germline heterozygous IDH2-R140Q. R140G, type-I D2HGDH disease and other IDH2 variants do not inherit efficacy.
candidate_updates.functional_evidence: One clear severe-cardiomyopathy trajectory: LVEF 20–25% at entry, 35–40% at six months and 40–45% at eight months with later fluctuation and concurrent care. A second original child had normal baseline systolic function; Gold had milder baseline disease. Biochemical suppression is strong; neurological outcomes are less causally secure.
candidate_updates.biological_units: Five outcome case records across three publications; original two and Gold are clearly distinct. Cross-publication linkage of two skin cases is unresolved. Metadata-only five-week-old report adds zero verified outcomes.
candidate_updates.material_route: Defined marketed tablet and research free-base routes; actual studied sprinkle and concrete minitablet patent. Public route and historical use do not establish received lot, present supply or infant administration compatibility.
candidate_updates.model_route: ATCC R140Q TF-1/parent route is biochemical, homozygous and cancer-line specific. Endogenous heterozygous mouse and genetic reversibility precedents exist. A new human cardiac model is optional when it discriminates a consequential exposure/function question.
candidate_updates.exposure_and_safety: Current adult PK includes 7.9-day half-life, tenfold accumulation, 29-day steady state, active metabolite, interactions and plausible A3 antagonism. No infant dose rule or lifelong safety boundary. Direct pediatric ALT/CK observations require a coherent longitudinal exposure/laboratory timeline.
candidate_updates.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing clinical program and published granted pediatric minitablet composition/process claims prevent a first-pediatric-formulation or open-rights claim. Define an improvement in delivery, exposure, burden/tolerability or prospective clinical evidence; standalone value capture remains unresolved.
candidate_updates.deciding_proof: Qualify one intended pediatric article/administration route and parent/metabolite/chiral-D2HG measures, then link exposure to observed tolerability and a preselected growth-aware organ outcome with suitable comparison and concurrent-care accounting.
candidate_updates.advance_condition: Reliable delivery and interpretable exposure/PD plus a useful organ-function or preservation signal justify confirmation; a larger product program requires independently supported clinical benefit and a real product advantage.
candidate_updates.stop_or_redirect_condition: Redirect delivery failure or exposure-related harm; narrow tissue/genotype/timing claims when appropriate. Do not reject human observations from an unqualified model. Stop a standalone product thesis if no useful incremental contribution or practicable product route exists.
candidate_updates.round7_delta: Full clinical lineage and 177-cell laboratory audit; specific public pediatric formulation, adult PK/DDI/A3 and model audit; staged clinical proof with independent challenge. Removed from the reserve list to avoid conflicting current dispositions.

candidate_updates.name: Ruxolitinib 1.5% cream for refractory Hailey–Hailey disease
candidate_updates.decision: Defined controlled clinical-proof priority: recommend marketed-article, protocol and measurement qualification followed by a contemporaneously controlled patient-benefit comparison.
candidate_updates.priority_scope: Clinical-stage work queue; not an established proprietary asset or numerical cross-program investment rank.
candidate_updates.exact_entity: Prospective standardized Opzelura 1.5% cream, 15 mg/g ruxolitinib base equivalent as 19.8 mg/g phosphate. Historical cases verify active/concentration/route, not every brand, vehicle or lot.
candidate_updates.functional_evidence: Five distinguishable exact-strength case reports support useful local control. Monotherapy-style treatment, add-on induction and topical maintenance are kept separate. No controlled exact-rux HHD effect estimate was verified.
candidate_updates.biological_units: Five selected single-patient reports, not a consecutive treated denominator. EADV duplicate and separate 1%+naltrexone report excluded from that count. Nine-patient preprint remains abstract-only and unpooled.
candidate_updates.material_route: Manufactured marketed cream defines a clinical article. Research free base/phosphate are assay routes, not equivalent clinical formulations. Qualified matched vehicle is one option; pragmatic randomized whole-product add-on comparison is a defined alternative.
candidate_updates.model_route: ATP2C1 engineered/organotypic research precedents, with parent identity and assay-stage limits. Optional mechanism work only; immune-free model negativity cannot rule out an inflammatory clinical mechanism.
candidate_updates.exposure_and_safety: AD PK: 479-person 1.5% phaseIII subgroup, mean Css 35.7 nM; maximum-use n=40 mean 104 nM with high-exposure extremes. No HHD PK boundary. 281 nM is a laboratory proxy, not a universal safety threshold; follow current label/combination context.
candidate_updates.public_rights_and_contribution: Existing composition/formulation claims and branded franchise; current ANDA litigation. KB111 and guselkumab are active distinct HHD programs. Controlled data may be valuable, while a proprietary asset needs a differentiated benefit and executable rights/manufacturing/regulatory route.
candidate_updates.deciding_proof: Prespecified patient-level clinical estimand with concurrent care/control, masked lesion assessment, meaningful pain/recurrence/rescue/burden interpretation and exposure linked to applied grams, active erosion and healing. No forced withdrawal or automatic new-model gate.
candidate_updates.advance_condition: Controlled useful clinical benefit or comparable efficacy with a meaningful burden/tolerability advantage, interpretable exposure and acceptable observed safety; exploratory evidence can justify independent confirmation.
candidate_updates.stop_or_redirect_condition: Rule out a meaningful benefit only with an informative design and adequate delivery; redirect measurement/article failures. Stop the proposed product for reproducible unacceptable effective-exposure harm or no differentiated product contribution.
candidate_updates.round7_delta: Five-report clinical audit, DERM101 concurrent-control benchmark, mechanistic citation correction, quantitative PK/high-exposure and official-patent audit, current competitors and a staged clinical proof. No new lead counted.

Proposed CB-SKM-6-WT male nonisogenic reference is not verified as the historical plot control.24-tissue qualification and conditional96-tissue exploration are prospective resources, not power. Public raw N/variance unavailable.

Native engagement unresolved; PRM-CETSA is a proposed bridge, not occupancy. Useful force and energy function must coexist at measured exposure. leader_updates.public_rights_note: Public structure, route and catalogs do not establish ownership or commercial clearance. Blueprint-origin and independent target/compound claims apply symmetrically with clinical-leader franchises; standalone value capture unresolved.
leader_updates.next_decision_question: Can the exact qualified article improve a qualified human MTM1 force/fatigue deficit, and does that signal justify confirmation with a relevant mitochondrial, neuronal, hepatic and cardiac exposure window?
leader_updates.proposed_advance_condition: Exploratory point>=M and lower95% bound>0 with qualified inputs and interpretable functional safety earns independent confirmation. Independent lower95% bound>M supports the tested background. Incomplete native engagement limits mechanism, not necessarily positive function.
leader_updates.proposed_stop_condition: Wrong lot/model/measurement redirects qualification. Upper95% bound<M supports model-specific futility only with adequate target perturbation, exposure and delayed modifiability. Orthogonal selective and independent-background failure is needed for bounded target downgrade. Required-exposure harm or absent product contribution can stop the article/asset thesis.
leader_updates.decision: Leading bounded qualification project: exact S article, independently specified assay, measured exposure and one post-deficit human-force model; conditional exploration and independent confirmation.
leader_updates.round3_delta: More concrete model route; narrower chemistry and assay-transfer claims. No new human BLU force efficacy demonstrated.
leader_updates.round4_delta: Two public patent disclosures describe the matching S upstream intermediate, creating a plausible joined reconstruction route. Newly inspected source workbook verifies strong dose-dependent, ceiling-limited wire-hang observations but exposes an unresolved P22 schedule mismatch in the small late-start comparison, incomplete baseline records, and unlinked panel denominators.
leader_updates.deciding_proof: Authenticate article, fix independent construct/reaction and exposure method, qualify post-deficit absolute twitch force in one background, then test a locked primary exposure and threshold M=max(.25*Gcal,repeatability floor) in uN. Confirm independently before broader genotype work.
